About Abbott

Abbott is a global healthcare leader, creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology.

Working at Abbott

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You will have access to:

Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.

A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries around the world and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.

A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as a best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

 

Our nutrition business develops science-based nutrition products for people of all ages, from helping babies and children grow, to keeping adult bodies strong and active. Millions of people around the world count on our leading brands – including Similac®, PediaSure®, Pedialyte®, Ensure®, Glucerna® and ZonePerfect® – to help get the nutrients they need to live their healthiest life.

Main Purpose of Role:
Responsible for long-term growth of Abbott Nutrition products in territory by increasing awareness among Health Care professionals on the important role of nutrition in improving quality of life, and the superiority of Abbott products to competitor brands. Gain new business and grow existing business in customer accounts by building the confidence of HCPs in recommending Abbott brand products.

Main Responsibilities:

Drive impactful engagements with healthcare professionals (HCPs) through one-on-one consultations, highlighting the role of clinical nutrition in patient care and positioning Abbott as the preferred choice.

Build and strengthen relationships with HCPs across assigned accounts to boost brand visibility and influence product recommendations.

Gather market insights, including competitor activity and unmet needs, to develop targeted account plans that drive growth.

Deliver compelling product detailing to equip HCPs with the latest scientific knowledge and emphasize the clinical advantages of Abbott’s nutrition portfolio.

Address HCPs’ specific needs and objections with tailored messaging to gain their commitment to recommend Abbott products.

Collaborate with patient groups and stakeholders to support educational initiatives and raise awareness among patients and caregivers.

Track and report account performance against KPIs and take proactive steps to ensure targets are met.

Qualifications:

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Pharmacy, Medicine, or a related healthcare field.

Experience: Fresh are welcome or at least 1 year of experience in pharmaceutical or healthcare sales.

Strong communication and presentation skills

Good organizational and time management abilities

Relationship-building and consultative selling skills

Self-motivated, persistent, and goal-oriented

Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritional and branded generic medicines. Our 114,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

WORKING AT ABBOTT

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You will have access to:

Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.

A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries around the world and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.

A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as a best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

MAIN PURPOSE OF THE ROLE

The Country Manager-Vietnam will take P&L responsibility, for building an effective sales pipeline which will result in achieving strategic & financial goal in his or her territory. This position plays a key role in managing the sales and marketing activities through combination of direct and distribution organizations in its respective country. He or she has the duty to assist in identifying and developing the sales and marketing opportunities for existing and new Abbott Rapid Diagnostics (ARDx) portfolios to eventually grow entire ARDx business by implementing Abbott S&M strategy.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

Leading both strategic & all operational commercial activities in its respective territory as below

Develop/shape/Customize/implement/drive the local country commercial / marketing strategy to be aligned with ARDx Global & Regional Commercial / Marketing Strategy.

Contribute to the strategic direction and business development of the Vietnam business and future APAC, by providing extensive market intelligence relevant to maximizing the ARDx product portfolio market opportunities in its territory.

Meet established financial goals (Top line & bottom line) and objective while maintaining territory budget by driving business growth through geographical expansion strategy execution.

Track sales results vs projected budget and outcomes objectives. 

Develop go to market strategies through direct sales efforts and business partners to accelerate ARDx products and services with business partner in assigned territory by bridging strategy implementation between “Sell to” model and “Sell with” model.

Support distribution partners in the sale of products, including training, sales meeting, technical expertise and marketing support of the ARDx product portfolio & Shaping New Business model as “Sell with” to be aligned with Regulatory plan in 2024.

Identify customer issues and resolves sales related difficulties, Working with KOLs for strong preference site

Act as a resource for contract negotiation, pricing, proposal, bid preparation and all customers follow up. 

Timely follow up and management of all leads that are distributed in territory.

Coordinate and facilitate of each market regulatory requirement & procedures.

Responsibility- Internal Systems and Process

Comply with Abbott Corporate Policies and Procedures.

Ensure all business activities are conducted professionally, aligned with regulatory and industry guidelines and are conducted in a manner consistent with Abbott’s Code of Conduct guidelines, and Abbott’s Anti-Corruption Policy

Responsibility- Customers

Responsible for exhibiting professional behavior with both internal/external business associates that reflects positively on the company and is consistent with the company’s policies and procedures.

Maintain key NGO account and key opinion leaders in responsible market.

Maintain complete customer master list.

Responsibility- Conduct

Ensure all activities carried out by self are in accordance with legislative employment policies and safety requirements and corporate policy

Promote a standard of excellence for quality and customer focus at Alere.

Comply with Abbott’s policies and procedures

Abide by Abbott Culture & Performance policies.

KEY BEHAVIORS

Develops Talent

Manages Talent : Manages, develops, and coaches talent to consistently achieve Commercial results.

Provides Direction: Provides timely feedback and support to optimize performance.

Drives for Results

Accountability: Acts ethically and within Alere’s code of conduct. In addition, creates personal and team accountability in an open and transparent manner.

Fosters Collaboration

Communication : Establishes open communication and articulates multiple viewpoints with emotional intelligence

Focuses on Customers

Customer Knowledge: Understands customer requirements, expectations, and needs to drive competitive advantage and sustainable value.

Industry Knowledge: Correlates industry insights, understands the levers to facilitate customer decision making and transcend the business need

MINIMUM BACKGROUND/ EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

Strategic / Technical / Operational

Capable of developing short/medium/long term sales and marketing strategies across diverse customer markets, implement and drive those strategies to success.

Ability to comprehend and conversant with and able to impart highly detailed medical / scientific terminologies and patient outcome concepts.

Capable of monitoring market, customer and competitor trends and advising management on methods to improve company competitiveness in respective markets.

Be able to train and develop distribution channel to establish and maintain the ability to effectively represent Alere products in the marketplace. 

Ability to develop project plans, timelines, and priorities critical programs and elements necessary to achieve the Sales & Marketing objectives by working together with distribution partners in its territories. 

Proven ability to work with stakeholders.

People management 

Ability to recruit and manage sales, marketing and functional team.

Internal systems and processes

Ability to identify and qualify new commercial portfolio in respective market in aligned with corporate’s overall direction.

Ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team environment, with a variety of internal departments with business partners.

Customers and external stakeholders

Customer service oriented and organized.

Ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team environment, with a variety of internal departments with business partners.

Appreciation and understanding of a culturally diverse organization particularly in relation to building relationships and establishing a supportive environment.

Financial

Ability to analyze and report on the status and success of the given budget.

Communication 

Strong communication and presentation skills and a thorough knowledge various international cultures.

MINIMUM EDUCATION REQUIRED

Bachelor’s Degree required, preferably in Biology, Chemistry, Laboratory science or equivalent.

+ 10 years of Sales & Marketing experience in IVD industry (exposed to lateral flow/instrument business desirable)

Proven excellence in both written and oral communication in English and/or in local language for its respective country

Post-Graduate qualifications in Marketing or Business.

Solid understanding of the IVD (preferably POC) market in the region.

Our preferences will fall into his or her in-depth work experiences & knowledge skills in Infectious Disease related IVD business which well fit in Abbott Rapid Diagnostics Core Business Area. 

In country experience managing sales and distribution infrastructure for healthcare products.

Start Up

Core level Abbott certification and/or equivalent level proficiency

Educate site on tools to facilitate compliance.

Escalate non-compliant sites according to corporate policy.

2 + years of progressively more responsible relevant clinical trial experience in the cardiovascular field. 

Competency in catheterizaion lab and operating room protocol and procedures.

Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. The role leads the commercial team for the Digital Health Solution Business. The role involves building a clear strategy to profitably grow market share and revenue, meeting or exceeding plan commitments, and collaborating with other functions

Position Summary

The role is responsible for the commercial execution, strategic, financial, and operational leadership of a fast growing Multi-million Digital Health Solutions (DHS) business and corresponding portfolio within the APAC region. This position oversees full P&L accountability, drives sustainable growth, and ensures the successful commercialization and adoption of digital health products and services. The leader will guide a cross-functional organization, cultivate high-performing teams, and strengthen customer relationships to deliver measurable business results.

Establish and sustain a profitable, high-growth Digital Health Solutions business across the APAC region.

Drive continuous improvement in customer satisfaction, operational performance, and financial outcomes.

Accelerate the adoption of digital health technologies that create measurable value for customers and advance the organization’s strategic objectives.

Major Accountabilities

Strategic & Financial Leadership

Oversee the full P&L and business, ensuring operational excellence and the achievement of Gross Margin and Division Margin targets through disciplined financial management and continuous performance optimization.

Develop, communicate, and execute an annual strategic business plan aligned with sales, margin, and profitability commitments.

Proactively identify market opportunities and competitive dynamics to shape long-term portfolio strategy and enhance market positioning.

Team Leadership & Organizational Development

Lead a regional organization composed of direct and dotted-line reports; ensure teams are equipped with the training, tools, and resources required to deliver exceptional performance.

Foster a high-performance culture that emphasizes accountability, innovation, continuous improvement, and customer-centric execution.

Recruit, develop, and retain top talent to build organizational capability and succession depth across the region.

Commercial Execution & Customer Engagement

Identify evolving customer needs and guide teams in demonstrating the strategic and economic value of informatics solutions to healthcare, laboratory, and diagnostic customers.

Drive demand generation by identifying new customer-centric products, services, and digital solutions that increase revenue, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction.

Participate regularly in field travel to assess market conditions, strengthen key customer relationships, and provide coaching and support to regional teams.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Innovation

Collaborate closely with product management, R&D, finance, service, and other stakeholders to evaluate the feasibility, value, and commercialization potential of new or customized digital health offerings.

Engage routinely with cross-functional and regional leaders to ensure effective alignment between corporate strategy, regional priorities, and operational execution.

Support the development of business cases, ROI models, and innovative commercial structures to drive adoption of SaaS-based digital health products.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree required.

Master’s degree in business, engineering, informatics, or related discipline preferred.

Extensive experience leading and executing complex, multi-year, multi-stakeholder contract negotiations.

Advanced knowledge of the APAC digital health market, including interoperability and communication frameworks across lab middleware, LIMS, and EMR ecosystems.

Deep expertise in laboratory workflow processes, informatics solutions, and communication interfaces within diagnostic environments.

Demonstrated experience in ROI development for medical SaaS products and understanding of SaaS billing models, contract structures, and commercial deployment strategies.

10+ years of progressive leadership experience in healthcare, digital health, diagnostics, or related industries with a proven ability to align cross-functional teams to achieve shared business outcomes.

Documented record of gaining market share, expanding markets, and successfully renewing or defending strategic business relationships.

Strong sales acumen within the diagnostic industry, with a proven ability to drive revenue growth and customer adoption.

职位目标 Job Purpose:

In order to support the construction of the company's equipment maintenance management system, the digitalization of maintenance processes and the promotion of technology standardization, assist engineering and technical managers to carry out the technical management and on-site maintenance execution of the whole life cycle of equipment, and ensure the stable and efficient operation of production equipment; By implementing equipment inspection, preventive maintenance, fault handling, data recording and process execution, improve the comprehensive efficiency of equipment and reduce downtime losses; At the same time, it cooperates with the completion of spare parts management, instrumentation calibration, and new equipment maintenance system implementation, providing front-line technical implementation and support for the efficient operation of the company's equipment management system and the achievement of production and operation goals.

主要工作职责 Key Responsibilities:

Participate in the diagnosis, repair, and emergency handling of mechanical and electrical failures on production equipment, ensuring stable equipment operation. Execute routine maintenance tasks and strengthen on‑site operational maintenance fundamentals.

Support the Engineering & Technical Manager in building and improving the company’s equipment maintenance management system. Actively participate in the development, execution, and optimization of PM (Preventive Maintenance) plans, and facilitate the scientific transition from PM to AM (Autonomous Maintenance), ensuring the implementation of standardized maintenance workflows.

Participate in the company’s lean production initiatives, supporting the implementation and training of the Lean 14‑step methodology and the Six Systems. Provide lean improvement suggestions from the equipment maintenance perspective to enhance operational efficiency and management performance.

Support maintenance digital transformation, including equipment maintenance data collection, reporting, and analysis. Drive KPI tracking, spare‑parts digital management, and dynamic inventory control. Assist in defining and executing equipment failure classifications (Critical/Major/Middle/Minor).

Focus on key equipment maintenance performance indicators, monitoring and analyzing MTTR, MTBF, and repeat failure data. Identify weak components and establish targeted management strategies to develop data‑driven maintenance optimization solutions.

Take responsibility for the plant‑wide calibration of instruments and meters. Explore and apply digital methods for calibration process tracking, data retention, and issue closure, ensuring calibration accuracy and compliance.

Perform installation and validation tasks for replacement equipment, draft equipment maintenance SOPs, and develop maintenance documentation for new equipment/production lines. Contribute to the enhancement of the standardized maintenance framework and promote process standardization and traceability.

Support the department in consolidating maintenance experience and developing standardized documentation. Participate in the implementation and application of digital O&M (Operations & Maintenance) tools, and complete additional maintenance system optimization or digital transformation tasks assigned by the manager.

任职条件Qualifications:

Associate degree or above, majoring in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Automation, Mechatronics, or related fields.

5–8 years of experience as an Equipment Maintenance Engineer, with solid electro‑mechanical maintenance capabilities. Proficient in reading electrical schematics, skilled in basic PLC programming and debugging, and experienced in troubleshooting electrical components such as inverters and sensors. Able to independently resolve complex issues in integrated electromechanical equipment.

Familiar with equipment maintenance management systems, with hands‑on experience implementing PM / PM‑to‑AM processes. Knowledgeable in statistical and analytical methods for key O&M indicators such as MTTR and MTBF.

Experience in lean production initiatives, with understanding of the Lean 14‑step methodology and the AM Six Systems. Capable of driving lean improvements from the perspective of equipment operations and maintenance.

Experience with maintenance digitalization projects, including participation in equipment management system implementation and maintenance data digitalization. Possess basic data collection, statistical, and analytical skills.

Hands‑on experience with instrument calibration, capable of independently performing calibration operations and completing data recording tasks.

Strong problem‑solving ability, execution capability, and pressure resilience, able to respond quickly to on‑site maintenance needs with strong logical thinking.

Strong teamwork and communication skills, willing to consolidate maintenance experience into standardized documentation. Proficient in Excel (data analysis), PowerPoint, and other office software.

Kom bij ons team als Allround Monteur in een 5-ploegendienst!

 

Wat ga je doen?

Stap in een technisch uitdagende en complexe omgeving binnen onze fabriek, waar je nauw samenwerkt met collega-monteurs en operators. Jij bent dé specialist van de productieploeg voor preventief en correctief onderhoud aan de lijn. Jouw bijdrage is cruciaal voor de betrouwbaarheid van onze technische bedrijfsinstallaties.

 

Past jouw profiel niet helemaal bij wat wij vragen? Geen probleem! Solliciteer toch, zodat we jou kunnen helpen met jouw ontwikkeling!

Wat worden je belangrijkste taken en verantwoordelijkheden?

Preventief onderhoud uitvoeren aan bedrijfsinstallaties tijdens geplande stilstanden.

Verstoringen verhelpen in zowel mechanische als elektrotechnische disciplines na melding van de interne klant, en aangeven hoeveel tijd nodig is om de problemen op te lossen.

Dagelijks storingen en onderhoudswerkzaamheden registreren in het onderhoudssysteem en benodigde onderhoudslijsten uitdraaien.

Communiceren met lijnoperators en ploegenmonteurs over lopende zaken en de Technical Specialist ondersteunen bij Rootcause Analyse op technisch vlak.

Aanbevelingen doen voor Demand Maintenance of optimalisatie aan de Technical Specialist op basis van analyses van technische storingen.

Samenwerken met andere monteurs en zorgen voor een goede werkverdeling en overdracht van taken.

Initiatief nemen en voorstellen doen voor verbeteringen van apparatuur of onderhoudsprogramma’s ten behoeve van kwaliteit en efficiency.

Contractors en externe specialisten begeleiden.

Toezicht houden op de naleving van bedrijfs- en veiligheidsvoorschriften.

Actief de tijd benutten om machines en apparatuur te observeren met als doel optimalisatie.

 

Wat zoeken wij?

Een MBO-opleiding richting Elektronica/Mechatronica of een vergelijkbare opleiding op niveau 4.

Ruime ervaring binnen een productieomgeving, bij voorkeur in de voedsel- en/of farmaceutische industrie.

Ruime kennis en werkervaring op een van de technische vakgebieden (mechanisch, elektrisch of besturing (PLC)) en in staat om vrijwel alle complexe storingen zelfstandig op te lossen. VCA-gecertificeerd.

Een echte vakman/vrouw die zich bewust is van de hoge eisen die aan onderhoud worden gesteld in deze industrie.

Open en duidelijke communicatie, leergierig, flexibel en stressbestendig.

 

Wat hebben wij jou te bieden?

Een goed salaris.

Een Individueel Keuzebudget (IKB) met vakantietoeslag, 13e maand, bijzonder verlof en extra vakantiedagen.

 

Hoe solliciteer je?

Ben je geïnteresseerd in deze vacature en herken je jezelf in het bovenstaande profiel? Solliciteer dan met je CV en motivatie via onze website. Voor meer informatie kun je contact opnemen met Meltem Cakir, Recruiter, via recruitment.netherlands@abbott.com. Onderdeel van onze selectieprocedure is het nagaan van referenties en het overleggen van een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag. Daarnaast kan een assessment center onderdeel uitmaken van het sollicitatieproces.We kijken uit naar je sollicitatie!

Mission Principale:
Le Directeur Régional est chargé de gérer et de développer les comptes existants de la région, de consolider la relation client, d'améliorer la rentabilité des comptes, de d’assurer des renouvellements de contrats et de prendre en charge la coordination du support technique, scientifique et consulting des équipes pluridisciplinaires, en encadrant une équipe dans le respect des procédures et politiques internes.

Principales Responsabilités:

Construit une équipe performante. Encadre et développe les Ambassadeurs pour concevoir des plans de croissance/plans de territoire stratégiques axés sur la perspicacité, qui se traduisent par la croissance de l’entreprise et la réalisation des objectifs.

Enseigne à et encadre son équipe d’Ambassadeurs pour créer de la valeur en continu qui se traduit par le renouvellement des clients, la création d’activités supplémentaires et l’établissement d’une forte fidélité à la marque.

Comprend les tendances des soins de santé et identifie les nouvelles opportunités qui offrent une valeur supplémentaire. Devient un conseiller de confiance en améliorant la satisfaction client.

Transmet et assure la compréhension par son équipe des comptes clients, de leurs besoins, des parties prenantes et des situations concurrentielles.

Contrôle la réalisation des plans d'actions sectoriels. Analyse les écarts avec le collaborateur, définit des actions correctives puis s'assure de leur mise en oeuvre.

Met en place et conduit un plan stratégique afin d'atteindre ses objectifs en incluant le développement des comptes clients existants.

S’assure que chaque Ambassadeur élabore chaque année un plan de croissance stratégique complet au niveau de son territoire

Priorise un travail hebdomadaire avec les clients VIP, du responsable du laboratoire à la C-Suite.

Soutient le renouvellement des activités existantes, avec le propriétaire du compte (AMB) et l’équipe Acquisition, au début du processus, empêchant efficacement la concurrence d’entrer dans le compte.

Travaille avec le client C-Suite pour s’assurer que la solution Abbott fonctionne comme prévu.

Identifie les opportunités de développement des clients de sa région au travers de la vente de molécules additionnelles, de la vente de solutions de service et du respect des contrats afin d'accroître la part de marché de la Division

Examine et analyse avec les Ambassadeurs le menu de tests et les modèles de commande pour évaluer les lacunes du processus chez le client et encadrer le développement de stratégies pour combler ces lacunes.

Veille à ce que les solutions Alinity, Hématologie et Solutions Digitales soient utilisées par un C-Suite dans chaque compte.

S’assure que son équipe développe des relations avec toutes les parties prenantes chez le client : Responsable informatique, Directeur Médical, Directeur financier, Directeur général..

Une formation supérieure Bac+3/5 spécialisée Biologie ou Commerce ou équivalent

Expérience de 5 ans minimum en vente de matériel médical et en management.

Expérience significative dans la gestion de comptes clients.

Très bonnes aptitudes à coordonner une équipe directe et transverse dans les missions de service technique (installation et maintenance d'automates).

Excellente compréhension de l'environnement économique, de la concurrence et des principaux acteurs.

Excellente aptitude à la vente et à la promotion de solutions (Automates, produits et Services).

Bonne maitrise de l'Anglais.

About Abbott

Abbott is a global healthcare leader, creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology.

Working at Abbott

Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.

The Opportunity 

This position works out of our Costa Rica – Alajuela location in the EP Division. In Abbott’s Electrophysiology (EP) business, we’re advancing the treatment of heart disease through breakthrough medical technologies in atrial fibrillation, allowing people to restore their health and get on with their lives.

The SR Process Development Engineer demonstrates a high level of technical independence and provides mentorship to junior engineers. Designs, develops, and optimizes manufacturing processes that ensure medical devices are produced safely, efficiently, cost effectivly and in compliance with regulatory standards. The position translates product designs into scalable, robust manufacturing processes that meet quality, cost, and delivery targets.

What You’ll Do 

Highly experienced and knowledgeable resource within the organization on designing and developing manufacturing processes for novel and existing life sciences products, taking into consideration problems inherent in the transfer of technology from development to production.

Identifies and mitigates risks associated to equipment technical knowledge, process under development

Conducts tests, measurements, process characterizations, process validations, and inspection validations throughout stages of development and production to determine controls over applicable variables and confirm expected process outputs and product requirements are met.

Prepares product and process reports by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing information results and drawing conclusions and providing recommendations related to processes, equipment, tools and product performance

Work closely with R&D, Quality, Manufacturing, and Supply Chain teams to support product development and scale-up.

Improve existing processes to enhance yield, reduce cost, and increase reliability.

Apply Lean, Six Sigma, and statistical tools to facilitate decision making and to draw conclusions from available data.

Design and execute experiments (DOE), analyze data, and present findings to cross-functional teams.

Evaluate, recommend and or implement new technological equipment, automation and/or materials.

Identifies, selects, and purchases equipment/fixtures according to development requirements.

Understands product cost components and its interactions, (direct & indirect material costs, MUV, labor, overhead). Uses product cost knowledge to identify risks and opportunities.

Performs installation/validation activities for new or existing production lines, meeting regulatory requirements. That includes equipment, process, product and test method validations.

Coordinate the creation and implementation of equipment specifications and drawings following company policies.

Has knowledge on product requirements and specifications, understanding potential risks related to product malfunctions.

Create and maintain technical documentation including SOPs, risk assessments, validation protocols, and safety instructions.

Develop and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs)

Provide technical training and mentorship to technicians and junior engineers.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree in technical engineering (Mechanical; Electrical; Electronical; Electromechanics; Materials; Chemical).

7+ years of working experience on similar roles as manufacturing engineer (sustaining) or process engineer.

Ability to work independently and collaboratively in cross-functional teams in a fast-paced, changing environment.

Excellent communication and presentation skills.

Excellent command of the English language, both spoken and written, to effectively communicate in a professional and technical environment.

Demonstrated experience in process development within a regulated manufacturing environment, including the design, validation, and implementation of robust manufacturing processes to support product lifecycle and continuous improvement initiatives

Proficiency in technical writing and documentation.

Experience in process characterization and method validation activities.

Strong analytical a problem-solving skills. Experience with continuous improvement methodologies such as lean manufacturing techniques, value stream mapping, or similar.

Proficient in statistical techniques such as Design of Experiments (DOE), Statistical Process Control (SPC), and data analysis using Minitab or equivalent software.

Knowledge of FDA, GMP, and ISO guidelines is required.

Multitasks, prioritizes and meets deadlines in timely manner. Strong organizational and follow-up skills, as well as attention to detail.

Willing to travel

SHIFT

Admin (Monday to Friday 8:00 am to 5:00 pm).

Works 100% on site

Preferred Qualifications

5 years of prior experience in PD in medical devices manufacturing.

Experience with computer-aided design (CAD) software such as SolidWorks or equivalent.

The Opportunity 

This position works out of our Lake Forest IL location in the Core Diagnostics Division.

We’re empowering smarter medical and economic decision-making to help transform the way people manage their health at all stages of life. Every day, more than 10 million tests are run on Abbott’s diagnostics instruments, providing lab results for millions of people.

Our diagnostic solutions are used in hospitals, laboratories, and clinics around the globe. The crucial information derived from our tests, instruments, and informatics systems is often the first step in patient care decision-making for hundreds of health conditions from heart attacks to blood disorders to infectious diseases and cancers.

What You’ll Work On

Our location in Lake County, IL, currently has an opportunity for a Finance Supervisor – US Commercial. This team member is responsible for assisting with all Core Lab FP&A Planning and Monthly Actuals Reporting processes for a $300 million sales channel, providing direct financial support for the US Commercial team and interfacing directly with Sales Directors and Area DVP to accomplish goals/tasks. This position works independently and collaborates with the Finance and business teams. This role is integral to the preparation and review of Plan, LBE (Latest Best Estimate) and Integrated Business Plan (IBP), as well as monthly close process and will be called upon to adapt to changes in the business environment and/or commercial strategy, implementing solutions to meet the needs of the management team. Additionally, the Supervisor will need to focus on understanding the product offerings, business dynamics, as well as establishing efficient processes and tools to effectively analyze and support new business opportunities.

WHAT YOU’LL DO 

Partner with the commercial teams to create and maintain sales forecasts for the annual Plan, monthly IBPs, and quarterly LBEs. This includes coordinating regular meetings with business teams, consolidation of regional data, challenging assumptions, and using professional judgement to create a forecast. 

Own the P&L for assigned areas, including gross-to-net sales adjustments, customer rebate accruals, price/volume/mix analytics, and expense analysis. Investigate any significant variances and look for opportunities to improve margin. 

Collaborate with Commercial Excellence to understand pipeline, forecast revenue and P&L, understand and challenge key assumptions. Identify and communicate any gaps or issues in achieving targets. 

IBP and LBE system load submissions and tie out for sales and product cost for Total USO.

Develop ad-hoc business analysis and present recommendations to non-finance business partners.

Provide financial expertise and business decision support in evaluating and identifying the key issues and gaps in business performance and emerging business needs, deliver analyses that provide a foundation for management understanding and action.

Maintain and develop system solutions and process improvements that meet the needs of the financial planning & reporting requirements.

Facilitate the monthly area close process and resolution of close issues, including Tracks accounting, instrument sales margin, etc.

Ensure appropriate integrity and reasonableness of financial data as well as compliance with Corporate & Division financial policies and procedures.

Responsible for adherence to Abbott accounting policies and procedures (CFMs) and Sarbanes Oxley requirements.

Meet timing and quality standards to facilitate effective senior management review and decision-making.

This role is involved in special projects with the Finance Director and other members of the commercial team and is expected to proactively look for ways to improve the planning and reporting processes.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree, preferably in finance or accounting or an equivalent combination of education and work experience. 

Five or more years of financial experience demonstrating a progressive level of responsibility.

Preferred Qualifications

Demonstrated ability to provide data and analysis to support decision making, methodical approach to problem solving and rational ideas supporting them, ability to keep learning and to teach others, traditional accounting knowledge and facilitator of management needs, streamlining functions within the department. 

Master’s degree/CPA.

High proficiency in Microsoft office suite, primarily Microsoft Excel and Power Point.

Proficiency in TM1, Cognos and SAP are a plus.

Ability to operate independently with broad scope of responsibility under minimal supervision and under challenging time constraints. 

Oral and written ability to communicate clearly, concisely and accurately with all levels of the organization. 

Ability to facilitate interpretation and understanding of data, identify risks, develop recommendations and implement solutions.

When you join Abbott EP, you become part of a passionate group of individuals who are dedicated to driving the EP space forward and helping people live longer, fuller lives. We are committed to building a foundation for our people to be successful, investing in their development and growth, and creating a diverse, inclusive culture that welcomes different perspectives, experiences and backgrounds. 

What You’ll Work On

Working under general direction, provides engineering, sales, educational and technical support in response to field inquiries from physicians, health care professionals, patients, and field sales staff, involving EP products. Performs work that involves a high degree of independence. Identifies and routinely uses the most effective, cost efficient and best business practices to execute processes; continually evaluates their effectiveness and appropriateness. Exercises independent judgment in planning, organizing and performing work; monitors performance and reports status to manager. 

As a Clinical Associate on the U.S. Abbott EP team, you will provide clinical and technical support in a hospital setting, utilizing EP technology in the treatment of various cardiac arrhythmias. You will join a high-functioning, collaborative team, partnering closely with physicians and hospital staff to support the diagnosis and treatment of abnormal heart rhythms to achieve better patient outcomes. In this role, individuals will exercise independent judgment in planning, organizing, and performing day-to-day tasks. You will identify and routinely use the most effective, cost-efficient, and best business practices to execute processes, regularly communicating insights, feedback, and results to managers and team. Gaining foundational knowledge of EP through a structured training program with a strong emphasis on hands-on learning and practical application. 

Providing regional EP procedural case coverage in an Electrophysiology lab and/or operating room setting. 

Acting as a clinical interface between the medical community and the business. 

Demonstrating the ability to build and sustain credible clinical relationships with customers and sharing product expertise accordingly. 

Demonstrating a thorough command of all EP products, including technical details, software utilization, and capabilities. 

Providing engineering, sales, education, and clinical support on the safe and effective use of Abbott EP products, including cardiac mapping, diagnostic, and therapy systems. 

Supporting EP Sales Representatives in the following areas: 

Collaborating with sales personnel; 

Facilitating regional training seminars; 

Participating in clinical studies/data collection; 

Troubleshooting; and, 

Leading/supporting new product in-service trainings and/or demonstrations to physicians, nurses, and sales representatives. 

Continuously develops engineering, sales and technical skills aligned with the overall territory strategy, including learning from senior sales personnel and management. 

Staying up-to-date on the latest industry developments, regulatory requirements, and maintains strong knowledge of company and competitor products, market trends, and strategic goals.

Participating in occasional travel for in-person instruction and live procedure coverage.

Senior Specialist, Benefits

The Opportunity

Own day-to-day retiree health operations, ensuring accurate eligibility, seamless service delivery, and clear, consistent retiree communications.

Support Open Enrollment (OE) strategy and execution across active and retiree populations.

Lead case management research and resolution, partnering across HRTS, HRSC, Payroll, and Businessolver (outsourced benefits administration vendor).

Manage benefit related invoices, driving accuracy, timeliness, and issue resolution.

Provide communications support for retiree and active benefit programs, including reviewing, coordinating, and maintaining accurate, accessible benefit content across internal and external channels.

Contribute to special projects including M&A activities.

What You’ll Do

Manage day-to-day retiree health operations, including post65 Medicare offerings, eligibility updates, and ongoing retiree communications.

Lead case management research and issue resolution, ensuring timely, accurate responses and strong documentation in partnership with Businessolver, carriers, and other vendor partners.

Support OE strategy, readiness, testing, and execution for active and retiree populations; document issues, monitor defects, and follow through to resolution.

Analyze, consolidate, and roll up plan utilization data from ben admin, carriers, and point solution vendors into clear dashboards and insight summaries for leadership, QBRs, and continuous improvement.

Evaluate vendor performance using a comprehensive, data driven approach (financials, utilization trends, quality indicators, and member feedback) and recommend improvements or corrective actions.

Coordinate and schedule largescale benefits events and cross functional presentations to enhance program understanding.

Manage Level 1 administrative appeals in collaboration with Businessolver and internal Legal partners; ensure accurate, compliant recommendations.

Support survey and benchmarking requests; assist with project plans and coordinate execution of benefits initiatives.

Review, reconcile, and validate benefit related invoices; investigate variances; coordinate corrections with vendors, HRIS, Payroll, and Businessolver to ensure accurate, timely payment.

Maintain operational controls, documentation, and reporting to ensure accuracy, compliance, and a seamless employee/retiree experience.

Oversee data integrity across systems; expedite root cause analysis and coordinate remediation with HRIS, HRSC, Payroll, and Businessolver.

Lead the review, coordination, and maintenance of retiree and benefit program communications across internal and external platforms, ensuring accuracy, clarity, and alignment with vendor partners.

Key Responsibilities

Retiree Health Operations

Day-to-day oversight of retiree health programs, including post65 Medicare offerings and eligibility management.

Coordinate retiree communications and ensure content remains current and accurate.

Case Management & Issue Resolution

Lead case research and resolution, ensuring comprehensive documentation and coordinated stakeholder alignment (HRIS, HRSC, Payroll, Businessolver, and vendors).

Track issues/defects, drive root cause remediation, and document corrective actions.

Utilization & Performance Insights

Aggregate and roll up plan utilization information across Businessolver and point solution vendors (active and retiree).

Build recurring dashboards/scorecards and prepare insight packs for QBRs, leadership reviews, and continuous improvement.

Translate utilization trends into actionable recommendations (plan design levers, vendor action plans, member communications).

Open Enrollment (OE) Support

Support active and retiree OE preparation, testing, documentation review, issue tracking, and hypercare activities.

Monitor configuration readiness with Businessolver and validate post deployment outcomes.

M&A and Special Projects

Support due diligence, data gathering, and integration tasks; coordinate vendor actions and timelines.

Contribute to project plans, status tracking, and risk/issue management.

Communications

Lead oversight of the vendor communication inventory and ensure all benefit content remains accurate, current, and aligned with program requirements.

Coordinate communication updates across Businessolver, HRTS , HRSC, Payroll, and benefit vendors to ensure consistency and clarity.

Manage periodic team reviews of benefit information across internal and external websites, retiree portals, and vendor platforms.

Support creation, refinement, and delivery of benefit communications for retiree notifications, OE periods, plan updates, and special projects.

Operational Excellence & Controls

Maintain dashboards and reporting for eligibility, utilization, and service metrics.

Oversee data integrity controls and issue remediation SLAs across vendors.

Manage invoice reconciliation and validation processes, ensuring accurate billing, timely resolution of discrepancies, and alignment with Finance, Payroll, HRIS, and vendors.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree is required.

4–6 years of experience in benefits operations with exposure to retiree programs, Medicare, and benefits vendor management

Knowledge of and hands-on experience with Medicare and Medicare Advantage programs.

Experience in supporting Open Enrollment delivery and M&A activities.

Proficiency with advanced Excel functions and analytical tools.

Strong expertise in health & welfare plans, vendor administration, and project coordination.

Experience working with providers and/or vendors, including account and contract support.

Ability to work effectively both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, changing environment.

Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and professional speaking skills.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

Scientific /Medical Writer:
Role Overview
The Medical Writer is an essential individual contributor within the Clinical Science Team
responsible for independently authoring high-quality clinical documents—particularly Module
2.5 (Clinical Overview) and Module 2.7 (Clinical Summary)—for global regulatory
submissions.
This role collaborates closely with Clinical Directors across multiple therapeutic areas to
ensure scientifically sound, compliant, and timely delivery of clinical modules that support
regulatory approvals.
Core Responsibilities
Authoring Clinical Modules
• Independently author, update, and finalize Modules 2.5 and 2.7 for global regulatory
submissions in alignment with company standards, ICH guidelines, and agency
expectations.
• Ensure documents accurately reflect the clinical strategy and scientific position of
each therapeutic area as defined by respective Clinical Directors.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
• Work closely with Clinical Directors and Clinical Science Team from multiple therapy
areas to gather input, verify scientific interpretations, and align on key narrative
elements within the clinical modules.
• Serve as the primary scientific writer responsible for integrating cross-functional
feedback into cohesive, submission-ready documents.
Planning & Documentation Strategy
• Review clinical development timelines and proactively plan medical writing activities
to meet critical submission milestones.
• Advise team members on documentation requirements and identify process
efficiencies.

Regulatory Submission Support
• Prepare or coordinate completion of clinical components of registration dossiers and
ensure consistency across all clinical documents, particularly following database
updates or clinical strategy modifications.
• Support Clinical Directors in preparing responses to Health Authority queries related
to authored clinical modules.
Compliance & Standards
• Maintain up-to-date knowledge of clinical documentation expectations of major
Health Authorities especially knowledge of key EM markets and changing landscape.
• Communicate potential impacts of changing guidelines or templates to the Manager
and functional leadership.
• Act as a Subject Matter Expert in clinical documentation processes and tools,
contributing to implementation of new systems or process enhancements.
NEW: Strategic Planning with Global Labeling
• Work closely with the Global Labeling team to develop an annual plan for clinical
documentation needed to support product renewals, safety updates, and regulatory
maintenance activities for clinical.
• Define strategic priorities and timelines for required updates to Modules 2.5 and 2.7
and ensure alignment with labeling objectives, lifecycle management plans, and
regulatory commitments.
• Proactively identify upcoming needs for dossier updates based on changes in clinical
data, labeling negotiations, or evolving regulatory expectations.
Additional Responsibilities
• Independently prepare and/or coordinate time-critical clinical reports and regulatory
documents supporting the planning, conduct, and reporting of clinical studies.
• Ensure that the scientific narrative reflects the clinical viewpoint established by the
Clinical Directors and departmental leadership.

Liaise with external partners (CROs, co-development partners, affiliates) and internal
teams (data management, biostats, publishing) to ensure accuracy and
completeness of tables, figures, and appendices.
Required Knowledge & Skills
• Minimum 5 years of industry experience as a Medical Writer, with a strong track
record in developing major clinical submission documents.
• Proven ability to author clear, accurate, scientifically robust clinical documentation,
including complex or high-visibility documents.
• Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple
deliverables under tight timelines.
• High proficiency in Microsoft Word and comfort working in electronic document
management systems.
• Excellent written and spoken English.
Education & Experience
• Advanced scientific degree (Master’s, PhD, PharmD, MD, or equivalent).
• At least 3 years of medical writing in relevant clinical submission / module
development.
• Strong understanding of clinical development methodology, clinical study operations,
statistics, and regulatory frameworks.
Desirable
• Familiarity with therapeutic areas relevant to the company pipeline.
• Experience collaborating with Global Labeling or Regulatory Affairs teams.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

Kom bij ons team als Allround Monteur in een 5-ploegendienst!

 

Wat ga je doen?

Stap in een technisch uitdagende en complexe omgeving binnen onze fabriek, waar je nauw samenwerkt met collega-monteurs en operators. Jij bent dé specialist van de productieploeg voor preventief en correctief onderhoud aan de lijn. Jouw bijdrage is cruciaal voor de betrouwbaarheid van onze technische bedrijfsinstallaties.

 

Past jouw profiel niet helemaal bij wat wij vragen? Geen probleem! Solliciteer toch, zodat we jou kunnen helpen met jouw ontwikkeling!

Wat worden je belangrijkste taken en verantwoordelijkheden?

Preventief onderhoud uitvoeren aan bedrijfsinstallaties tijdens geplande stilstanden.

Verstoringen verhelpen in zowel mechanische als elektrotechnische disciplines na melding van de interne klant, en aangeven hoeveel tijd nodig is om de problemen op te lossen.

Dagelijks storingen en onderhoudswerkzaamheden registreren in het onderhoudssysteem en benodigde onderhoudslijsten uitdraaien.

Communiceren met lijnoperators en ploegenmonteurs over lopende zaken en de Technical Specialist ondersteunen bij Rootcause Analyse op technisch vlak.

Aanbevelingen doen voor Demand Maintenance of optimalisatie aan de Technical Specialist op basis van analyses van technische storingen.

Samenwerken met andere monteurs en zorgen voor een goede werkverdeling en overdracht van taken.

Initiatief nemen en voorstellen doen voor verbeteringen van apparatuur of onderhoudsprogramma’s ten behoeve van kwaliteit en efficiency.

Contractors en externe specialisten begeleiden.

Toezicht houden op de naleving van bedrijfs- en veiligheidsvoorschriften.

Actief de tijd benutten om machines en apparatuur te observeren met als doel optimalisatie.

 

Wat zoeken wij?

Een MBO-opleiding richting Elektronica/Mechatronica of een vergelijkbare opleiding op niveau 4.

Ruime ervaring binnen een productieomgeving, bij voorkeur in de voedsel- en/of farmaceutische industrie.

Ruime kennis en werkervaring op een van de technische vakgebieden (mechanisch, elektrisch of besturing (PLC)) en in staat om vrijwel alle complexe storingen zelfstandig op te lossen. VCA-gecertificeerd.

Een echte vakman/vrouw die zich bewust is van de hoge eisen die aan onderhoud worden gesteld in deze industrie.

Open en duidelijke communicatie, leergierig, flexibel en stressbestendig.

 

Wat hebben wij jou te bieden?

Een goed salaris.

Een Individueel Keuzebudget (IKB) met vakantietoeslag, 13e maand, bijzonder verlof en extra vakantiedagen.

 

Hoe solliciteer je?

Ben je geïnteresseerd in deze vacature en herken je jezelf in het bovenstaande profiel? Solliciteer dan met je CV en motivatie via onze website. Voor meer informatie kun je contact opnemen met Meltem Cakir, Recruiter, via recruitment.netherlands@abbott.com. Onderdeel van onze selectieprocedure is het nagaan van referenties en het overleggen van een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag. Daarnaast kan een assessment center onderdeel uitmaken van het sollicitatieproces.We kijken uit naar je sollicitatie!

Job Description

Field Service Engineer - EIMEA – India – Coimbatore

SUMMARY:

Accuray EIMEA is searching for a Field Service Engineer, home-office based in Coimbatore region (India).

The person in this position has front-line responsibility for installations, remote and on-site diagnostics prior to repair services as well as preventive maintenance visits on Accuray systems, primarily to Accuray customers located regionally but occasionally throughout all EIMEA Region.

The successful candidate must have proven ability to diagnose and resolve problems on highly sophisticated software, electronic and mechanical robotic devices at clinical sites and major hospitals. Applicants must have the ability to work independently and have effective communication skills.

Field Service engineers may also work hours other than a traditional daytime shift and may also work weekend days as part of their normal workdays with limited notice due to the emergent nature of service work. Regular work schedules are determined by a combination of Accuray’s service obligations and customer service needs and are subject to change as needs arise.

REPORTING TO/DEPARTMENT: 

Deputy Service Manager India

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: 

PRODUCT SUPPORT 

Provide installation, repair and maintenance support to Accuray systems.

Support is provided to the customer remotely by phone, internet and by on-site visits, as determined by the machine status or customer requirements.

Promoting the highest level of customer satisfaction through the timely response to customer calls, clear and effective communications, professional appearance, and efficient repair/maintenance activities.

Self-management of schedule and work priorities to ensure that urgent customer requirements are addressed timely and customer satisfaction is optimized.

Accurate and clear documentation of work activities are to be completed within the Accuray Customer Management software program, such that these records provide appropriate documentation of the product service history for Device History File records.

Appropriate care of parts inventory and prompt return of replaced parts that are required to be returned to the Accuray stock for processing.

Appropriate management and timely completion of Timesheets and expense reports incurred in the field service of Accuray systems.

Assist in the development of service documentation, in conjunction with the Accuray Customer Service team.

Assist in the training of further Customer Support staff and customer on site personnel with respect to maintenance and service activities, as required.

Assist in identification and development of Field Support tools and test equipment.

Follow Company training as needed. (e.g., basic technical training of 6 weeks at Accuray Headquarters in the US).

Learn and apply all Accuray internal policies and processes.

Follow local regulations (such as radioprotection rules – attends and runs TUV Audits at customer).

PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT 

Provides feedback through the Madison Customer Service group for service-related product improvements that could improve Mean Time to Access (MTTA) and Mean Time to Repair (MTTR), or improvements in mean Time Between Failures (MTBF).

Assist in the development, documentation, and testing of service tools and design updates to the product.

Works effectively with other engineers, scientists, subcontractors, and consultants.

Support project team activities, with attendance at team meetings, representation of Field Service requirements, and provision of documentation as required.

SAFETY 

Observe Accuray Safety Program requirements and work practices.

Help ensure that safety requirements and quality considerations are pro-actively addressed and implemented in the design of the product.

Communicate to the Accuray corporate, or where possible directly address, quality issues raised by customers, in a timely fashion.

Supports the Accuray Quality System and Safety and Health Program by following procedures and mentoring others.

Takes ownership of individual safety to maintain a safe work environment.

The incumbent may be asked to perform other function-related activities in addition to the above-mentioned responsibilities as reasonably required by business needs.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

Minimum 3 years’ experience in field service, installation, and troubleshooting complex electronic equipment or bachelor’s degree in with less field experience considered. A basic understanding of medical physics is desirable.

Previous experience in large medical device field service strongly preferred.

Be a self-starter and work without close supervision, be able to successfully schedule, organize and conduct field service activities in assigned territory

Hands-on experience with electronic test equipment.

Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

Good H/W and S/W computer skills, including network knowledge. Ability to quickly learn to use new software tools.

Excellent customer relations skills and strong service orientation.

Team player - ability to work well in a close team environment.

Fluent reading, writing and speaking in local language and English.

Must be comfortable with extensive travel (up to 50% travel time), sometimes on short notice, and occasional after-hours support requirements.

Checks out and approves operational quality of system equipment. This role instructs customers in the operation and maintenance of the system and serves as company liaison with customer on administrative and technical matters for assigned projects. The FSE will interpret customers’ needs and clarifies if the responsibility for problem resolution falls to sales personnel, customer support reps, or engineers. This job may include any aspect of field support, and is not limited to system hardware and software, PCs, and networking/wireless networking. 

Location: This position will be Remote out of the Sacramento, CA surrounding area.

 

 

PRODUCT SUPPORT

 

· Provide installation, repair, upgrade, and maintenance support for TomoTherapy and CyberKnife systems located at assigned customer sites

· Promoting customer satisfaction through the timely response to customer calls, clear and effective communications with internal and external customers, professional appearance, and efficient repair/maintenance activities

· Maintain regular communication with direct manager, peer field personnel, and commercial team members for any customer matters requiring attention

· Self-management of schedule and work priorities to ensure that urgent customer requirements are addressed appropriately, and customer satisfaction is optimized

· Support is provided to the customer remotely by phone, internet and by onsite visits, as determined by the machine status or customer requirements Maintain complete and timely documentation of work activities

· Initial review of customer issues, such that customer concerns with product performance and safety are quickly communicated to Accuray for appropriate review and handling

· Assist in the training of other Customer Support staff, and customer or site personnel with respect to maintenance and service activities, as required

· Work with other FSEs and/or Customer Support Staff on CyberKnife or TomoTherapy products as required

· Appropriate care of parts inventory and prompt return of replaced parts that are required to be returned to Accuray for processing

· Appropriate management and timely completion of expense reports incurred in the field for customer service or company required travel and/or training

· Assist in the review and development of service documentation

· Assist in identification and development of field support tools and test equipment

· Maintain company vehicle (if provided) in accordance with Accuray fleet vehicle policy, including safe operations, vehicle cleanliness and vehicle maintenance

· Willing to travel up to 25% outside of assigned service area, sometimes with little notice

 

PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT

· Provides feedback for service-related product improvements

· Assist in the development, documentation, and testing of service tools and design updates to the product

· Support project team activities, with attendance at team meetings, representation of field service requirements

Qualifications:

a. Required:

· Minimum 5 years’ experience in field service, installation, and troubleshooting complex electronic equipment or bachelor’s degree in with less field experience considered

· Successful candidates will demonstrate an ability to be a self-starter and have the ability to work without close supervision, be able to successfully schedule, organize and conduct field service activities in assigned territory

· The demonstrated ability to communicate complex information to a wide range of audiences including executive level management

· Strong system level troubleshooting skills

· Strong computer skills with an understanding of basic networking

· Strong interpersonal and presentation skills

· Ability to lift up to 50 pounds and work in a physically active environment

b. Preferred or Desired:

· Previous experience in large medical device field service strongly preferred

· Former military experience a plus

Job Description

Are you driven by operational excellence and delivering quality products to your customers? Accuray is always looking for talented professionals to join our Production and Operations team. If you don’t see a current opening that fits your background, we encourage you to apply through this General Interest Pipeline. This will ensure you’re considered for future opportunities such as Material Handler, Test Technician, Production Technician, Traffic/Shipping Coordinator, and other various roles in Operations and Production that could align with your skills and career goals.

Why Work for Accuray?

At Accuray, we give hope through innovation. Our goal is to develop cutting-edge radiation therapy solutions that help people diagnosed with cancer get back to living their lives, faster—and every role contributes to this purpose.

We’re a team of passionate problem-solvers driven by the desire to make an impact. You’ll work in a collaborative, inclusive environment where your ideas—and your growth—matters.

We offer competitive benefits, flexible work options, and the chance to shape the future of healthcare with AI and advanced technologies.

Join us—and help give patients hope for more time to make memories that matter.

Various Operations roles we hire for:

Test Technician: Our Test Technicians ensure products meet quality and performance standards by conducting tests, troubleshooting issues, and documenting results. They work with technical drawings, electronic test equipment, and follow strict safety and regulatory guidelines. Key qualifications include a technical degree, hands-on experience in testing environments, and familiarity with tools like oscilloscopes and multimeters.

Material Handler:

Our Material Handlers support manufacturing and warehouse operations by efficiently moving, storing, and tracking materials and products. They are responsible for loading and unloading shipments, maintaining inventory accuracy, and ensuring materials are delivered to the right locations on time. Key qualifications include attention to detail, physical stamina, familiarity with inventory systems, and experience operating forklifts or other material handling equipment.

Production Technician:

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Senior ML Engineer to join the Firefly team within Adobe's Applied Science and Machine Learning (ASML) organization. Firefly is Adobe's family of creative generative AI models that power next-generation creative experiences across Adobe's products. In this role, you will work at the frontier of multimodal AI by starting from foundational models and adapting them for various real-world use cases and products. You will develop and build innovative generation pipelines, bring powerful research into production, and collaborate closely with research, product, and infrastructure teams to invent the future of AI-powered creativity.

What you'll Do

Foundational Model Development & Adaptation

Engage with large-scale pretrained models for multimodal generation (image, text, video, and beyond) and tailor them to support Adobe Firefly products and features.

Research, prototype, and integrate brand-new techniques from the latest literature into production-grade generation pipelines.

Construct and refine innovative end-to-end pipelines for multimodal generation, balancing quality, performance, and scalability.

Data Strategy & User Workflows

Work alongside data and research teams to review, modify, and recommend improvements to data strategies that support model training and fine-tuning.

Analyze and iterate on user-facing workflows, translating product requirements into model and pipeline build decisions.

Contribute to dataset curation, annotation strategy, and evaluation frameworks for generative models.

Technical Excellence & Collaboration

Participate in build reviews and code reviews, upholding high standards for code quality, architecture, and reproducibility.

Build and maintain robust technical documentation, design documents, and engineering standards.

Collaborate with partner teams across ASML and contribute actively to technical roadmaps and cross-functional planning.

Mentor junior engineers and share knowledge through pairing, code review, and internal technical talks.

What you need to succeed

Technical Depth

5+ years of industry experience in machine learning engineering, with a strong focus on deep learning for computer vision or multimodal generation.

Practical experience handling extensive, intricate ML codebases and current ML frameworks like PyTorch or Tensorflow in live settings.

Demonstrated experience in constructing and refining ML pipelines on a large scale — covering model training and fine-tuning all the way through inference and deployment.

Solid understanding of generative model architectures (e.g., diffusion models, transformers, GANs, VAEs) and experience adapting or training them for applied use cases.

Strong Python proficiency and software engineering fundamentals, including system build, testing, and debugging.

Experience in distributed training or inference on GPU clusters; knowledge of frameworks like Slurm or similar is an advantage.

Domain & Collaboration

Extensive knowledge of multimodal generation workflows — especially image or video generation — and the capability to quickly adopt new methods from research.

Demonstrated experience collaborating cross-functionally with research scientists, product managers, and infrastructure engineers.

Ability to communicate technical trade-offs clearly and contribute meaningfully to roadmap discussions and architectural decisions.

Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to thrive in a fast paced research and product environment.

Experience contributing to technical documentation, development proposals, or engineering standards.

Nice to Have

Experience with controllable generation, LoRA / fine-tuning workflows, or RLHF-based alignment techniques.

Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and MLOps tooling.

Prior experience working in a creative AI or media technology domain.

Contributions to open-source ML projects or peer-reviewed publications.

Education

A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience, is required.

Master's degree or PhD, or equivalent experience, preferred.

Director, Global Solutions Consulting
 

The Opportunity 

Adobe’s products empower people everywhere to imagine, create, and transform how the world works. Our Solutions Consultants are the trusted guides who bring that power to life for customers—turning possibility into clarity, and vision into measurable impact.

We are seeking a Director, Global Solutions Consulting to lead well-established teams across North America and EMEA. This leader will set the vision, standards, and operating model for our world-class team. The role spans both Creative Cloud and Document Cloud solution areas while remaining product-agnostic enough to flex with evolving portfolio needs. The Director will define excellence in discovery, value storytelling, demo execution, Proof of Value (PoV) methodology, and cross-functional execution.
 

What You’ll Lead

You will lead well-established Solutions Consulting teams across North America and EMEA. You will craft a unified standard of excellence for both Creative Cloud and Document Cloud solutions. With you on the team, we will ensure consistent execution, seamless cross-regional collaboration, and strong alignment with Sales, Product, Customer Success, and Marketing partners!
 

What You’ll Do

Set strategic direction and operating standards for the Global Solutions Consulting organization.

Drive revenue impact by elevating discovery, solution mapping, proof of value rigor, and storytelling

Partner closely with regional Sales leaders and Sales Operations to influence pipeline, forecast accuracy, and deal strategy.

Build and mentor a strong management bench, creating a high-performance culture rooted in accountability, curiosity, and growth.

Lead cross-functional collaboration with Product, PMM, Customer Success, and Professional Services.

Work with leadership team to establish global standard methodologies, demo frameworks, reusable assets, and enablement programs.

Represent Solutions Consulting as an executive sponsor with key customers.
 

What You’ll Bring

10+ years of Solutions Consulting, Pre-Sales, or related experience, with 3–5+ years leading multi-region teams.

Deep proficiency in consultative discovery, value storytelling, enterprise architecture, and executive communication.

Experience with both Creative Cloud and Document Cloud workflows, or comparable enterprise solutions.

Creative approach to solving tough problems, operational rigor, and experience partnering across Sales, Product, and Customer Success.

Ability to foster an inclusive, high-trust, high-accountability team culture.
 

How You’ll Measure Success

Conversion rate improvement, Average Deal Size growth, and sales cycle efficiency.

Demo and PoV quality benchmarks and adoption of standards across regions.

Team engagement, leadership strength, and talent development.

Operational benchmarks including coverage ratios and capacity utilization.
 

How You’ll Partner
 

You will work seamlessly with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, Product Marketing, Customer Success, Professional Services, RevOps, and Alliances to ensure alignment, consistent go-to-market execution, and a frictionless customer experience across all regions.
 

Team & Culture
 

We thrive when our team is invested in winning together. We're proud of the culture we're building and want to bring in a leader that makes us all better. You will nurture a culture of customer-centricity, innovation, curiosity, craftsmanship, and cross-team collaboration. As leaders, we model the behaviors we expect—clarity, empathy, execution excellence, and continuous improvement.
 

Location & Travel
 

This role leads distributed teams across North America and EMEA. Travel is required for leadership meetings, customer engagements, team events, and cross-functional alignment.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Partner Manager at Adobe, you will take ownership of one of our most strategic Global System Integrator (GSI) partnerships, with primary responsibility for Germany and an additional overlay role across Adobe Central Europe, working closely with regional Partner Alliance Managers.

This role sits at the heart of Adobe’s growth strategy, with a clear mandate to scale partner-led pipeline, revenue, and customer impact across the Adobe Digital Experience Cloud. You will define and execute the joint strategy with a top-tier global partner, aligning Adobe’s technology, industry solutions, and go-to-market motions with the integrator’s consulting, delivery, and services capabilities across the German market, while ensuring regional consistency and leverage across Central Europe.

Operating in a complex, matrixed environment, you will engage with stakeholders ranging from alliance leaders and solution architects to senior executives and C-level decision-makers. Your success will be measured by your ability to translate strategic alignment into tangible business outcomes—accelerating partner-sourced and partner-influenced deals, driving customer adoption, and building a scalable, high-impact partnership model across the region.

What You’ll Do

In this role, you will act as the primary relationship owner and trusted advisor for a global systems integrator in Germany, while collaborating with other Partner Alliance Managers to support and extend the partnership across Central Europe. You will shape joint priorities, lead executive alignment, and ensure disciplined execution across sales, marketing, and delivery teams.

You will develop and own Joint Business Plans that define shared objectives, investment areas, and success metrics, covering pipeline creation, bookings, customer adoption, and services attach. Working closely with Adobe Sales and Customer Success teams, you will ensure partner opportunities are identified early, properly registered, and executed seamlessly through to customer success.

A key part of the role is driving go-to-market impact. You will collaborate with Marketing, Product, and Partner Solution Consulting teams to design joint industry plays, solution offerings, and demand-generation initiatives. This includes sponsoring and shaping executive events, campaigns, and thought leadership activities that deliver measurable pipeline and revenue growth in Germany, while aligning with broader Central Europe priorities.

As a senior leader within Adobe’s partner ecosystem, you will bring a strong point of view on digital experience transformation, advising partners and customers on market trends and how Adobe’s full Experience Cloud portfolio can address their most critical business challenges. You will also play an important role in fostering a culture of accountability, ambition, and continuous improvement across the partnership and the wider regional partner community.

What You need to succeed

You bring extensive experience in enterprise sales and strategic partnerships, with a proven track record of delivering results through large, complex partners. You have spent several years working directly with Global System Integrators or major consulting firms, ideally with strong exposure to the German market and experience operating across multiple countries or regions.

You combine strong commercial acumen with executive presence, enabling you to influence senior leaders and drive alignment at the highest levels. You are experienced in building and scaling partner businesses, developing joint value propositions, and translating strategy into execution that delivers measurable outcomes across both local and regional contexts.

Success in this role requires excellent communication and presentation skills, a proactive and resilient mindset, and the ability to thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments. A bachelor’s degree is required; a master’s degree or equivalent professional experience is preferred.
