The Opportunity

Adobe is transforming the enterprise content supply chain with intelligent brand solutions that redefine how large organizations create, govern, and scale content. At the core of this transformation is Brand Brain, a first-of-its-kind AI system that captures an enterprise’s business context and brand identity, enabling teams to create and validate content that is consistently on-brand across tools, workflows, and channels.

We are looking for a Senior Developer to build of Brand Brain’s core services and infrastructure. This role is ideal for a senior full stack engineer who can design and build these key AI-powered content workflows that will help organizations create on-brand assets at scale. You will work across backend, AI orchestration layers, creative tooling, agentic workflows etc. This role sits at the intersection of creativity, engineering craftsmanship, and applied AI.

Impact You’ll Make

You will have an opportunity to thrive in ambiguous, fast-paced environments and can take a feature from concept to production. You will help architect build technology that helps enterprises create on-brand content at scale by building robust backend services, APIs and platforms that integrate Brand Brain into Adobe ecosystem and third-party enterprise apps.

The Opportunity

Adobe leads in creating world-class software solutions, and we are excited to welcome a new Software Development Engineer 5 to our vibrant team in Bangalore, Karnataka, India. This is an outstanding chance to join a cooperative and driven environment where your work directly influences the success of innovative projects.

Responsibilities

Architect and deliver foundational systems that enable enterprises to build on-brand content at a global scale.

Develop strong backend services, APIs, and integration layers that embed Brand Brain deeply within the Adobe ecosystem and third-party enterprise platforms.

Drive engineering excellence across performance, reliability, observability, and secure-by-default building.

Contribute to crafting long-term platform architecture in a fast-paced, highly visible product area.

What You’ll Do

Define and evolve foundational architecture, including service boundaries, domain models, APIs, and internal platform capabilities supporting high-throughput, low-latency workloads.

Build and implement scalable microservices and AI orchestration layers powering intelligent content workflows and agentic systems.

Build strong APIs and connectors that connect Brand Brain with Adobe products and third-party enterprise software.

Ensure platform compliance with strict SLAs for availability, scalability, latency, and data governance.

Establish guidelines for observability, incident management, prioritization, and cost efficiency.

Rapidly prototype and iterate on AI-powered features to validate new product experiences.

Improve engineering quality through thoughtful code reviews, automated testing, and technical mentorship.

What You’ll Bring

8+ years of experience building high-quality backend systems and microservices with strong emphasis on scalability, resilience, and performance.

Deep proficiency in backend development using Python or Java (both preferred).

Strong experience designing, building, and operating RESTful and/or GraphQL APIs at scale.

Hands-on experience with cloud-native architectures, containers, CI/CD pipelines, and distributed systems.

Strong foundation in system build, modern architecture patterns, and engineering guidelines.

Demonstrated ability to take features from concept to production in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.

Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate cross-functionally across Product, Build, and AI/ML teams.

Nice to Have

Experience in AdTech, MarTech, Content Management Systems (CMS), or enterprise SaaS platforms.

Familiarity with large-scale data platforms, indexing, or search systems.

Experience integrating platforms across complex product ecosystems.

Exposure to Adobe or third-party creative ecosystems (e.g., Photoshop, Express, InDesign, Figma).

Experience shipping AI-powered features or working with agentic workflows.

Who You Are

Design Workflow Authority: Deep credibility in professional design workflows and creative production pipelines, with knowledge of the film industry as a plus.

Executive Influence: Proven ability to influence academic leadership and complex institutions.

AI Leader: Practical and informed perspective on generative AI in creative production.

The Opportunity

Adobe purchases products and services from thousands of suppliers each year. We aim to accelerate Adobe's continued commercial success through outstanding strategic sourcing. You will have the chance to lead sourcing projects while you partner with internal teams and suppliers to optimize spend across Adobe's indirect categories.

What you'll do

Lead end-to-end commercial strategy for global cloud providers (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP), including complex enterprise agreements, consumption optimization, and long-term capacity planning.

Partner with Engineering, Architecture, and Finance to translate cloud usage patterns into actionable sourcing strategies that reduce total cost of ownership while maintaining performance and resilience.

Develop and execute negotiation strategies for multi-year cloud commitments, marketplace agreements, and emerging cloud-native services.

Utilize governance mechanisms that improve visibility into cloud spend, usage forecasting, and risk management.

Monitor market trends across hyperscalers and cloud ecosystem vendors to inform build vs. buy decisions and long-term platform strategy.

Proactively seek value-creating opportunities across spend categories

Oversee the process of disseminating and following contract obligations, and instituting a complete strategy to approach renewal.

Develop, issue, and coordinate RFx activity and lead commercial negotiations to find the best sourcing solution for Adobe.

Ensure proper risk mitigation through liaising and contributing with Legal. Help internal partners obtain robust Service Level Agreements (SLAs) to ensure reliable performance.

Report progress on a weekly basis, indicating work planning and work in progress. Add agreements, service details and payment forecasts into procurement systems in a complete and timely manner.

Drive continuous improvement and organizational change initiatives.

What You’ll Need

Minimum of a bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Economics, or similar (preference: MBA, or JD).

Strategic Sourcing/Procurement-related industry certification(s) a plus.

Preference: 6-10 years’ experience in Strategic Sourcing with an emphasis in cloud software or software as a service.

Deep market knowledge software contracting trends, licensing models, and business models.

Experience leading teams, formal people leadership preferred. 

Familiarity with fiscal planning cycles and ad hoc financial analysis.

Excellent emotional intelligence (EQ) & influence with various partners, and improving business dynamics both within Global Procurement and broadly across Adobe; evidence of continuous positive customer feedback.

Growth mentality: aware of personal strengths and weaknesses; skilled in receiving, applying, and giving useful feedback.

Mastery of MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

Familiarity with BI reporting and spend analysis.

High attention to detail and the exercise of sound judgment and decision-making.

Exceptional written and verbal communication, time management and interpersonal skills.

Able to synthesize and present complex matters and data analysis in executive presentation views with insightful commentary.

Willing to train users in new processes, policies, and procedures or technologies.

Effective ownership of competing priorities. Flexible working times based on company requirements and should be expected at various times through the business year and quarter.

The Adobe Digital Imaging Data Science Team is looking for a Data Scientist passionate about data and delivering an outstanding product experience. We use extensive product usage data and work closely with product managers, marketing managers, and software engineers to derive insights and build a foundation for reliable data-driven decision-making. You will focus on initiatives like product analytics, dashboards, data engineering, GTM analytics, growth and more. Your main role is to develop and maintain a strong data architecture that enhances reporting, analytics, and experimentation. Over time, you will apply predictive modeling and machine learning to help the organization improve customer experiences. Join us and drive meaningful change in Adobe’s most exciting areas!

Responsibilities:

Partner with product and engineering teams to understand existing product instrumentation and help bridge gaps in data streams to assist data science initiatives.

Analyze product usage patterns to better understand customer behavior including acquisition, engagement, conversion, and retention.

Proactively identify user trends and communicate relevant insights to assist product decision-making.

Automate and optimize data pipelines using SQL and/or Python-based ETL Frameworks.

Build and maintain various dashboards to inform the team about the state of the business, as well as to alert business partners when issues occur.

Architect and implement models to recommend personalized in-app content.

Drive A/B and multivariate tests and build feature-level experiments to validate hypotheses and influence product development decisions.

Requirements:

MS or Ph.D. in data science, computer science, statistics, applied mathematics, engineering, or economics, or equivalent experience.

3 - 5+ years of relevant data science experience.

Experience translating business questions into data analytics approaches.

Strong proficiency in querying and manipulating large datasets using SQL-like languages (Hive, Spark, etc.).

Experience developing and operationalizing consistent approaches to experimentation, using appropriate statistical techniques to reduce bias and interpret statistical significance.

Proficiency with descriptive and inferential statistics (i.e., t-test, chi-square, ANOVA, correlation, regression, etc.) to understand customer engagement and generate hypotheses.

Experience crafting data visualizations and storytelling to efficiently communicate analysis results to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Knowledge of relevant tools in this field such as Hadoop, Hive, Splunk, Spark, Tableau, Excel (Charting and Pivot-Tables), and Power BI.

Experience in product instrumentation is a plus.

Possess natural curiosity and technical competence, being capable of asking critical questions and always ready to address any challenges.

Experience addressing an executive level audience.

Excellent communication, relationship skills, and a strong teammate.

About the Role

The Acrobat Product Marketing team is seeking a strategic Director of Product Marketing, Engagement to lead our Value Discovery team with a focus on delivering meaningful impact. This leader will shape how customers discover, adopt, and build lasting habits around our most important capabilities.

They will define the strategy that connects product innovation to sustained customer value, ensuring new and existing capabilities are clearly positioned, prioritized effectively, and reinforced across the full customer lifecycle. This role owns the narrative and sequencing of key experiences so what we build is not only understood, but consistently used.

Working cross-functionally with teams such as Product, Growth, Lifecycle, GTM, and others, this leader will drive adoption, increase repeat engagement, and translate product improvements into measurable, long-term impact for the business.

What You’ll Do

Define and lead the Value Discovery strategy, shaping how customers discover, adopt, and build lasting habits around our most important capabilities.

Design and operationalize a cross-channel engagement framework that ensures new and existing capabilities are introduced, reinforced, and re-surfaced at the right moments across the customer lifecycle.

Develop engagement messaging framework for key capabilities grounded in user value and existing workflows

Build an always-on content strategy that employs trends, cultural moments, and seasonal events to promote new and existing value

Partner cross-functionally with GTM, Product, Design, Growth, Lifecycle to align engagement strategy with roadmap priorities and business goals.

Embed audience expertise, behavioral insights and adoption data into strategic decision-making to influence product direction.

Drive measurable improvements in feature adoption, depth of usage, and multi-tool engagement.

What We’re Looking For

A strategic product marketing leader who drives behavior change—not just awareness.

A builder of scalable engagement systems, not one-off campaigns.

A strong cross-functional operator who can influence Product, Growth, Lifecycle, Design, and GTM partners and align teams around shared adoption goals.

A problem solver with a customer-first approach who translates workflows and user insights into clear, compelling value narratives.

A data-driven operator who uses adoption metrics, usage patterns, and experimentation to continuously refine strategy.

A leader who can balance long-term critical thinking alongside hands-on execution and operational excellence.

A compelling storyteller who can articulate value in a way that drives clarity, urgency, and action internally and externally.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

10+ years in Product Marketing, Engagement, Lifecycle, or a related field in a subscription-based business, with clear ownership of adoption and engagement metrics.

Proven track record of increasing feature adoption, usage depth, retention, or multi-product engagement.

Experience building cross-channel engagement strategies (in-product, email, paid, owned).

Comfort working closely with Product & Design teams, shaping roadmaps through customer insight, influencing prioritization, and embedding go-to-market thinking into product development.

Strong analytical skills and comfort using data to inform decisions and prioritize investments.

Experience building and leading high-performing teams and influencing senior partners.

Excellent communication skills with the ability to drive clarity and alignment across functions.

A passion for modernizing a legacy product with a clear vision for how AI can drive everyday utility, prove ongoing value, and unlock Acrobat’s next phase of growth.

Director of Global Strategic Sourcing – Technology

The Opportunity 

We are looking for a dynamic Director of Technology Strategic Sourcing to lead high‑impact technology categories. You’ll have the opportunity to set the vision and strategy for the spend categories, shape company‑wide sourcing decisions related to Technology spend and grow as a senior leader within a global sourcing organization. You will deliver significant savings, streamline operations, and raise internal customer satisfaction. You’ll also help standardize how we buy and govern technology through our unified source-to-pay process, enabling faster buying, and strengthening governance companywide.

Collaborating with the Head of Global Strategic Sourcing, you will lead teams of category managers covering over $2.5B in annual spend. The category scope includes Cloud (Compute, Storage, GPU), AI and Data Platforms, Enterprise Software (SaaS and on- premise), Infrastructure (Hardware, Data Center, Network) and Services. Are you a builder and leader who is comfortable in setting strategy, driving execution, developing talent, and influencing senior levels in a fast‑paced, global environment? If you are looking to operate at scale, influence executive decision‑making, and build the next chapter of your leadership career, this role offers both growth and impact.

What you'll Do 

Partner closely with internal customers to understand priorities, unlock value, and deliver measurable outcomes.

Build and continuously evolve multi‑year category strategies aligned to business roadmaps, budgets, and risk posture.

Help standardize technology buying through unified source‑to‑pay processes and contracting standards.

Lead sourcing and cross-functional teams across multiple categories and initiatives from strategy development through sourcing, contracting, and implementation.

Develop organizational capability by mentoring, coaching, and building high‑performing sourcing leaders and teams.

Drive process improvements that increase customer happiness, reduce cycle time, and deliver efficiency gains while ensuring compliance with policies and mitigating supplier risk.

Deploy leading-edge procurement solutions (e.g., AI, RPA, Chatbots, Process Mining) to drive automation, unlocking savings, mitigate risk and transform strategic sourcing processes 

What you need to succeed 

10+ years of demonstrated leadership experience and expertise in strategic sourcing for Technology categories (enterprise software, SaaS/cloud, data/AI, or infra/services) at a global scale and within a fast paced, dynamic organization.

Experience in structuring and negotiating large-scale cloud agreements with hyperscalers. Solid understanding of cloud category market dynamics (offerings, pricing, competitive position, market trends); Demonstrated ability to develop and implement sourcing strategies that translate to significant business outcomes. 

Proven track record in building trusted relationships with diverse partners across all levels (including senior-most levels of an organization) and influence decision‑making that aligns the interests of diverse teams.

Strong people-leadership capabilities, with a track record of attracting, developing, training and retaining outstanding talent.

Experience embedding risk, compliance, and governance into sourcing and contracting processes.

Experience leading high-profile, complex negotiations with multi-faceted relationships (buy from, sell to, joint go-to-market, etc).

We have a fantastic opportunity for a Principal Enterprise Architect Professional Services to join our team based in London.

As a Principal Enterprise Architect Professional Services, you will guide architecture through the transformation lifecycle. You will build executive confidence, govern design decisions, lead architecture build, and make sure technology choices support long-term value.

What you’ll do

You will bridge business goals and technical delivery by designing target architectures, planning transitions, and creating decommissioning strategies. Using change management frameworks such as ADKAR, you'll support adoption and sustainability.

Key Responsibilities

Assess and advance the architectural intent crafted during pre-sales.

Provide architectural leadership across the full transformation lifecycle and guide platform adoption and evolution.

Convert the success roadmap created during pre-sales into a comprehensive, managed transition plan featuring clear sequencing, decision points, and risk controls.

Formulate robust, industry-specific architectural perspectives and translate them into target-state architecture, reference models, and phased implementation plans.

Foster and maintain executive trust in architectural direction, serving as a strategic advisor to senior business and technology collaborators.

Collaborate with licensing and services sales teams to improve major sales initiatives.

Coordinate architectural efforts among delivery teams, subject matter experts, and partners to ensure build integrity and alignment during execution.

Establish and lead architecture governance and assurance forums.

Partner closely with pre‑sales teams to ensure lessons learned, build patterns, and reference architectures continually improve future pursuits and delivery outcomes.

What you’ll need to succeed

Proven experience providing enterprise architecture leadership across large-scale transformation programmes, from early visioning and pre-sales through delivery, adoption, and platform evolution.

Strong grounding in TOGAF principles and lifecycle-based architecture governance, applied pragmatically in complex enterprise environments.

Broad understanding of digital marketing, data, and activation ecosystems.

The ability to craft compelling narratives that translate architectural choices into business-relevant results and messages suitable for executives.

Experience operating as a trusted architectural advisor to senior executives.

Strong understanding of AI, automation, and emerging agentic models, and their implications for enterprise platforms.

Experience working closely with delivery teams, partners, and vendors to maintain build integrity.

Ability to apply structured change and adoption approaches (including ADKAR) to support the human and organisational aspects of architectural evolution.

A collaborative, outcome-focused leadership style, with a relentless focus on value and adoption.

Fluency in English is required. Any other european language would be a plus.

The Opportunity

Firefly Enterprise is bringing generative AI into real creative workflows—directly inside the tools customers already use. The Extensibility team builds and evolves GenStudio plugins (e.g., for Figma and other creative hosts) that connect in-product experiences to Firefly imaging workflows (generate image/similar, generative expand, remove background, etc.) and GenStudio enterprise workflows (templating/mapping, iteration, governance handoff).The problem we’re solving: enterprise creative teams want the speed of generative AI without leaving their native tools or rebuilding complex templates elsewhere. GenStudio plugins solve this by enabling in-tool generation and editing, mapping content to structured fields/roles (headline/body/CTA/on-image text), and handing off outputs to GenStudio for governance and activation—all while integrating with the right APIs and enterprise constraints.This role is frontend-first with basic full-stack expectations: you’ll mainly build UI and client architecture, and you’ll also be comfortable debugging service integrations, collaborating on API contracts, and making small backend contributions when needed.

What you’ll do

Build and ship GenStudio plugins using modern JavaScript/TypeScript and a contemporary frontend framework (React/Web Components or similar).

Own user-facing workflows end-to-end: UI implementation, interaction design fidelity, state management, performance, accessibility, and reliability.

Integrate deeply with APIs (REST/GraphQL): handle auth flows, async job orchestration (polling), retries, error states, and instrumentation-friendly patterns.

Design for extensibility: implement flexible UI patterns and plugin architecture that can grow to new workflows, new hosts, and enterprise requirements.

Work closely with Product and Design: clarify requirements, surface edge cases early, and iterate quickly with high-quality execution.

Champion engineering quality: unit/integration testing where appropriate, code reviews, build/release hygiene, and pragmatic tech debt management.

Mentor and support junior engineers through reviews, pairing, and design discussions.

What you need to succeed

6–8+ years of professional software engineering experience with a strong frontend focus.

Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and modern component-based UI development.

Proven experience integrating with APIs and building robust client-side systems around asynchronous workflows.

Strong CS fundamentals and practical software design skills.

Excellent communication skills; ability to collaborate across functions and time zones.

Nice to have

Experience building embedded/plugin UIs (Figma plugins, UXP panels, add-ins, extensions, or other constrained runtimes).

Basic backend experience (Node.js/services) and comfort working with logs/metrics and debugging cross-service issues.

Familiarity with LLMs/GenAI concepts and integrating AI capabilities into products.

Experience with build systems, CI/CD, and release processes (marketplace-style or enterprise deployments).

La Oportunidad 

Esta posición está ubicada en la Ciudad de México en la división de Productos farmacéuticos establecidos. Estamos comprometidos a llevar los beneficios de nuestros medicamentos confiables a más personas en los países de más rápido crecimiento del mundo. Nuestro amplio portafolio de medicamentos genéricos de marca diferenciada y de alta calidad abarca múltiples áreas terapéuticas, incluidas la gastroenterología, la salud de la mujer, los cardiometabólicos, el manejo del dolor / sistema nervioso central y las vías respiratorias.

El Analista de Documentación y Soporte Administrativo será responsable de ejecutar las actividades que se deriven del sistema de documentación, que incluyen la preparación, actualización, disponibilidad e implementación de la documentación técnica que se utiliza en las operaciones de la planta y que impactan la calidad de los productos que Abbott Mexico fabrique, acondicione y/o distribuya en el mercado local y de exportación.

Que harás:

1. DOCUMENTACIÓN

SISTEMA DE DOCUMENTACION / CONTROL DE CAMBIOS: Hacer uso de los sistemas electrónicos validados y siguiendo lo indicado en los procedimientos efectivos para:

• Ejecutar las actividades derivadas del sistema de documentación que se encuentran relacionadas con la recepción, implementación, actualización, distribución y archivo en duro de documentos locales y documentos globales. Por ejemplo:

LOCALES: Procedimientos / manuales de operación, formatos, apéndices, procedimientos de producción / fabricación / acondicionamiento, especificaciones / metodología, estructuras de producto terminado / graneles, listado de caducidades / precios, documentos pre -aprobados de otros sistemas de calidad, etc.

GLOBALES: Fórmulas, especificaciones de materia prima, producto terminado, material de empaque primario y metodología.

• Dar apoyo a las diferentes áreas para procesar y ser el Coordinador de los controles de cambio globales y locales.

• Verificar de manera semanal la emisión / actualización de las políticas emitidas por Global y asegurar su implementación local conforme a los índices de la División, Región y Afiliada Comercial.

• Mantener el archivo físico de Documentación ordenado y actualizado.

 

2. INFORMACIÓN TÉCNICA

• Proporcionar la información técnica del sitio incluida dentro del sistema electrónico de Documentación al área Regulatoria y de Calidad de los diferentes países en donde se exportan los productos de Tlalpan para el armado de dossiers de registros en nuevos productos o a cambios en ellos por requerimiento de sitios, clientes, nuevos mercados, etc.

• Preparar información requerida para el Reporte Anual de Producto correspondiente a controles de cambio de procesos de documentación global.

 

3. SISTEMA ELECTRÓNICO DE DOCUMENTACIÓN

• Ser Administrador del Sistema Electrónico de Documentación.

• Apoyo a usuarios del sitio en temas relacionados con el sistema electrónico de documentación como “Business Administrator”.

• Altas y modificaciones a accesos de usuarios del sistema electrónico de documentación.

 

4. SOPORTE AL NEGOCIO

• Mantener el nivel de cumplimiento de las Buenas Prácticas de Documentación.

• Participación activa en reuniones Regionales y/o Globales relacionadas a Documentación y Controles de Cambio para las productos que Abbott Tlalpan es el manufacturero.

• Imprimir / verificar procedimientos de producción, fabricación, acondicionamiento y formatos de arranque de línea que se utilizan para fabricar / adicionar un producto en el sitio de Tlalpan.

• Ejecutar las actividades de documentación que se deriven de transferencia de producto, lanzamiento de nuevos productos, cambios de proceso, Sistema CAPA (Del inglés “Correction Action and Preventive Action”) / Quejas, Sistema de Auditoría Interna.

• Coordinar y gestionar actividades administrativas y de logística durante la recepción de auditorías de diferentes ministerios de Salud como de Columbia, Rusia, Perú, USA, así como de Assessments Corporativos.

• Realizar actividades de suplencia del Analista de Documentación y Químico Documentador, cumpliendo con el plan de entrenamiento correspondiente.

Cualificaciones requeridas

Licenciatura en Ciencias Químico Biológicas, Ingeniería Química o afín con Titulo profesional indispensable

Manejo de office (excel, word, .ppt)

Experiencia: Mínimo 2 años en manejo de documentos técnicos en inglés, controles de cambio, dossiers, lanzamiento de nuevos productos en empresas farmacúticas.

Conocimientos deseables: Buenas Prácticas de Manufactura (GMP’s), Buenas Prácticas de Documentación, ALCOA+

Conocimiento de sistemas (BPCS, SAP o similares)

THE OPPORTUNITY

Our location in Temecula, CA, currently has an opportunity for a Quality Engineer in our Vascular Division. This is a fully onsite role. 

The Quality Engineer assures new or modified products conform to quality standards and establishes compliance with the quality system. Responsible for maintaining a strong collaborative partnership with cross-functional team members that facilitates organizational success by protecting patient/user safety and meeting business needs.

Abbott Vascular provides innovative, minimally invasive and cost-effective products for treatment of vascular disease. Our extensive portfolio includes drug-eluting stents, bare metal stents, guide wires, balloon dilatation catheters, imaging catheters and software, vessel closure devices and peripheral stents.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Execute and support on-time completion of Design Control Deliverables.

Support on-time execution of Quality Plans for internal development, OEM-based, Clinical Product Development (CPDP), and design change projects.

Accountable for Design Verification and Validation planning & execution, including active cross-functional root-cause analysis investigation & resolution activities.

Lead or support Risk Management activities from product Concept through Commercialization.

Support design test and inspection method development, and lead method validation activities.

Ensure DHF content completion, integrity, and regulatory & standards compliance; collaboratively communicating & resolving gaps.

Support manufacturing process development & qualification for new product commercialization and product changes.

Support internal & external audit responses.

Support product re-certifications.

Support the establishment of objective, measurable, discrete, and verifiable customer and product requirements.

Support objective component specification definitions, supplied component sampling plan development, and vendor qualifications.

Support execution of biocompatibility and sterilization qualifications.

Complete Document Change Request Reviews in a timely and objective manner.

Additional duties may be identified by functional management based on the current project/business objectives.

Support all Company initiatives as identified by management and in support of Quality Management Systems (QMS), Environmental Management Systems (EMS), and other regulatory requirements.

Complies with U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations, other regulatory requirements, Company policies, operating procedures, processes, and task assignments. Maintains positive and cooperative communications and collaboration with all levels of employees, customers, contractors, and vendors.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE YOU’LL BRING

Bachelor's degree in related field.

2-5+ years of related work experience with a basic understanding of specified functional area, or an equivalent combination of education and work experience

Medical Devices or other highly regulated industry experience

Undertanding of ISO, ASQ, RM/FMEAs and FDA Regulations

Previous Quality engineering experience and demonstrated use of Quality tools/methodologies.

Ability to work in a highly matrixed and geographically diverse business environment.

Ability to work within a team and as an individual contributor in a fast-paced, changing environment.

Ability to leverage and/or engage others to accomplish projects.

Strong verbal and written communications with ability to effectively communicate at multiple levels in the organization.

Multitasks, prioritizes and meets deadlines in timely manner.

Strong organizational and follow-up skills, as well as attention to detail.

Ability to travel approximately 10%, including internationally.

Preferred Experience: 

Experience working in a broader enterprise/cross-division business unit model preferred.

The Opportunity

Within the capacity of Lead Employee Relations Consultant (P50), you will operate as a high-level strategic advisor, problem-solver, and thought partner to leaders across Adobe. You will independently navigate the most critical, complex, and high visibility employee relations matters—including sensitive investigations, complex performance issues, conduct matters, conflict resolution, and escalations—while influencing leaders toward business-aligned, ethically grounded decisions!

You will shape organizational health by anticipating risks, synthesizing insights across regions, and driving proactive strategies that help leaders build resilient, engaged, and inclusive teams. You will partner closely with HR Business Partners, Employment Counsel, Employee Experience Centers of Excellence, and ER Managers to accelerate decision-making, elevate ER thinking, and ensure consistent outcomes that reinforce Adobe’s values.

This role is ideal for an expert who is as comfortable briefing executives as leading an investigation, and who can balance strategic foresight with operational excellence!

What you'll Do

Strategic Business Partnership & Organizational Enablement

Act as an experienced advisor to leaders, influencing decision making and proactively identifying people related risks, patterns, and opportunities for healthier team environments.

Translate business strategy into tailored ER approaches that reinforce accountability, improve team efficiency, and drive positive organizational outcomes.

Coach leaders through complex people challenges, building their capability to lead with clarity, fairness, consistency, and cultural alignment.

Partner with HRBPs and leadership groups regarding organizational themes, early warning signs, and workforce health indicators, enabling proactive interventions and scalable solutions.

2. Leadership of High Complexity Casework & Investigations

Lead sensitive, detailed, and high stakes workplace investigations, ensuring high-quality analysis, objectivity, thoroughness, and compliant processes.

Provide direction, guidance, and quality review on case strategy, documentation, findings, and recommendations.

Address the most intricate performance management and conduct matters, offering strategic recommendations rooted in risk assessment, cultural alignment, and business impact.

De-escalate issues that arise within the ecosystem.

3. Reorganizations & Workforce Transformation

Partner with leaders and HRBPs to guide the people related execution of reorganizations, team restructures, role changes, and other workforce transitions.

Advise on communication strategies, sequencing, change readiness, team impacts, and risk factors.

Identify root causes of organizational friction and develop ER strategies that support smoother transitions and long-term organizational effectiveness.

Ensure consistency of approach across regions while respecting local nuance.

4. Proactive ER Strategies & Organizational Health Insights

Analyze case trends, workplace dynamics, and team health indicators to deliver actionable insights, and partner with business and PX leadership to recommend proactive strategies—such as training, manager enablement, and process or behavior changes—to reduce risk and strengthen culture.

Partner with EWX and ELR leadership to activate priorities such as manager capability uplift, governance & documentation improvements, and scalable ER standards.

Lead continuous improvement efforts that simplify processes, strengthen decision quality, and reinforce global consistency.

5. Coaching, Influence & Thought Leadership

Serve in a senior ER capacity on cross‑functional initiatives, partnering closely with Legal, Security, HR Operations, PX, and Centers of Excellence.

Lead and participate in Americas and global ER projects, promoting regional alignment and uniformity in processes, communication standards, governance, and partner engagement while supporting scalable, adaptable solutions.

6. Cross Functional Leadership

Function as a senior ER representative on cross-functional initiatives, collaborating closely with Legal, Security, HR Operations, PX, and Centers of Excellence.

Lead and contribute to Americas and global ER projects, driving regional alignment and consistency in processes, communication standards, governance, and partner engagement while enabling scalable, adaptable solutions.

What you need to succeed

Deep expertise navigating high complexity ER matters across investigations, conduct, conflict, and performance.

Strong business insight and ability to align ER guidance to organizational objectives and business realities.

Exceptional judgment, analytical skills, and integrated thinking; ability to anticipate issues and shape early interventions.

Demonstrated success influencing leaders at multiple levels and driving outcomes in a global matrix environment.

Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to produce concise, executive ready summaries and high quality investigation documentation.

Ability to coach others, uplift team capability, and drive consistent, values aligned outcomes.

Experience partnering with cross functional teams on organizational change, de-escalation, governance, and critical initiatives.

Adobe Firefly’s ASML group invites research scientists and engineers passionate about conditional generation and editing of large generative AI models. This role emphasizes images and videos. We strive to advance generative AI technology while guaranteeing models possess excellent quality and control.

We are especially looking for candidates experienced in large-scale, industry-level pre-training and mid-training of multi-modality generative models. This role has a direct effect on the quality of Adobe’s image and video generation models, supporting next-generation creative workflows for millions of users.

As an Applied Scientist at Adobe, you will join a world-class team of applied researchers and engineers building the future of digital experiences. You will have the opportunity to innovate across the full training stack, collaborate across data, modeling, and product, and see your work ship to customers worldwide.

Job Responsibilities

Conduct innovative research and development in training large-scale generative AI models for image and video synthesis.

Develop, carry out, and carefully assess sophisticated techniques for conditional generation and editing. Emphasize improving instruction compliance, controllability, and visual clarity in pre-trained image and video models.

Collaborate cross-functionally with researchers, engineers, and product teams to translate multimodal innovations into scalable downstream applications coordinated within Adobe products.

Develop and maintain robust evaluation pipelines to assess generative models across quality, efficiency, robustness, and safety metrics.

Translate research concepts and published work into production-ready implementations using Python and modern machine learning frameworks.

What you'll need to succeed

Possession of a Master’s or Ph.D. degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field.

Extensive practical experience in large-scale generative AI training concentrating on image and video generation and editing.

Familiarity with diffusion models, transformers, or other brand new generative architectures.

Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate across cross-functional teams.

Strong coding and prototyping ability in Python, PyTorch, and ML infrastructure tools.

Working with product teams on technology transfers.

Strong history of publishing in Computer Science, AI/ML, or related areas.

Adobe seeks a Senior or Principal Engineering Program Manager with strategic and execution skills to support Adobe Analytics Product and Engineering teams in meeting vital business targets. The role involves building and growing the next generation of Adobe Analytics products, especially emphasizing agentic capabilities in the Adobe Customer Experience Orchestration (CXO) portfolio.

You will operate in a highly complex, fast-evolving, and often ambiguous environment. The ideal candidate thrives in this setting — bringing structure to ambiguity, improving cross-functional alignment, and developing positive relationships across the organization. This is not a “task master” role. Serving as a reliable, hands-on partner embedded within the program team, you will work closely with Engineering, Product, UX, and Marketing leaders to drive outcomes.

You will be instrumental in advancing collaboration, communication, consistency in execution, and alignment within the CXO ecosystem — establishing yourself as a trusted and indispensable contributor. Experience leading software development programs and collaborating across Engineering, Product, and Marketing is essential.

If you feel driven to develop the future of Adobe’s analytical solutions in the emerging Agentic space, we’d love to meet you.

What you'll do:

Drive complex programs from concept through release.

Proactively identify risks, remove obstacles, and solve problems directly — taking ownership rather than waiting for direction.

Ensure strong operational hygiene across tools (JIRA, dashboards, status reporting).

Coordinate cross-functional dependencies across global teams, partnering closely with other Program Managers and collaborators.

Communicate program status, risks, and trade-offs.

Mentor peers, effect positive change, and lead by example.

What you need to succeed:

Deep sense of ownership and accountability — you operate like a business owner.

Technical curiosity — you seek to understand how systems work and leverage AI tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude, Codex) to accelerate insights and solutions.

Strong prioritization skills and the ability to complete tasks in a fast-paced, technically complex environment.

Strong interpersonal and communication abilities, capable of influencing various cross-functional groups and senior leadership.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, high attention to detail, and a focus on continuous improvement.

Proficiency in JIRA (basic), Confluence (basic), Excel (intermediate to advanced), and modern AI tooling.

10+ years of relevant experience, including engineering management and/or program management experience.

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required; advanced degree preferred.

PMP, CSM, or Agile certifications preferred.

We are seeking a Director of Product Marketing, Growth & Platforms to drive user and revenue expansion for Adobe's Creator portfolio. In this role, you will coordinate the growth strategy for Firefly, Photoshop, Lightroom, and Premiere across both web and mobile platforms.

You will be responsible for shaping the expansion approach for this ecosystem and lead a cross functional team passionate about driving impact across two key areas:

Cross-Application Growth: Scale our products within Adobe’s creative ecosystem by integrating workflows and optimizing acquisition funnels across internal and external touchpoints.

Portfolio Lifecycle Management (LCM): Develop our LCM system and omnichannel methods (email, push, in-app messaging, SMS or comparable experience) aimed at improving user engagement and retention.

What You Will Do

Drive Cross-Application Growth Strategies

Workflow Integration: Build cross-application workflows and incorporate Firefly's Generative AI tools into Photoshop, Lightroom, and Premiere.

Journey Optimization: Manage end-to-end user journeys.

Scale branded entry points across the product ecosystem. Support the development of a cross-app platform. Build viral loops and develop our trends and sharing roadmap to drive organic growth.

External Partnerships: Build strategic partnerships to define new entry points and workflows (e.g., LLM providers, hardware, and software partners).

Architect Portfolio Lifecycle Oversight (LCM)

Omnichannel Activation: Manage LCM channels across the Creator portfolio, including push, in-app, email, SMS, App Store Optimization (ASO), and Google Play.

Evergreen Engagement: Direct the evergreen LCM strategy with Outbound Product Marketing to sustain user engagement between major product releases.

Infrastructure Acceleration: Partner with Product and Engineering to advance infrastructure.

Platform modernization: Explore new ways to bring to bear Gen AI technologies to engage users and drive operational excellence.

Orchestrate Cross-Functional Execution & Growth Operations

Growth Operations: Lead high-velocity multivariate testing frameworks to optimize acquisition funnels, monetization models, and user flows.

Product-Led Growth (PLG): Operationalize PLG loops - such as sharing, referrals, and asset remixing to improve user acquisition.

Executive Alignment: Align Engineering, Build, Product, and Marketing around unified growth objectives. Translate growth analytics into clear executive reporting.

What You Need to Succeed

Growth Leadership: 12+ years of leadership experience in growth marketing, product marketing, or product management. A proven record of scaling products to mass-market adoption within a multi-product ecosystem.

Mobile & Web Expertise: Deep experience driving user acquisition, retention, and monetization strategies for applications.

Lifecycle & Ecosystem Experience: Proficiency in managing complex LCM channels and growth loops. Hands-on experience with enterprise marketing automation infrastructure (e.g., Adobe Journey Optimizer) is highly preferred.

Quantitative Rigor: Strong analytical skills. Demonstrated capability in cohort analysis, funnel optimization, user profiling, and A/B/multivariate experiment development.

Technical & Creative Proficiency: Ability to translate GenAI capabilities (e.g., LLMs, diffusion models) into intuitive value propositions for creative professionals in building, video, and imaging.

Cross-Functional Leadership: Proven ability to influence executive collaborators, product managers, and engineering teams in a matrixed organization.

The opportunity
Adobe is seeking Senior Staff Applied Scientists who excel at turning research breakthroughs into innovative product features. In this role, you will focus on scouting, adapting, and improvising the latest research to advance Adobe’s AI capabilities in the field of Natural Language, Image/Video generation, editing, and multimodal AI that impact millions of users.
We welcome outstanding candidates in all related technical fields, such as Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Computer Vision, and Natural Language Processing, Large language models.
Familiarity with inference optimization, performance trade-offs, and scalable integration will be an asset. We are looking for a candidate who is motivated by moving fast with research and innovation and wants their ideas to shape the future of Adobe products.

What you will do

Transform innovative research concepts into practical applications within the realm of Generative AI, LLMs, Reinforcement learning, Reasoning, Evaluations.

Prototype and experiment rapidly, demonstrating feasibility and business impact.

Push beyond academic results to develop and deploy practical, differentiated innovations for Adobe’s products.

Collaborate with world-class researchers and ML engineers to bring research ideas to production.

Publish and present your work in world-class scientific venues in AI/ML fields.

Develop and enhance GPU-accelerated pipelines for (customized) model training and inference, focusing on performance, scalability, and reliability.

Foster a culture of innovation, technical excellence, and continuous improvement across the organization.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

Ph.D. or Masters or equivalent experience in Engineering, Computer Science, AI/ML or related fields and 10+ professional experience.

Research or industry experience in training AI/ML models in at least one of the following modalities: multimodal LLMs, Image, Video.

Proficiency in training and optimizing large-scale models, involving data curation, distributed training, and memory-efficient strategies.

Experience with post-training techniques such as fine-tuning, alignment or distillation.

Proficiency with modern deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch) and experience scaling models on GPU/TPU clusters.

Excellent communication skills and a strong great teammate.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience on large-scale generative model training.

Experience on synthetic data generation.

Previous involvement with product teams in technology transfers.

Experience of working with large-scale datasets

Job Description

We need a skilled Product Manager to join our team, specializing in Sales and Support technology. The perfect candidate should excel in using AI to improve customer experience and boost business growth.

Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy and Vision: Craft, communicate, and advocate a distinct product vision and strategy for Sales and Support technologies, integrating AI to enhance customer engagement.

Market Research and Analysis: Undertake meticulous market research to uncover customer needs, market trends, and competitive landscape. Employ these observations to guide product development and positioning.

Roadmap Development: Build and maintain a detailed 4-quarterly product roadmap that aligns with business goals and customer needs. Prioritize features and improvements based on impact and feasibility. Present roadmap progress and insights to senior leadership and cross-functional collaborators.

Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate closely with engineering, UX designers, sales, legal, and support teams to ensure successful product development and launch. Facilitate communication, alignment and collaboration across distributed teams and geographies.

Customer Engagement: Work with customers & key team members to gather feedback, grasp problems, and validate product concepts. Apply this feedback to propel continuous improvement and innovation.

Performance Metrics: Define and track critical metrics to measure product success and identify areas for improvement and innovation. Use data-driven insights to make informed decisions.

AI Thought Leadership: Recognize opportunities where AI can significantly change the transactional digital-human exchanges. Define creative solutions that improve the transactional sales and support processes. Keep abreast of the most recent AI advancements and integrate them into product development. Work together with business, engineering, and data science teams to prototype, validate, and launch AI-powered features that boost automation, personalization, and efficiency.

Qualifications

Education: Bachelor's degree or relevant experience in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a similar field. An MBA or advanced degree is a plus.

Experience: At least 5 years of experience in product management, specializing in transactional Sales and Support technologies. Demonstrated success in launching and overseeing products.

Technical Skills: Proficient knowledge and proven history of integrating AI technologies and their utilization in transactional Sales and Support field. Having familiarity with AI/ML frameworks and tools is greatly valued.

Experience with Leading AI Platforms: Having worked with industry-leading AI ecosystems like Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service, Amazon Bedrock, or AWS SageMaker is highly desirable. Being familiar with integrating these platforms into enterprise-scale sales and support systems is a strong advantage. Demonstrated success in employing these technologies to build scalable, intelligent solutions that improve user efficiency, automate workflows, and drive measurable business outcomes will set you apart.

Analytical Abilities: Demonstrates excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities. Ability to interpret complex data and make data-driven decisions.

Communication Skills: Demonstrates strong verbal and written communication abilities. Capable of effectively engaging with technical and non-technical collaborators.

Encouragement: Demonstrated leadership skills with the ability to influence and encourage cross-functional teams. Strong project management skills and attention to detail.

Why Join Us

Modern Environment: Join a forward-thinking company that values innovation and creativity. Work on modern technologies and make a significant impact on the industry.

Collaborative Culture: Join a collaborative and inclusive team that values diverse perspectives and fosters a culture of continuous learning and growth.

Career Growth: Opportunities for professional development and career advancement. We invest in our employees' growth and provide an encouraging environment for career progression.

If you are enthusiastic about product management, possess a solid Sales and Support tech background, and see the possibilities of Generative AI, we invite you to apply. Join us in influencing the future of customer experience!

The Opportunity

The ATS Creativity & Productivity (C&P) Business Capability, Design & Delivery (BCDD) team is looking for an experienced Senior Manager to lead the CRM and Omnichannel product pillar within the Integrated Customer Experience (ICX) RTM organization.

This role is responsible for defining and driving the AI first product strategy and delivery for:

CRM platforms supporting transactional Sales and Support teams

High velocity sales experience including tooling

Omnichannel communication platforms (chat, phone, messaging, contact center capabilities)

Advisor-facing workflow automation and intelligent routing

AI-enabled Advisor productivity capabilities

You will build trusted relationships across ICX leadership and drive a disciplined product perspective within your team. You will simplify and optimize complex end to end workflows in a highly matrixed environment.

You will articulate and influence at the VP and Senior Director level to drive transformation, particularly in areas of AI/GenAI enablement, platform modernization, and service reliability.

You will collaborate closely with Architecture, Engineering, UX, Analytics, and Vendor partners to prototype, validate, and scale solutions that improve advisor productivity, operational efficiency, and customer experience.

What You’ll Do

Rapidly understand the ICX operating model and find opportunities to streamline critical workflows to drive measurable business value.

Own and evolve the product vision and multi-quarter roadmap for CRM and internal sales transactional platforms.

Present quarterly roadmap progress, platform health, and business impact to VP/Sr. Directors.

Drive AI-first innovation across platforms, including intelligent case routing, automation, agent assist, and workflow optimization.

Strengthen vendor engagement (e.g., CRM and CCaaS platforms, strategic cloud vendors) to ensure roadmap alignment and platform value realization.

Improve service reliability and operational excellence by embedding SLAs, root-cause accountability, and technical debt reduction into product ownership.

Make thoughtful trade-offs that balance quality, business value, scalability, and delivery timelines.

Mentor and grow a high-performing team across global locations.

Needed to Succeed

10+ years of experience in software product management, including leadership of Product Managers in enterprise environments.

Proven track record delivering complex enterprise platforms such as CRM systems, internal sales tools, case management systems, or omnichannel contact center platforms.

Experience modernizing legacy systems into scalable, AI-enabled platforms.

Practical knowledge of enterprise applications and integrations across CRM, service platforms, workflow automation, and cloud ecosystems.

Proven ability to lead distributed teams across geographies.

Intense curiosity in emerging AI/GenAI technologies and their application to advisor productivity and customer interaction platforms.

MBA or Masters degree preferred.

Interest in mentoring and growing product managers while fostering a focused product approach in everything we do.

Attention to detail with a proactive attitude and the ability to work as part of a distributed team across North America and India.

Intense curiosity and a sincere interest in learning new technologies, platforms, business processes.

Adobe Firefly’s Applied Science & Machine Learning (ASML) group is seeking research scientists and engineers passionate about conditional generation and editing of large-scale generative AI models. They will concentrate on images and videos. Our aim is to advance generative AI and ensure models have high quality and controllability.

We are especially seeking candidates experienced in large-scale, industry-grade pre-training and mid-training of multi-modality generative models. This role directly influences the quality of Adobe’s image and video generation models, supporting next-generation creative workflows for millions of users.

As an Applied Scientist at Adobe, you will join a world-class team of applied researchers and engineers building the future of digital experiences. You will have the opportunity to innovate across the full training stack, collaborate across data, modeling, and product, and see your work ship to customers worldwide.

Job Responsibilities

Conduct innovative research and development in training large-scale generative AI models for image and video synthesis.

Develop, carry out, and carefully evaluate sophisticated techniques for conditional generation and editing. This work emphasizes improving instruction adherence, controllability, and the visual quality of pre-trained image and video models.

Collaborate cross-functionally with researchers, engineers, and product teams to translate multimodal innovations into scalable downstream applications coordinated within Adobe products.

Define and build comprehensive evaluation frameworks and benchmarking pipelines to assess generative models across quality, efficiency, safety, and reliability, establishing guidelines and standards for the organization.

Translate research concepts and published work into production-ready implementations using Python and modern machine learning frameworks.

Collaborate with technical leads to build long-term technical strategy and roadmap, while mentoring and guiding junior engineers and researchers to elevate team capability and impact.

What you'll need to succeed

Hold a Master’s or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a closely related area.

Extensive practical experience in large-scale generative AI training emphasizing the creation and modification of images and videos.

Familiarity with diffusion models, transformers, or other brand new generative architectures.

Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate across cross-functional teams.

Strong coding and prototyping ability in Python, PyTorch, and ML infrastructure tools.

Working with product teams on technology transfers

Strong history of publications in Computer Science, AI/ML, or related areas

The Opportunity

Adobe empowers individuals and organizations to create exceptional content effortlessly. The AI for Engineering team builds a scalable, production-grade AI platform that powers creativity across design, imaging, motion, and personalization.

We are seeking a Staff Engineer - AI for Engineering to design and build the next-generation AI systems that bring intelligent, adaptive, and agentic experiences to Adobe Express.

This role is ideal for an engineer who deeply understands how modern LLMs and generative models behave in real-world systems — including reasoning patterns, tool use, prompt dynamics, failure modes, and orchestration strategies — and can translate that understanding into scalable, production-ready platforms.

You will define and build the end-to-end architecture that enables Agentic AI solutions solving real engineering problems— spanning model orchestration, tool integration, memory systems, inference services, data flows, evaluation loops, and real-time decision systems.

This is a systems-first AI role focused on building intelligent platforms.

What You’ll Do

A core part of this role is building scalable Agentic AI platforms that empower developers, significantly boost engineering productivity, and accelerate AI adoption across the organization.

Architect and evolve the AI platform powering Adobe Engineering — with a strong emphasis on Agentic AI systems and LLM-native architectures.

Design and implement scalable orchestration layers that coordinate LLMs, tools, APIs, memory stores, and multi-step reasoning workflows.

Build production-grade agent frameworks that support planning, task decomposition, tool invocation, multi-agent collaboration, and persistent memory.

Develop high-performance inference and runtime systems with strong guarantees around latency, reliability, observability, and cost efficiency.

Design evaluation and feedback systems that measure reasoning quality, task success, hallucination rates, and agent behavior — enabling rapid iteration and continuous improvement.

Integrate first-party and third-party foundation models into cohesive, adaptive systems using routing, model selection, guardrails, and fallback strategies.

Design data flows, session-level intelligence, and contextual memory systems that allow agents to operate coherently across interactions.

Partner with applied research, product, and platform teams to bring intelligent agentic capabilities into real developer-facing experiences.

Drive architectural strategy for AI for Engineering — connecting models, reasoning engines, tools, and data streams into adaptive AI systems.

Mentor senior engineers in modern AI system design, LLM orchestration patterns, and agent platform architecture.

What You’ll Bring

10+ years of experience building large-scale distributed systems, AI platforms, or intelligent service architectures.

Deep understanding of how LLMs behave in production environments — including prompting strategies, reasoning chains, tool usage, grounding techniques, hallucination mitigation, guardrails, and evaluation patterns.

Strong experience building AI-powered systems using LLM orchestration frameworks, model routing strategies, and multi-model pipelines.

Hands-on experience designing agentic systems — including reasoning loops, memory persistence, tool integration, state management, and multi-agent coordination.

Proven expertise in building scalable, cloud-native, microservices-based architectures with strong observability and reliability.

Experience designing evaluation systems for generative AI quality, task completion, and behavioral robustness.

Proficiency in TypeScript, Python and at least one systems language (Java, Go, C++), with experience building production AI services.

Strong systems thinking — ability to connect model capabilities, runtime constraints, and product requirements into coherent architectures.

Excellent multi-functional communication skills, with experience influencing architectural direction across research and engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience architecting AI assistants, copilots, or agent platforms in production environments.

Experience working with multimodal generative systems (text, image, video, motion).

Familiarity with tool-augmented LLM systems, RAG architectures, vector databases, and contextual memory systems.

Exposure to evaluation frameworks for generative AI quality and safety.

Experience contributing to open-source AI frameworks or publishing technical thought leadership.

The Challenge

As a Staff Cyber Threat Hunter, you will direct proactive threat hunting campaigns to reveal advanced adversary activity that avoids standard defense mechanisms. You will act as a self-motivated technical leader. You will lead in-depth hunts and convert uncertain signals into justifiable conclusions. You will evolve findings into scalable improvements related to threat identification and prevention.

This role suits someone passionate about cybersecurity who enjoys ongoing learning, contemporary data analysis, and creating solutions to lower attacker dwell time and business risk.

What You Will Do

Lead hunt campaigns: threat model, scope, implement, and complete high-complexity hunting campaigns informed by threat intelligence and business risk. Document hunting approach, research, and outcomes with actionable insights for long-term knowledge retention.

Apply data-driven techniques: leverage statistical and ML-based hunting methods to analyze large datasets, identify anomalies, and surface weak signals at scale.

Operationalize results: partner with Detection Engineering to convert hunt findings into durable detections, analytics, and improved instrumentation.

Build automation: develop simple tools and automated solutions to fast-track hunting and investigation workflows through Python, APIs, and up-to-date development methods.

Collaborate broadly: work closely with CSIRT, Threat Intelligence, Red Team, Security Engineering, and product teams to create multi-functional security impact.

Communicate clearly: distill complex investigations and risk into clear, actionable updates for technical collaborators and senior leadership.

Mentor others: share knowledge and guidelines to raise the overall maturity and efficiency of the threat hunting program.

What You Need

Staff-level expertise: demonstrable ability to operate independently in unstructured problem spaces and lead complex technical investigations.

Deep hunting experience: strong background investigating modern environments (cloud, Kubernetes, endpoints, CI/CD, identity, networking) and applying adversary TTP knowledge.

Passion for cybersecurity: genuine enthusiasm for threat hunting and staying current with evolving threats, attacker innovation, and defensive techniques.

Continuous learner: actively keeps skills updated with new technology trends, including AI-enabled systems and emerging AI-related threats.

Engineering approach: experience building automation and workflow improvements using Python, APIs, Git, and CI/CD pipelines.

Query expertise: advanced proficiency with SIEM and data platform query languages such as SPL, SQL, KQL, or equivalent.

ML-aware approach: understanding of ML and statistical concepts (e.g., anomaly detection, baselining) and how to apply them in threat hunting.

Experience: Over 10 years in cybersecurity specializing in detection and response.

The Opportunity

Adobe’s Digital Video & Audio group develops some of the most innovative and popular creative tools worldwide. These include Premiere, After Effects, and Audition, available on desktop, mobile, web, and cloud.

AI is fundamentally transforming how creators imagine, produce, and share content. We’re looking for a passionate Machine Learning Engineer who is excited about turning innovative research into intuitive, reliable product experiences used by millions of creators worldwide.

In this position, you will work closely with senior engineers, applied researchers, and diverse collaborators to turn experimental ML prototypes into scalable, production-ready systems. If you enjoy tackling complex machine learning problems in video, audio, and multimodal media — and feel driven by having your innovations incorporated into real products — this is an outstanding chance to create meaningful impact.

You will gain hands-on exposure to production-scale ML systems while directly crafting how AI powers Adobe’s creative ecosystem.

What You’ll Do

Drive the development of ML-powered features from early-stage research prototypes to robust production deployments.

Compose, build, and optimize scalable ML pipelines for video understanding, multimodal intelligence, and generative AI applications.

Implement, experiment with, and fine-tune brand new deep learning models across Computer Vision, Video AI, and Generative AI domains.

Solve real-world creator challenges involving spatial, temporal, and multimodal data.

Lead model evaluation, benchmarking, validation, and performance optimization to ensure high quality and reliability.

Optimize and deploy models across heterogeneous environments (CPU/GPU/NPU), including ONNX and CoreML workflows.

Improve model efficiency through quantization, pruning, distillation, and inference acceleration techniques.

Write clean, modular, maintainable, and well-tested production-quality ML code.

Collaborate cross-functionally with researchers, product managers, designers, and platform engineers to deliver impactful roadmap-aligned features.

Remain updated on emerging ML techniques and actively integrate innovations into video and media workflows.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

5+ years of hands-on experience in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, or related domains.

Proven experience building, scaling, and deploying ML models in production environments with measurable impact.

Strong proficiency in PyTorch (preferred) or TensorFlow, and Python-based ML development.

Solid foundations in mathematical modeling, including Linear Algebra, Probability, Statistics, and optimization theory.

Deep understanding of core ML principles: model training, validation, generalization, and performance trade-offs.

Strong grasp of deep learning architectures including CNNs, RNNs, Transformers, and multimodal models. Clear understanding of when and why to apply each architecture for spatial, temporal, or cross-modal tasks.

Practical experience in computer vision tasks such as object detection, segmentation, tracking, video understanding, or temporal modeling.

Familiarity with model optimization and deployment techniques including pre/post training quantization, ONNX, CoreML, and edge deployment.

Understanding of software engineering guidelines including version control (Git), testing frameworks, CI/CD, and code review processes.

Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving ability, and curiosity to learn in a fast-evolving AI landscape.

Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively within diverse, high-performing teams.

Why You’ll Love This Role

Develop AI systems that support millions of creators around the world.

See your ideas move from research to real-world impact.

Collaborate with world-class engineers and researchers.

Address significant, large-scale ML challenges in video and media.

Grow in an environment that values innovation, ownership, and continuous learning.

Hands-on use or administration of Adobe Experience Platform (AEP)

Deep domain expertise in one or more industries (Retail, Telecom, Healthcare, Automotive, Cloud and Streaming platforms, etc.)

Experience with programming languages (e.g., Python or Bash scripting)

Manage the transformation and the partnership from start to finish - from initial pre-sales planning through early delivery, adoption, and value realisation.

Connect commercial goals and delivery efforts, ensuring the vision sold is the vision delivered.

Secure and sustain C-suite confidence, building trusted advisor relationships grounded in clarity, insight, and strategic mentorship.

Partner with licence and services sellers to win groundbreaking platform deals and secure the services partnerships that anchor long-term value.

Orchestrate delivery teams, architects, and partners, ensuring build integrity, sequencing, and measurable progress.

Act as a key driver in the customer’s transformation delivery programme, modelling standard methodology, resolving blockers, and accelerating momentum.

Establish governance and risk routines that keep complex programmes aligned, accountable, and on track.

Ability to influence and encourage senior executives, securing belief, investment, and alignment.

Critical thinking grounded in real-world delivery, including the ability to translate AI-enabled futures into actionable plans.

We're seeking a Senior Software Development Engineer with extensive frontend experience to join the Adobe Target team. What You Bring

8+ years of experience building production-grade web applications with a strong frontend focus

Extensive knowledge of React and contemporary JavaScript/TypeScript (ES6+), accompanied by a strong grasp of component-based architecture

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience in the field

Nice to Have

Experience with state management libraries (Redux, Zustand, Recoil)

Familiarity with building systems (Spectrum, Storybook, or similar)

Exposure to backend technologies (Node.js, GraphQL, REST APIs)

Experience working on developer-facing tools, SDKs, or platform products

Contributions to open source projects

About the Role

Adobe Customer Solutions is seeking an Adoption Digital Strategist – AI Transformation to support enterprise clients as they evolve their operating models, organizational structures, and ways of working to enable AI at scale.

This role is ideal for a transformation practitioner with strong analytical and organizational design skills who is passionate about how AI reshapes team structures, decision rights, governance, and execution models. The Adoption Digital Strategist partners with senior strategists and program leaders to design and implement future-state operating models that support sustainable AI adoption.

What You’ll Do

Support AI Operating Model Design

• Contribute to future-state operating model design for AI-enabled organizations
• Analyze current-state organizational structures, governance, and workflows
• Map decision rights, accountability structures, and cross-functional processes
• Support the design of new roles, team structures, and capability models required for AI adoption
• Help define governance forums and escalation pathways

Drive Organizational Design & Ways of Working

• Conduct stakeholder interviews and working sessions to assess organizational readiness
• Develop org design options, RACI matrices, and role clarity documentation
• Identify structural barriers to AI adoption and propose practical redesign solutions
• Support implementation of new operating rhythms and collaboration models
• Help align marketing, digital, IT, data, and operations functions around shared AI objectives

Enable Program-Level Adoption

• Translate AI strategy into practical operating model components for Adobe Products
• Support adoption planning across workstreams and business units
• Identify adoption risks tied to organizational design gaps
• Partner with program management to embed operating model changes into overall governance

Support Executive & Leadership Engagement

• Prepare executive-ready power points outlining operating model recommendations
• Support visioning and design workshops focused on AI organizational implications
• Communicate complex organizational concepts clearly and practically
• Present workstream outputs with confidence and structure

Measure & Sustain Adoption

• Define operating model success metrics (role clarity, decision velocity, governance effectiveness)
• Support tracking of AI usage and behavioral shifts tied to structural changes
• Contribute to governance mechanisms that institutionalize AI-enabled ways of working

What You Bring

Required Qualifications

• 3–6 years of experience in digital transformation, operating model design, organizational design, and top tier Management Consulting experience 
• Experience supporting enterprise or multi-workstream transformation programs
• Working knowledge of organizational design frameworks and governance models
• Strong analytical skills and ability to translate strategy into structural recommendations
• Clear written and verbal communication skills and expert level power point design skills
• Bachelor’s degree required
• Willingness to travel to client sites as needed

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in consulting, professional services, or enterprise transformation teams
• Exposure to AI-enabled transformation programs
• Prosci ADKAR certification / Adobe DX /DME experience
