The Opportunity

We are seeking a highly experienced and innovative Staff Software Engineer to join the GenStudio Engineering team. This role is ideal for a technical leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is passionate about building scalable, high-impact software solutions. You will drive architectural decisions, mentor engineers, and influence the technical direction of GenStudio.

What You’ll Do

Design, build, test, and maintain AI/ML-based systems and applications that serve as the backbone of scalable, production-ready technology stacks.

Frame product features as ML tasks (e.g., classification, recommendation, context engineering).

Analyze trade-offs across cost, latency, and accuracy while ensuring compliance with UX, privacy, legal, and security constraints.

Assess data distribution (variance, sampling, drift) and manage data labeling workflows involving LLMs, SMEs, or user-generated activity.

Organize datasets for training, validation, and testing, and engineer high-quality features using normalization, smoothing, and weighting techniques.

Implement and adapt techniques from academic research and industry papers; evaluate algorithmic trade-offs considering data requirements, latency, and runtime.

Handle cold-start scenarios and mitigate overfitting/underfitting challenges.

Define offline benchmarks and metrics; design and analyze A/B tests to validate online performance.

Architect scalable ML systems (e.g., multi-agent, recommender, active learning, multi-stage model training, enterprise search) for both offline and online workflows.

Optimize model development and deployment in GPU/TPU environments using PyTorch.

Work cross-functionally with data, research, and product teams to translate models into production-ready services.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

10+ years of experience in software engineering, with a strong track record of technical leadership.

Bachelor's or advanced degree in Computer Science or a related field (or equivalent experience).

Deep understanding of front and back-end development technologies, including JavaScript library like React, Java and NodeJS

Proficiency in Python (especially for data workflows) and experience with ML/DL frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow/Keras, CUDA, Hugging Face, and JAX.

Proven expertise in Machine Learning and Deep Learning, including model design, optimization, and fine-tuning.

Strong understanding of transfer learning principles and their application in production settings.

Experience designing and deploying scalable AI/ML systems optimized for GPU/TPU environments.

Solid grasp of data engineering concepts—including dataset management, feature engineering, and handling data drift.

Ability to balance theoretical ML knowledge with practical, high-performance implementation.

Strong understanding of how to transform models into reliable, production-grade services.

Preferred Attributes

Recognized as a leader with vision within and beyond the organization.

Experience mentoring senior engineers and shaping engineering culture.

Demonstrated ability to drive innovation and evangelize new technologies.

Experience with building GenAI-first applications.

Contributions to industry forums, conferences, or open-source communities.

The Opportunity

The Americas is Adobe’s largest region, and you will join at a key moment to design, develop, and help deliver our future. You will work closely with senior sales leaders in the region to improve our business. As the head of Renewals Sales Strategy and Operations in the Americas, you will focus on driving strong recurring revenue growth and managing change across Enterprise Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, and Partners.

We seek someone with a customer experience focus who is both highly effective and efficient. They must think strategically and be ready to tackle hands-on work.

We’ll need you to develop and drive the renewals strategy and maintain a regular schedule of business reviews. You will also manage day-to-day operations within the Americas while working with a global cross-functional team for support.

What you’ll do

Work in close partnership with sales and customer success executive leadership to direct the operations of the renewals business

Manage field sales and ecosystem annual planning, encompassing the determination of financial objectives, organizational setup, account distribution, capacity modeling, territory allocation, quota setting, and compensation frameworks for the renewals business.

Lead, coordinate and refine the renewal forecasting cadence, processes and artifacts, driving predictability.

Develop and implement productivity and performance reporting for renewals management, individuals, and account opportunity.

Support and optimize the renewals strategy including core sales processes and efficiency drivers, infrastructure and automation, regional performance and Enterprise Data Driven Operating model.

Establish highly repeatable (and scalable) sales processes, automation and reporting methodology, both quantitative and qualitative that can be implemented across regions, and provide deep insights.

Lead key sales productivity initiatives across Americas; focused on customer success, retention, bookings growth and ecosystem alignment

Maintain strong relationships with Americas peers and collaborators to evaluate effectiveness of programs and impact of operational strategies, programs and improvements

Effectively partner and appropriately challenge leadership to effectively overachieve targets and instill centralized processes.

Accountability to assist renewals teams to improve performance through the development and driving deep adoption of both strategic and tactical programs.

Conduct historical reviews of performance, and use predictively to direct the business to improved performance.

What's needed to succeed

Experience leading a premier, sophisticated Renewal Strategy and Operations function driving significant financial advancement.

A high-performance self-starter and people leader capable of leading and developing a high performing centralized but distributed operational team responsible for supporting $1B+ of revenues.

A consistent success record in delivering strategic advice and operational management in Renewals Strategy and Operations within a complex technology sales environment.

Adobe has shaped the creative industry for decades. But with emerging creators, we should continuously evolve how we show up: more creator-native, culturally fluent, and embedded in the ecosystems shaping the future of creativity. We’re looking for a Principal Product Marketing Manager, Community & Culture to define and activate the cultural strategy that fuels our growth with creators and creative technologists.

This is a high-impact role that will co-lead the global community and cultural marketing strategy for creators across next-generation Adobe products, sitting within Product Marketing and in deep partnership with our community and global marketing organizations.

You will build the creator community roadmap in close partnership with the Community team, shape cultural positioning, and ensure our presence across community, social, and influencer channels is strategically aligned and culturally resonant.

You will translate cultural insight into measurable brand relevance, buzz, and creator adoption, while building the feedback loops that influence product strategy, go-to-market planning, and inbound PMM priorities.

What You’ll Do

Set a clear vision for creator community and cultural marketing, aligning strategy with Adobe’s broader product and growth goals.

Build and evolve the global community marketing roadmap for creators across next-gen Adobe offerings.

Identify priority creator segments, subcultures, affinities and emerging creative ecosystems that represent future growth opportunities.

Develop scalable frameworks that translate cultural trends and platform behaviors into strategic marketing activation.

Market & Cultural Intelligence

Engage directly with creators and the broader creative AI ecosystem to surface insight, sentiment, and unmet needs.

Bring a forward-looking POV on where creative culture, AI, and the creator economy are headed—and where opportunities are emerging or underserved.

Synthesize market research, audience segmentation, and competitive analysis to identify strategic growth opportunities.

Convert fast-moving cultural signals and community intelligence into brand-relevant positioning, launch strategies, and actionable recommendations that inform product roadmap and customer experience.

Product Positioning & Messaging

Define and communicate culturally resonant value propositions for Adobe’s creator-focused products and initiatives.

Craft messaging and narratives that shift perception from “legacy and complex” to creator-native, culturally fluent, and AI-forward.

Ensure consistency of positioning and messaging across social, influencer, community, and product marketing channels.

Go-to-Market Leadership

Partner with product, other PMMs, and marketing leads to shape go-to-market strategies that break through with new-to-Adobe audiences through cultural marketing and community channels.

Ensure product launches reflect authentic creator insights and community sentiment.

Develop playbooks that regional and global teams can use to activate culturally-led growth strategies.

Driving Business Impact Through Cultural Relevance

Define how community engagement drives measurable outcomes including brand relevance, buzz, creator acquisition, and conversion.

Develop and implement campaigns and programs that deliver measurable return on investment, using data and analytics to optimize performance.

Establish learning systems that scale what works and continuously refine positioning.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Influence

Lead cross-functional alignment across social, influencer, product, research, and regional marketing teams.

Review briefs and creative direction emerging from community and influencer initiatives to ensure cultural alignment and strategic rigor.

Present strategies, insights, and recommendations to senior leadership to influence decision-making and investment priorities.

Act as a key liaison between marketing, product, and community teams to ensure seamless collaboration.

10+ years of experience in product marketing, community, cultural strategy, creator marketing, or related roles.

Exceptional strategic, analytical, and storytelling skills, with the ability to turn cultural and community insight into structured marketing strategy.

Strong creative judgment and credibility, with experience collaborating closely with designers, creators, and creative teams.

Deep understanding of social behaviors, network effects, and viral growth patterns, with the ability to partner with Product and PMM to translate product-led growth opportunities into community driven adoption.

Thrives in fast-moving, ambiguous environments, balancing scrappy execution with the ability to bring clarity through disciplined frameworks, playbooks, and plans.

Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and mentor junior team members.

Experience working within highly matrixed, global organizations and influencing senior team members.

BS Degree in Marketing, Business is preferred or 10+ years’ experience in Marketing or equivalent practical experience.

Deep understanding of how creative culture forms and how content travels across platforms globally.

Strong POV on AI, creative tools, and the evolving creator economy.

We have a fantastic opportunity for a Principal Enterprise Architect Professional Services to join our team based in Copenhagen.

As a Principal Enterprise Architect Professional Services, you will guide architecture through the transformation lifecycle. You will build executive confidence, govern design decisions, lead architecture build, and make sure technology choices support long-term value.

What you’ll do

You will bridge business goals and technical delivery by designing target architectures, planning transitions, and creating decommissioning strategies. Using change management frameworks such as ADKAR, you'll support adoption and sustainability.

Key Responsibilities

Assess and advance the architectural intent crafted during pre-sales.

Provide architectural leadership across the full transformation lifecycle and guide platform adoption and evolution.

Convert the success roadmap created during pre-sales into a comprehensive, managed transition plan featuring clear sequencing, decision points, and risk controls.

Formulate robust, industry-specific architectural perspectives and translate them into target-state architecture, reference models, and phased implementation plans.

Foster and maintain executive trust in architectural direction, serving as a strategic advisor to senior business and technology collaborators.

Collaborate with licensing and services sales teams to improve major sales initiatives.

Coordinate architectural efforts among delivery teams, subject matter experts, and partners to ensure build integrity and alignment during execution.

Establish and lead architecture governance and assurance forums.

Partner closely with pre‑sales teams to ensure lessons learned, build patterns, and reference architectures continually improve future pursuits and delivery outcomes.

What you’ll need to succeed

Proven experience providing enterprise architecture leadership across large-scale transformation programmes, from early visioning and pre-sales through delivery, adoption, and platform evolution.

Strong grounding in TOGAF principles and lifecycle-based architecture governance, applied pragmatically in complex enterprise environments.

Broad understanding of digital marketing, data, and activation ecosystems.

The ability to craft compelling narratives that translate architectural choices into business-relevant results and messages suitable for executives.

Experience operating as a trusted architectural advisor to senior executives.

Strong understanding of AI, automation, and emerging agentic models, and their implications for enterprise platforms.

Experience working closely with delivery teams, partners, and vendors to maintain build integrity.

Ability to apply structured change and adoption approaches (including ADKAR) to support the human and organisational aspects of architectural evolution.

A collaborative, outcome-focused leadership style, with a relentless focus on value and adoption.

Fluency in English and Danish is required. Any other european language would be a plus.

Real impact at scale: your work directly enables millions of users to create and collaborate

Job Title: Principal Value Consultant

Job Summary

We are seeking a strategic Value Consultant dedicated to advancing the development of our Value Consulting organization at Adobe. This role emphasizes building compelling arguments to demonstrate the value of Adobe Firefly Services and solutions to prospective clients while driving sales and customer adoption. The ideal candidate will possess a solid grasp of software sales processes, value-based selling, and have experience translating technical features into business benefits. They will also have a solid understanding of go-to-market and business skills to help customers understand how to use Adobe software to drive business outcomes and present to influencers as well as executive decision makers.

Key Responsibilities

Develop Business Cases: Work with sales teams, including Account Executives, Solution Consultants, and Solution Architects. Build detailed arguments to demonstrate the return on investment and value of our software solutions. 

Design Value Frameworks: Refine frameworks for value consulting that can be consistently applied across different products and client scenarios.

Client Engagement: Work directly with clients to understand their needs and challenges, in order to articulate how Adobe solutions can create measurable value for their business.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with product management, marketing, and leadership to ensure alignment on value messaging and capability. Gather insights that inform argument development.

Training and Enablement: Create and deliver training sessions for sales teams to enhance their understanding of Value Consulting methodologies and to equip them with tools for effective client engagement.

Metrics and Reporting: Help develop and support objective and key results to measure the effectiveness of value consulting initiatives and provide data for regular reports to senior management on progress and outcomes.

Market Research: Stay updated on industry trends, competitive landscape, and customer needs to continuously refine value propositions and argument strategies.

What you need to succeed:

Masters in Business Administration (MBA), Marketing, or a related experience.

5+ years of experience in a consulting, sales, or product management role within the software industry.

Strong understanding of case development and value-based selling principles.

Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex information in a clear and compelling manner.

Proven track record of collaborating with cross-functional teams and getting results in a fast-paced environment.

Analytical approach with the ability to interpret data and insights to inform strategic decisions.

Familiarity with financial modeling and analysis.

Experience in customer engagement and relationship management.

Knowledge of software solutions and technology trends relevant to our industry.

The Adobe Customer Solutions Engagement Manager leads substantial, innovative engagements for critical Adobe accounts. Acting as a trusted advisor and strategic guide, you help Sales and Delivery teams align projects with customers’ objectives. Recognized as a business contributor and delivery specialist, you are the primary customer contact in a billable capacity. You drive the delivery of desired results while preserving strong executive connections.

This position merges excellent delivery and client relationship supervision, concentrating on client and partner communication, cross-functional teamwork, and technical skills to advance business transformation. Success requires collaborating across people, process, and technology with an industry or customer practitioner perspective to produce measurable customer value.

What You'll Do

Customer Engagement & Delivery Leadership

The role manages the success of a defined set of strategic Services customers in the region. It ensures customer requirements are met and that engagements deliver measurable business value aligned to customer priorities. It acts as the primary contact for customer executives and coordinates with partners across the customer’s broader ecosystem. After contract booking, it ensures a smooth and efficient transition from Sales to Delivery. It works closely with Sales, Delivery, and Product teams to align on customer success plans and find opportunities to drive value across Adobe solutions. It serves as the main point of contact at senior management level, resolving customer issues quickly and keeping engagements on track.

Operational Excellence

You are responsible for driving accurate and effective revenue management, including growth and margin execution, revenue acceleration, backlog burn, contract expiration and extension management, and close alignment with Adobe Finance and Operations.

You manage the Services team by coordinating team staffing, onboarding, and transitions within the assigned account(s).

Services Expansion & Opportunity Development

You will partner closely with Adobe Sales to build new services opportunities and support contract extensions, change requests, and addendum. The technician will carry out all testing associated with Batch Release & Microbiological Analysis and Environmental monitoring.

BSc in Microbiology or related Scientific discipline.

Skills & Experience

Strong understanding of compliance and quality standards.

Very good understanding of microbiological techniques & methods used.

Computer skills including Word & Excel. Familiarity/experience with LIMs an advantage.

Excellent attention to detail & strong interpersonal skills.

Batch testing is critical to overall quality of the product. Incorrect results could potentially lead to a rejected batch or distressed inventory.

Manager, Foundry COE Enterprise Sales (FLM)

Our Company
Changing the world through digital experiences.

At Adobe, we empower people and businesses to create exceptional digital experiences. Firefly Foundry represents the next frontier of this mission — where creativity, technology, and enterprise transformation converge through the power of generative AI.

The Opportunity

Firefly Foundry enables organizations to build proprietary, IP-protected generative AI models trained on their own brand and creative assets. As a Manager in Adobe’s Foundry COE Enterprise Sales organization, you will lead a team of sellers responsible for early customer engagement, opportunity development, and driving adoption of Foundry within enterprise accounts.

In this role, you will set team-level strategy, define execution priorities, and shape how your sellers engage with customers in this emerging market. You’ll take the broader direction established by the Director (SLM) and translate it into clear operating plans, territory approaches, and repeatable motions for your team.

You are both a strategic leader and a hands-on coach — driving clarity, sharpening deal strategy, and guiding your team through complex enterprise engagements. You’ll partner closely with cross-functional leaders to ensure field insights directly inform product evolution, positioning, and GTM iteration.

This is a high-impact leadership role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, brings strong sales and product intuition, and is eager to help build a new motion from the ground up.

What You’ll Do

Team Leadership & Direction Setting

Lead, develop, and mentor a team of Foundry sellers focused on strategic enterprise opportunities.

Set direction for your team — defining quarterly focus areas, customer engagement strategies, and early-market plays aligned to Foundry’s broader GTM.

Establish the operating rhythms, goals, and performance expectations that drive a culture of accountability and execution excellence.

Act as a player-coach, supporting key deals while empowering sellers to lead with confidence.

Strategic Sales Execution

Shape the team’s approach to segmentation, account prioritization, and early-market validation.

Guide sellers in articulating value, identifying high-impact use cases, and developing multi-threaded enterprise relationships.

Partner with regional and enterprise leadership to ensure alignment in account coverage and customer strategy.

Lead deal reviews, sharpen deal strategy, and ensure consistent execution across the sales cycle.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Collaborate deeply with Product, Engineering, and Strategy to share structured customer insights from your team’s engagements.

Influence product fit, roadmap considerations, and solution positioning based on early patterns observed in the field.

Support rollout and adoption of new product capabilities, messaging, and GTM plays.

Serve as a trusted partner to cross-functional leaders, ensuring your team’s customer learnings meaningfully shape Foundry’s evolution.

Operational Excellence

Drive forecasting accuracy, pipeline discipline, and strong data hygiene across your team.

Identify trends, competitive shifts, and early adoption patterns to inform team strategy and GTM adjustments.

Develop lightweight, repeatable practices and playbooks your sellers can adopt as Foundry scales.

Ensure your team operates with clarity, predictability, and high trust across internal stakeholders.

What You Need to Succeed

Required Qualifications

8+ years of enterprise software sales experience with 1–3 years in people leadership.

Proven success coaching and developing high-performing sellers.

Demonstrated ability to set direction, establish structure, and bring clarity to ambiguous environments.

Strong collaboration skills and comfort working with Product, Engineering, and Strategy partners.

Excellent communication, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills.

Understanding of content workflows, digital asset management, or creative operations.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with generative AI or creative automation platforms.

Familiarity with the Adobe ecosystem (Creative Cloud, Experience Cloud, Firefly).

History supporting or scaling early-stage product sales motions.

Background in content-heavy or transformation-focused industries.

What’s In It for You

Lead and develop a team operating at the cutting edge of enterprise generative AI.

Drive foundational customer engagements that shape the future of how organizations use AI for creativity.

Collaborate closely with world-class cross-functional partners.

Grow your leadership career within a high-visibility, high-impact organization.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Business Operations Lead to serve within the Ultimate Success team, within our strategic accounts segment, designed to deliver a differentiated, cross-functional engagement model.

In this role, you will serve as the operational backbone and decision enabler for senior leadership (Director+), driving alignment, governance, and performance visibility across strategy, data, programs, and delivery/resource management.

You will establish and own the operating model for the Signature Program—ensuring clear accountability, a unified reference point on program health, and disciplined execution across cross-functional collaborators. You will lead steering committees and executive forums for priority initiatives, framing decisions, driving closure, and ensuring commitments translate into measurable outcomes.

As a core member of this segment’s leadership team, you will bring structure to complexity, proactively surface risks and tradeoffs, and materially increase leadership effectiveness by reducing ambiguity, preventing surprises, and ensuring follow-through.

Examples of What You’ll Do

Own and Enforce the Signature Operating Model

Define, document, and continuously improve how the Signature Program operates (cadence, metrics, governance).

Act as the single source of truth for program, account, and initiative health.

Hold cross-functional collaborators accountable to agreed operating rhythms and commitments.

Enable Decisions and Drive Accountability

Guide steering committees and executive governance forums with clear objectives and outcomes.

Frame leadership conversations about decisions, options, tradeoffs, and implications.

Maintain decision logs and ensure follow-through is reflected in execution plans.

Deliver Actionable, Executive-Ready Insights

Drive requirements for decision-ready dashboards and work management systems

Deliver weekly summaries, priorities and QBRs

The Project Graph team is looking for a Principal Product Manager to lead the vision, strategy, and execution of our Graph platform, a core, highly technical product used to design, visualize, execute, and share complex workflows through graph-based systems. Project Graph powers both an advanced node-based editor and downstream, simplified experiences built on top of those graphs.

This role sits at the intersection of UX, systems design, AI-enabled workflows, and platform thinking, and requires deep empathy for advanced users such as developers, technical artists, ML practitioners, and designers.

As a principal-level PM, you will define long-term direction, tackle ambiguous problems, and work closely with engineering, design, and leadership to scale a powerful, performant, and extensible graph authoring and execution platform.

What you’ll do

Define the long-term vision and roadmap for the Graph platform, including the editor, execution model, plugins, APIs, extensibility, and interoperability across products and surfaces.

Define what “great” looks like for graph-based authoring across beginner, advanced, and expert users, including transitions between power-user tooling and simplified downstream experiences.

Lead discovery efforts to deeply understand user workflows, pain points, and mental models in graph-based and automation-driven systems.

Translate complex user needs into clear product requirements, PRDs, and success metrics across both authoring and execution.

Collaborate with design to shape interaction patterns for node creation, connections, layouts, debugging, inspection, and working at scale.

Partner closely with engineering to break down large, ambiguous problems into shippable increments without losing architectural coherence.

Work with engineers on architecture-level decisions affecting performance, data models, rendering, and execution to ensure the system performs well with large graphs and real-world workloads.

Understand and influence systems such as graph execution models, state management, serialization, versioning, and reproducibility.

Define platform primitives that enable reuse, sharing, and distribution of graph-based workflows in different contexts.

Act as a bridge between user needs and technical realities, setting clear outcomes while avoiding prescriptive implementation decisions.

What you need to succeed

8–12+ years of product management experience, with significant ownership of complex, technical, or platform products.

Prior experience with node-based editors, visual programming tools, workflow builders, automation systems, or graph-based products, direct or adjacent.

Proven track record of shipping and iterating on sophisticated user interfaces used by expert or technical users.

Strong systems thinking with the ability to reason about interconnected components, constraints, and emergent behavior.

Deep empathy for power users and creators who rely on precision, speed, debuggability, and flexibility.

Comfort working closely with highly technical engineering teams on performance-critical, architecture-heavy systems.

Ability to operate independently at a principal level while influencing cross-functional partners.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, especially for complex and abstract concepts.

Bonus points

Background in developer tools, creative tools, game engines, VFX pipelines, ML tooling, data platforms, or automation systems.

Familiarity with graph concepts such as DAGs, execution graphs, dependency graphs, and scheduling.

Experience with extensible platforms, plugin systems, SDKs, or scripting environments.

Experience shipping products that combine authoring tools with runtime or execution environments.

Exposure to AI-driven workflows, generative systems, or model orchestration tools.

Role Description

The Technical Pre-Sales Enterprise Architect (EA) serves as the primary technical driver for closing strategic sales opportunities and enabling customer success through marketing technology value realization. For Adobe’s Top 50 customers, the EA partners with technology, promotional, and executive-level contacts. They assess current-state technology and business objectives. They deliver future-state marketing architectures, manage digital engagement roadmaps, and showcase “Art of the Possible” experiences.

Minimum Qualifications

Past experience in a lead consultative role supporting large-scale enterprise digital marketing ecosystems as an Architect, Principal Consultant or Marketing/Technical leader.

Working knowledge of end-to-end digital marketing MarTech, such as CDPs, Marketing Automation, omni-channel personalization, Journey Orchestration, Measurement and Optimization, Content Management, Content Generation, Digital Asset Management (DAM), Tag Management and Data Collection, Identity and Consent Management, CRM, Media Execution, Social Media Management, Reporting/Insights, and multi-channel activation.

Demonstrated ability aligning diverse stakeholders, managing dependencies, and driving schedule adherence to achieve strategic deal closure.

Significant hands-on experience using enterprise platforms (Adobe, Salesforce, Oracle, Microsoft, etc.) with an emphasis on REST APIs, Cloud Storage, Structured/Unstructured Data, Security and Data Ingress/Egress.

Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, value-focused narratives for technical, marketing, and executive audiences.

Skilled at diagnosing business and technical gaps and crafting forward-looking architectures aligned to strategic outcomes and measurable business value

Strong written and verbal communications skills with particular expertise in PowerPoint and Lucid Chart/Visio

Ability to travel up to 30% of the time within the United States

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science (CS), Digital Marketing or MBA or equivalent experience

Skills that Set You Apart 

One or more current Adobe Certified Expert certifications in Adobe (RTCDP, AJO, Analytics/CJA, AEM, Target or Workfront)

Recent experience building enterprise level ROI-focused Business Cases for technology transformations

Hands-on experience architecting and/or delivering native, Flutter or React-Native mobile applications

Deep understanding of B2B marketing strategies, buying journeys, and account-based engagement models.

Experience managing a Book of Business, including overseeing the ecosystem to drive deal closure, performing scope and contract reviews, and tracking value realization.

Experience with AI technologies and ability to support AI adoption in marketing use cases, accelerating onboarding to Adobe solutions and driving measurable customer success.

Proficiency with bringing to bear Generative and/or Agentic AI solutions.

Job Description- Enterprise Architect

Position Summary

As an Adobe Enterprise Architect, you will define and deliver enterprise scale digital

experience architectures that leverage Adobe Experience Cloud, AI/ML capabilities, and

modern cloud platforms. You will partner with senior business and technology leaders to

shape strategy, architecture roadmaps, and operating models that drive measurable customer

and business outcomes.

You will combine deep enterprise architecture expertise with AI, data, and cloud-native

experience to design future-ready solutions: from customer data foundations and decisioning

to personalized, omnichannel experiences. As a trusted advisor, you will guide clients through

digital, data, and AI transformation, ensuring alignment between business goals, technology

investments, and delivery teams.

Success in this role is measured by customer value and adoption, quality and feasibility of

architectures, clarity of roadmaps, impact on KPIs, and depth of trusted relationships rather

than billable hours alone.

The Opportunity

Digital is disrupting traditional business models and reshaping every stage of the customer

lifecycle. Leading organizations are turning to Adobe Experience Cloud and AI-powered

experiences to stay ahead.

Adobe’s Enterprise Architecture team is a dynamic group of senior consultants who:

• Partner with executives to define digital, data, and AI strategies.

• Design integrated architectures that connect content, data, insights, and activation.

• Help clients adopt cloud-native, API-first, and event-driven patterns on platforms such

as Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Cloud solutions, and public cloud

providers.

As an Enterprise Architect, you will use your knowledge of digital marketing technology,

AI/ML capabilities, and enterprise architecture to:

• Create strategic roadmaps for digital experience and AI innovation.

• Lead clients as a subject matter expert.

• Serve as a trusted advisor across business, data, and technology stakeholders.

What you'll Do

• Shape digital, data, and AI strategy

o Partner with executive and senior client stakeholders to define digital experience,

customer data, and AI/ML goals.

o Translate business vision into actionable multi-year architecture roadmaps

encompassing Adobe solutions, data/ML platforms, and cloud services.

o Identify key business drivers, KPIs, and value hypotheses to prioritize use cases

(e.g., personalization, journey orchestration, next-best action, marketing

optimization).

• Design enterprise and solution architectures

o Design end-to-end architectures across Adobe Experience Cloud and client

ecosystems.

o Define AI- and data-centric architectures, including: Customer data platforms,

identity, and profile management.

o Data ingestion, quality, governance, and activation patterns. Recommend futurestate

technology architectures using cloud-native principles (API-first,

microservices, event-driven, serverless) across Azure, AWS, and/or other public

clouds.

o Define reference architectures and patterns for secure, scalable cloud

deployments. Zero-trust, identity, and access management. Observability and

reliability.

• Drive alignment and governance

o Ensure alignment between business strategies, enterprise architecture, and

delivery teams across marketing, product, data, and IT.

o Define governance, operating models, and ways of working (e.g., architecture

review processes, decision forums, standards) to support sustainable adoption of

Adobe capabilities.

o Act as a liaison between Adobe teams, client business owners, IT, data/analytics,

and external partners for the full lifecycle of the engagement.

• Communicate and evangelize

o Communicate architecture options, trade-offs, and recommendations to C-level

and senior leadership using clear narratives, visuals, and value framing.

o Lead workshops, visioning sessions, and roadmap presentations that evangelize

AI and data driven digital experiences.

o Advocate for the Enterprise Architecture function and your work within the larger

Adobe Consulting organization and with clients.

• Contribute to practice growth

o Capture and codify reusable assets (reference architectures, patterns, templates,

accelerators).

o Mentor other architects and consultants on enterprise, AI, and cloud architecture

best practices.

o Support pre-sales activities (e.g., solutioning, estimations, proposals, executive

presentations) to position Adobe and EA services.

o

What you need to succeed

• proven record to develop enterprise architecture models.

• Validated experience with architecture frameworks such as API, SOA, and TOGAF

• Understanding & experience with public cloud architecture and services (Microsoft

Azure / Amazon AWS).

• Experience designing or integrating AI-powered customer experiences, including

working with LLM-based services and understanding core concepts such as prompt

design, RAG, and model evaluation strategies.

• Ability to collaborate with data/ML teams to define AI solution patterns and

guardrails, including basic awareness of agentic workflows and tool using agents, and

how they impact reliability, observability, and governance in enterprise environments.

• Experience from working with the Adobe Experience Cloud or at least one of its

solutions & Previous experience with other Digital Marketing platforms. (Good to

have).

• Experience communicating across senior leadership.

• Ability to intake client business vision and translate to technical solution and

architecture requirements.

• Clear written and verbal communication skills communicating deliverables, sharing

information, and leading meetings.

• Ability to communicate and lead execution of architecture vision across multifunctional

technical and strategy teams.

• Experience working with software engineers, data architects, application developers &

data scientists to plan out end-to-end solutions

• Understanding the solutions and systems that support it.

• Ability to communicate technical and business strategy optimally to audiences of

varying levels of experience, background, and seniority.

• Ability to travel a minimum of up to 50%.

What you'll Do 

As a Senior Solution Consultant, you’ll act as a trusted advisor to our customers - the world's most innovative companies! A strong understanding of technology and how this can drive digital transformation

Exceptional presentation skills, conversational skills and experience as a trusted advisor

Experienced in building and communicating use cases and value propositions 

Strong demonstration and value-selling experience 

Crafting end-to-end user experiences, using innovative ways to combining content, web journey, personalised experiences and marketing automation 

Self-motivated with a strong aim to succeed in a highly dynamic environment

Maintain an understanding of competitors, especially strengths and weaknesses of competitor solutions 

Develop & maintain authoritative understanding of digital technologies and marketing trends 

Provide creative and strategic content/input as part of the RFP or proposal process, presentations and client case studies 

Participate & lead in customer workshops, presentations, and other working sessions as required 

The following requirements are relevant to this role: 

Ability to conduct and lead customer workshops 

A good understanding of digital technologies in general e.g. web, mobile, CRM, etc. 

Must be self-managed, adaptable and dedicated to customer success 

Experience in a technical pre-sales, consulting, specific industry or digital marketing environment

Exceptional interpersonal, written, presentation, and communication skills

You will partner with Digital Growth & Ecommerce, A.com, Web & Mobile Product, User Research, Business Intelligence, and Marketing teams to implement with precision and approach and solve problems strategically.

Lead the mobile app store business in Japan, using existing Adobe frameworks and creating new ones as needed.

Create and run a framework for optimizing mobile web journeys to the app stores or multi-surface, multi-journey-step mobile web experiences. 

Develop deep end-to-end understanding of Japan’s key user journeys across Mobile, Social, and Web products. Translate insights into prioritized, data-driven growth recommendations and clearly communicate them to leadership to drive alignment and execution. 

Diagnose the health of a product discovery, initial use, and engagement, from exploration through to activation and repeat use, to find opportunities and deliver value to customers on an ongoing basis.

Senior Director, Security India 

About Us 

Changing the world through digital experiences is what Adobe’s all about. We give everyone—from emerging artists to global brands— everything they need to design and deliver exceptional digital experiences. We’re passionate about empowering people to build breathtaking and powerful images, videos, and apps, and transform how companies interact with customers across every screen.

We’re on a mission to hire the very best and are committed to crafting exceptional employee experiences where everyone is respected and has access to equal opportunity. We realize that new insights can come from everywhere in the organization, and we know the next big idea could be yours.

Opportunity 

Security is foundational to Adobe’s product development and operational excellence. Our security practices are deeply embedded across our software lifecycle and are continuously refined through collaboration with global partners, leading researchers, and industry organizations. These efforts ensure Adobe remains at the forefront of threat detection, prevention, and incident response.

We are seeking a Senior Director of Security India to lead and expand Adobe’s global security engineering capabilities, with a strong focus on our India operations. This executive will play a critical role in shaping Adobe’s security strategy, driving innovation, and building trust with our customers by ensuring their data is protected and privacy is preserved.

Role Summary 

As a Senior Director, you will be responsible for the strategic leadership and operational excellence of Adobe’s Security organization in India. You will collaborate closely with the CSO, global engineering leaders, and cross-functional partners to shape and drive enterprise-wide security initiatives, in addition to engaging externally with CTO/CIO/CISOs of our APAC customers. This role requires a visionary leader with deep technical expertise, strong people leadership, and a proven track record of influencing at the executive level.

What You’ll Do 

Strategic Leadership: Define and implement the long-term vision for Adobe’s security engineering function in India, aligned with global security priorities.

Site Presence: Continue to build the security brand and presence in India with leaders across Adobe.

Customer-Facing: Engage with CTO/CIO/CISOs of our APAC customer to help build trust in our products, build relationships and help answer their security related questions, and in case of a security incident, quickly come up to speed to lead customer confidence calls.

Global Collaboration: Partner with the CSO and senior leaders across engineering, legal, and cloud infrastructure to drive cohesive security strategies.

Operational Excellence: Oversee delivery of high-impact security services, ensuring operational efficiency, scalability, and continuous improvement.

Innovation & Engineering: Lead teams in developing innovative solutions for application security, cloud security, and cyber defense.

Risk Management: Champion enterprise risk mitigation strategies, including threat modeling, vulnerability management, and incident response.

Talent Development: Build and mentor a high-performing team of security engineers, researchers, and ethical hackers. Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, and inclusion.

Stakeholder Engagement: Establish trust and influence with senior executives, internal partners, and external vendors to advance Adobe’s security posture.

Compliance & Governance: Ensure adherence to global security standards, regulatory requirements, and internal policies.

Thought Leadership: Represent Adobe in industry forums, contribute to security research, and drive awareness of emerging threats and standard processes.

Complexity: Navigate a highly matrixed organization, building on strong partnerships across regions to shape security strategy, execution, and long-term Adobe success and reputation.

What You Need to Succeed 

B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Security Engineering, or related field.

15+ years of progressive experience in security engineering, including 10+ years in leadership roles with global scope.

Proven success leading large-scale security programs across cloud, application, and enterprise environments.

Deep expertise in cybersecurity frameworks, threat intelligence, and secure software development practices.

Strong understanding of infrastructure as code, security automation, and compliance as code.

Experience managing cross-functional teams, building strong partnerships across regions, influencing senior partners, and building customer relationships.

Recognized as an influential, innovative, and collaborative leader in the industry.

Certifications such as CISM, CISA, or CISSP are a plus.

Exceptional communication, critical thinking, and executive presence, both internally and externally.

Demonstrated commitment to inclusive practices.

The Opportunity

As a Value Engineer within the JAPAC Ultimate Success team, you will partner closely with Value Advisors and Account Teams to build rigorous, defensible financial models that quantify the measurable business impact of Adobe’s solutions.

Your mandate is to ensure that every value claim — from revenue uplift to retention improvement and operational efficiency — is supported by structured assumptions, credible benchmarks, and CFO-ready modelling. You will operate at the intersection of finance, analytics, and strategy, translating complex product capabilities and customer data into clear economic impact models that withstand executive scrutiny.

This role is less about leading the room and more about ensuring that when we enter it, our numbers are airtight.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Modelling & Quantification

Build robust return on investment, NPV, payback, and scenario-based financial models to quantify revenue growth, retention impact, cost efficiencies, and productivity gains.

Conduct sensitivity analysis and assumption testing to ensure models remain defensible under CFO-level scrutiny.

Structure value levers clearly and prevent double-counting across impact areas.

Translate marketing, commerce, and experience metrics into financial outcomes (margin impact, lifetime value, cost avoidance).

Develop scalable modelling templates and tools to standardise value calculations across the region.

Value Workshops and Business Case Development

Partner with Value Advisors and Account Teams to convert strategic value hypotheses into quantified economic impact to support Value Workshops and Business case development.

Document assumptions transparently and apply conservative modelling principles to maintain credibility.

Reconcile customer-supplied data with benchmarks and Adobe telemetry to ensure integrity of outputs.

Support renewals and expansion cases with defensible financial analysis.

Prepare executive-ready financial summaries that simplify complex modelling into clear decision-support outputs. 

Be able to explain, communicate and answer questions on the business case or models to customer executives.

Value Realisation Analytics

Track realised versus projected value across use cases, adoption, and Net Dollar Retention (N$R).

Analyse performance data to identify value at risk, underperformance drivers, and incremental growth opportunities.

Support quarterly business reviews with updated financial insights and scenario updates.

Maintain structured measurement frameworks to ensure consistent value tracking across strategic accounts.

Benchmarking & Methodology

Understand and leverage existing Adobe tools to support Value modelling,

Maintain and refine regional industry benchmarks and modelling assumptions.

Incorporate new Adobe product capabilities into financial impact models.

Contribute to the evolution of JAPAC value modelling frameworks, templates, and playbooks.

Support automation and AI-enabled modelling to scale analytical output while maintaining rigor.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Collaborate closely with Value Advisors, Sales, Ultimate Success teams, and Professional Services to ensure alignment between strategy and quantification.

Act as the quantitative authority during value workshops, renewal planning and expansion conversations.

Provide internal coaching on modelling rigor and financial logic.

Help embed value thinking into lifecycle planning and expansion strategies.

What you bring:

5–10+ years of experience in FP&A, Commercial Finance, Deals Advisory, Valuations, Strategy Consulting, Corporate Development, or Value Engineering.

Advanced financial modelling capability (expert Excel skills required; experience with scenario modelling and sensitivity analysis essential).

Strong understanding of SaaS economics, marketing return on investment, retention modelling, and unit economics.

Proven experience building defensible arguments for enterprise technology or digital transformation programs.

High analytical rigor and comfort challenging assumptions.

Ability to translate complex financial analysis into crisp, executive-ready outputs.

Experience supporting executive-level discussions (not necessarily leading them).

Familiarity with Adobe Experience Cloud (Customer Experience Orchestration) or similar Martech ecosystems preferred.

Proficiency in Microsoft Suite (especially advanced Excel).

About the product

Creative Cloud Desktop (CCD) and AdobeHome (CCHome) together power the primary entry points into the Creative Cloud ecosystem. CCD is the desktop control center for app discovery, installation, updates, trials, subscriptions, and in-product engagement. AdobeHome extends this experience to the web, enabling content discovery, workflow continuity, collaboration, and cross-product journeys.

As high-traffic growth surfaces, both platforms play a critical role in acquisition, conversion, personalization, and monetization. Our engineering teams build the experimentation frameworks, targeting systems, and scalable infrastructure that allow rapid campaign launches, data-driven optimization, and seamless user experiences for millions of customers worldwide.

The Opportunity

We're seeking a full stack Software Development Engineer with both frontend and backend experience to join the Growth Engineering team. You'll develop, build, and deliver high-quality web applications, libraries, and SDKs that unlocks growth features on CCD and AdobeHome. This role offers the chance to work on products used by millions daily, collaborate with skilled engineers, and lead important projects from idea to completion.

If you care deeply about developing high-performing, scalable systems and want to work on impactful technology, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Do

Develop exceptional web applications using React, TypeScript, and modern JavaScript, providing intuitive and responsive user interfaces

Build and develop micro architectures that enable independent, scalable, and maintainable modules across teams

Own projects end-to-end—from technical build and implementation to testing, deployment, and production support

Collaborate closely with product, design, data science and other partner teams to define requirements, build product direction, and deliver seamless user experiences

Champion frontend and backend guidelines, including code quality, accessibility, performance optimization, and build system adoption

Mentor and learn from teammates, contributing to a culture of continuous improvement and knowledge sharing

Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues, ensuring our applications perform reliably at scale
 

What You Bring

8+ years of experience building production-grade web applications with a strong frontend focus

Deep expertise in system architecture, distributed systems, and large-scale extensible platforms

About the Role

Changing the world through digital experiences is what Adobe's all about. We give everyone—from emerging artists to global brands—everything they need to design and deliver exceptional digital experiences! We're passionate about empowering people to create beautiful and powerful images, videos, and apps, and transform how companies interact with customers across every screen.

At Adobe, this commitment extends inward as well—empowering our own teams with powerful digital tools and insights to drive creativity, collaboration, and impact at scale. We are seeking a motivated Engineering Manager to lead our engineering team in building and scaling an internal advanced benchmark and analytics platform. This high-impact platform delivers real-time insights, customizable dashboards, interactive visualizations, and robust reporting—empowering data-driven decisions and unlocking new levels of innovation across the organization.

This role involves direct management and growth of a cross-functional engineering team. The current team comprises Frontend UI/UX Engineers using Vue.js and Backend Engineers with Node.js and Fastify, utilizing ClickHouse, Redis, and Azure Container Apps. You will balance hands-on technical support with leading the team and overseeing delivery. You will collaborate closely with product, design, data, and business team members. It is a great chance for a strong full-stack engineer ready to transition into management. You will gain support and mentorship while building key leadership skills and advancing the platform into a stable, high-performance base for Adobe's internal users.

The ideal candidate has solid full-stack expertise (frontend + backend) and experience with data-intensive applications. They are eager to grow into people management and employ modern AI coding tools to increase team productivity.

Key Responsibilities

Lead, mentor, and support a high-performing engineering team. Participate in hiring, onboarding, performance discussions, and career growth conversations. Build a collaborative, inclusive team culture with guidance from senior leadership.

Guide technical architecture and design decisions for the platform tracking critical metrics. Stay hands-on when necessary with frontend (Vue.js), backend (Node.js + Fastify), data layer (ClickHouse, Redis), and deployment (Azure Container Apps).

Partner with product managers to define and complete the engineering roadmap. Prioritize features, address technical debt, improve performance and scalability, and enhance reliability to deliver business value.

Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, design sessions, and technical planning to uphold high standards of code quality, maintainability, security, and performance.

Champion guidelines in software development, including testing, CI/CD, observability, and secure cloud deployments (e.g., VNet integration in Azure).

Support and exemplify efficient use of AI-based coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude/Claude Code) to hasten development, refactoring, and innovation—while reviewing outputs carefully.

Collaborate closely with cross-functional partners (product, UX/design, data analysts, DevOps, business collaborators) to turn requirements into engineering plans, remove blockers, and deliver iteratively.

Track team velocity, quality metrics, and system health; facilitate retrospectives and drive continuous improvement with support from leadership.

Handle sprint/quarter planning, resource coordination, risk identification, and delivery commitments for platform work.

Remain informed about progress in Vue.js, Node.js/Fastify, analytics databases (ClickHouse), caching (Redis), container platforms (Azure Container Apps), AI-assisted development, and data trends to support team decisions.

Required Qualifications

5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong hands-on work in frontend and backend technologies (e.g., Vue.js or similar modern JS frameworks + Node.js/TypeScript).

Prior technical leadership experience (e.g., tech lead, project lead, mentoring juniors, or owning major features/systems), with readiness and enthusiasm to transition into direct people management.

Experience contributing to full-stack delivery in production, ideally with data-heavy or analytics applications (e.g., dashboards, important metrics, observability tools). Familiarity with high-performance APIs, analytical databases (e.g., ClickHouse or similar OLAP), caching (e.g., Redis), and container platforms (e.g., Azure Container Apps or Kubernetes concepts) is a plus.

Practical experience working with AI-driven coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude/Claude Code) in everyday tasks, and enthusiasm for supporting the group in integrating them efficiently.

Solid understanding of contemporary software approaches: agile methods, CI/CD, testing (unit/integration/E2E), observability, and secure cloud deployments (Azure preferred).

Strong communication and collaboration abilities; capable of working alongside product, design, and non-technical colleagues to align engineering with business objectives.

Demonstrated potential for people leadership: mentoring others, giving feedback, and contributing to team culture.

Solid problem-solving skills and comfort navigating ambiguity in evolving, data-focused platforms.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with internal tools, enterprise analytics/benchmark systems, or B2E platforms.

Familiarity with real-time data, event streaming, or OLAP workloads.

Exposure to Azure services (Container Apps, VNet, Monitor) and IaC (Bicep/Terraform).

Background in frontend data visualization, backend optimization, or AI-assisted workflows.

Previous mentoring or informal leadership in scaling features or small projects.

What We Offer

Leadership of a high-visibility internal platform that influences organizational decisions.

Opportunity to grow as a manager in a supportive, innovative environment with mentorship from senior leaders.

Hands-on technical involvement while developing people-leadership skills.

Competitive salary and benefits packages.

We value diverse perspectives and encourage all qualified individuals to apply—especially those excited to take their first step into engineering management.

Collaborate with multiple departments to ensure the UX strategy aligns with platform capabilities, including Adobe Experience Cloud.

What you need to succeed
 

8–12 years of experience in UX strategy, digital strategy, customer experience, or management consulting.

Proven background in user experience and customer journey strategy, with strong visual/UI build judgment and extensive collaboration alongside technologists and customers.

Proficiency in Adobe Experience Cloud or similar experience-focused platforms (including AEM, personalization, analytics, or journey tools).

Comfort working in cross-functional, matrixed teams, contributing to complex initiatives through collaboration and influence.

A collaborative, curious approach to problem-solving, with the ability to bring structure and clarity to ambiguous challenges

The Opportunity

The Personalization and Campaign office is redefining how direct sales at Adobe plans, implements, and scales market engagement strategies using AI. We sit at the intersection of strategy, data, content, and frontline execution, translating business intent into always-on, highly personalized customer experiences across inbound and outbound sales motions.

We are looking for a skilled Copywriter with deep prompt engineering expertise to help power this transformation. This role is critical to how we build, test, and scale messaging. The messaging uses advanced technology and feels human, relevant, and effective throughout the customer journey. The customer journey. You will develop the content, prompts, and narratives that drive performance across agentic workflows, campaigns, and sales experiences.

As a Campaign Content Manager, Applied AI, you will specialize in crafting high-impact content and prompts that fuel AI agents used across sales and marketing workflows. You will work closely with Strategy and operations, Market introduction, Product Marketing, Sales Operations, Campaign Managers, and AI Engineers to build personalized content that adapts to context, audience, and intent, at scale.

This role blends creative copywriting with analytical rigor. You will obsess over personalization, experimentation, and performance, constantly iterating based on data and feedback in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

Build and author copy and prompts for sales and GTM use cases, including outbound email campaigns, nurture sequences, in-product messaging, chat experiences, and sales assisted workflows and pitches.

Build, test, and refine prompts that enable AI agents to generate high-quality, on-brand, context-aware content across multiple scenarios.

Partner with Product Marketing and GTM teams to translate positioning, value propositions, and campaign strategy into scalable prompt frameworks.

Drive experimentation for AI-generated content, including A/B testing, multivariate testing, and performance analysis across segments and channels.

Optimize messaging for personalization at scale, demonstrating firmographic, behavioral, and contextual signals.

Maintain prompt libraries, messaging frameworks, and documentation to ensure consistency, quality, and reuse.

Collaborate with engineering and analytics partners to continuously improve output quality, speed, and relevance.

Stay current on emerging guidelines in prompt engineering, AI-assisted copywriting, and agentic content systems.

Qualifications / Experience

6+ years of experience in B2B SaaS copywriting, content strategy, or product marketing, with direct exposure to sales-focused use cases.

Proven experience with prompt engineering for LLM-powered systems, including writing, testing, and refining prompts.

Strong understanding of SaaS go to market motions, including inbound, outbound, lifecycle marketing, and sales enablement.

Hands-on experience running content experiments, A/B tests, and using data to inform iteration and optimization.

Exceptional writing skills with the ability to adapt tone, voice, and structure across audiences, segments and funnel stages.

Highly detailed and driven by a strong passion for action in fast paced environments.

Deep passion for personalization and customer relevance at scale

Comfortable partnering cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Marketing, Analytics, and Engineering teams, open to feedback, and motivated by shared iteration.

Role Overview

Adobe Services Delivery partners with enterprise customers to accelerate digital transformation by delivering prescriptive strategy, thought leadership, and consultative workshops powered by Adobe Digital Experience Cloud. Digital Strategists lead high‑impact engagements that help customers define, operationalize, and scale their digital marketing and personalization capabilities and help them elevate and chart their digital transformation journeys.

Required Experience

Prior experience in a strategy consulting role

2+ years of experience delivering strategy and implementation services involving three or more of the following Adobe Digital Experience Cloud solutions in large‑scale enterprise digital marketing implementations:

Adobe Analytics or Customer Journey Analytics

Adobe Journey Optimizer or Adobe Campaign

Adobe Real‑Time CDP or Audience Manager

Adobe Experience Manager (AEM)

Adobe Target

Adobe Experience Platform

GenStudio

Workshop & Thought Leadership Development:

Design and build original, repeatable workshops focused on enterprise digital marketing transformation using Adobe DX technologies.

Create strategic assets including POVs, frameworks, maturity models, operating models, and roadmaps tied directly to Adobe Experience Cloud capabilities.

Expand existing Adobe‑led workshops across industries by harvesting insights, analyzing customer data, and evolving deliverables.

Author thought leadership (proposals, frameworks, white papers, and presentations) centered on Adobe Digital Experience Cloud, AI‑driven personalization, and enterprise marketing transformation.

Lead high‑quality, consultative workshops with exceptional executive presence.

Engage C‑suite and senior leaders through compelling storytelling narratives that connect Adobe DX solutions to drive action and change.

Lead customers to strategic technology‑enabled solutions to address their business challenges using prescriptive methodologies, tools, frameworks, and high-quality deliverables and roadmaps focused on Adobe Experience Cloud platforms.

Identify and surface new Strategy & Readiness Services opportunities during customer engagements.

Apply a cross-discipline, entrepreneurial perspective, capable of alternating between topics and adapting conversations, leading customers to prescriptive solutions.

Author compelling, high quality deliverables, and present them to a multitude of high-level leadership audiences including C-Suites. 

What you need to succeed:

Experience driving digital transformation initiatives as a trusted adviser.

Strong understanding of Adobe DX technologies, operating models, and activation strategies.

Experience in crafting digital strategies, along with an understanding of how to translate these into the technologies and tactics needed to operationalize them.

Comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast‑moving environments with an entrepreneurial mindset.

Strong executive presence and communication skills, with ability to engage and encourage both senior executives as well as technical leaders.

Ability to adapt and navigate around rapidly changing meeting dynamics and topics.

Outstanding problem solving and analytical skills including talent for conducting research, analyzing data, developing hypotheses, and synthesizing recommendations.

A creative strategist and problem solver able to absorb new complex and ambiguous concepts quickly and convert them into digestible and navigable solutions.

Big 4 or Management Consulting background preferred, but not essential.

Key Responsibilities

Own scoped transformation workstreams within an enterprise program—plan, sequence, and track milestones; manage interdependencies; surface risks with clear mitigation proposals.

Establish and run governance rituals (standups, Scrum of Scrums, sprint reviews, release readiness, risk/issue reviews) and maintain high‑quality artifacts (RAIDs, roadmaps, dashboards).

Drive change & adoption by partnering with change managers and business owners to land new workflows, tools, and operating models; measure adoption and value realization.

Stakeholder & executive communication—synthesize progress, decisions, and risks into crisp updates for leadership; influence without authority across org boundaries.

Data‑driven execution—use program KPIs/OKRs, quality gates, and analytics to guide course corrections and continuous improvement.

Analytics & Continuous Improvement
Leverage perfo Familiarity with enterprise systems (SAP, Workday, Salesforce, Adobe Cloud) and digital transformation programs.

Performance metrics and analytics to monitor progress, measure outcomes, and inform continuous improvement across programs.

Risk Management & Mitigation
Proactively identify risks and interdependencies, develop mitigation plans, and engage stakeholders to resolve issues before they impact delivery.

Innovation & Emerging Technology
Stay current on emerging digital trends, tools, and AI-enabled productivity solutions. Pilot new approaches that enhance efficiency, collaboration, and scalability.

Executive Alignment & Sustainability
Build alignment, gain executive sponsorship, and ensure sustainability of transformation efforts beyond program completion.

Qualifications

4-6 of experience in program management, enterprise transformation, or technical leadership within software industries

Proven experience leading cross‑functional programs/projects with measurable outcomes in tech or adjacent domains.

Demonstrated proficiency with Agile/Hybrid methods (Scrum, SAFe, Lean) and program governance.

Strong communication and influencing without authority across multiple stakeholder groups.

Familiarity with enterprise systems (SAP, Workday, Salesforce, Adobe Cloud) and digital transformation programs.

Tools: Workfront, Smartsheet, Jira, Confluence, MS Project, Power BI (or equivalents).

Skilled in transformation governance and playbook implementation; applies and refines program standards and best practices.

Leads cutover planning, release management, and testing readiness to ensure smooth program transitions.

Operates effectively in fast-paced, matrixed environments; navigates ambiguity and collaborates across functions.

Analytical problem-solver who connects technology, process, and business impact to drive continuous improvement.

Promotes change adoption and process enhancements across teams to improve program execution.

About the role

The RFx Proposal & Solution Architecture Manager will lead end‑to‑end proposal strategy, solution design, and demo orchestration for qualified opportunities, acting as a trusted advisor to sales leaders and customers. This role combines deep MarTech architecture expertise with strong narrative, writing, and presentation skills to craft persuasive responses spanning RFx documents, vision micro demos, and executive presentations that clearly articulate business value and technical feasibility.

What your will be responsible for

Lead RFx responses for strategic opportunities, working on qualified deals to interpret customer requirements, define win themes, and build contextualized, high‑quality proposals.

· Partner with Sales and Solution Consultants to assess customer environments, identify Experience Cloud fit, and design end‑to‑end architectures that address customer journeys, integrations, and scalability.

· Own the proposal plan from initiation to submission, driving cadence, managing work‑streams, and ensuring on‑time, compliant, and differentiated deliverables across technical and business tracks.

· Act as Solution Architect and Subject Matter Expert, defining reference architectures, integration patterns, and deployment approaches for Adobe DX solutions (e.g., content, data, marketing automation, commerce).

· Create and orchestrate vision demos, micro‑demos, and prototype experiences that bring the proposed architecture and value story to life for both technical and executive stakeholders.

· Build reusable customer‑facing assets (architecture blueprints, demo scripts, POV outlines, playbooks) that raise proposal quality and accelerate response velocity across the RFx team.

· Coordinate inputs from cross‑functional stakeholders (sales, product, marketing, finance, legal, delivery) and synthesize them into a single, coherent narrative and solution design.

· Mentor and coach the RFx and presales team on solutioning best practices, demo storytelling, and architecture patterns, including running knowledge‑sharing sessions and internal enablement.

What you’ll do

Establish yourself as an influential leader in proposal management, solution architecture, and RFx strategy for Adobe Digital Experience.

· Shape deal strategy by aligning customer business drivers with Adobe’s architecture vision, challenging assumptions, and identifying gaps in customer journeys and technical readiness.

· Lead “win rooms” and workshops to define solution options, risks, and trade‑offs, building consensus across internal teams and customer stakeholders.

· Translate complex architectural concepts (data flows, integrations, security, scalability) into clear, business‑friendly narratives and visuals suitable for CXO audiences.

· Deliver high‑impact demos and presentations that connect technical capabilities to measurable outcomes such as revenue growth, personalization, operational efficiency, and customer lifetime value.

· Represent the team in conferences, customer events, blogs, and internal forums to showcase best practices, reusable demo assets, and thought leadership around presales architecture and RFx excellence

What you need to succeed

B.Tech or MBA (or equivalent) with 12–15 years of experience in presales, solution consulting, or cloud‑based digital experience implementations.

Strong understanding of enterprise and MarTech architecture, including at least one core area such as Customer Data Platforms, marketing automation, content management/experience (AEM‑like platforms), or commerce.

Hands‑on experience designing end‑to‑end architectures across data, content, activation, and analytics layers, including APIs, integrations, identity, and security considerations.

Proven RFx and proposal management experience, including leading complex RFP/RFI responses, orchestrating cross‑functional contributions, and driving technical win outcomes.

Demonstrated demo excellence: skilled at using demo tools and pre‑built libraries, building custom scenarios, and adapting demos for different personas while maintaining strong storytelling and engagement.

Strong project management capabilities with a track record of delivering high‑quality proposals and solutions on time in fast‑paced environments.

Exceptional communication, writing, and presentation skills, with the ability to craft CXO‑level narratives and visually compelling decks and diagrams.

Proficiency with productivity and design tools (Office Suite, collaboration platforms, basic design/prototyping tools) and comfort learning Adobe’s own experience and design tools quickly.

High ownership, creativity, and growth mindset, with a passion for staying current on digital experience, architecture, and AI‑driven MarTech trends.

The Opportunity

Strategic Program Manager leading complex, cross-functional programs that directly support business objectives and long-term organizational goals of the Adobe Digital Experience organization. Responsible for structuring and managing multiple programs simultaneously, ensuring initiatives are coordinated, aligned, and delivering measurable impact across the enterprise.

Self-starting critical thinker who combines strategic clarity with operational rigor, proactively identifying risks, driving alignment, and ensuring accountability across diverse teams and interested parties. This program manager must demonstrate standard Program Management methodology, ensuring efficiency, scalability, and consistency.

What you'll Do

Design, structure, and manage 2–4 programs at a time.

Translate high-level goals into coordinated program roadmaps, governance models, and measurable outcomes within the Objectives/Key Results (“OKR”) framework.

Build and maintain a program life cycle based on tangible progress points and deliverables that act as health indicators and allow you to “look around the corner” and identify risks and dependencies on or over the horizon.

Drive relentless accountability and prioritization by aligning all program activities to defined picture of success, assigning clear ownership and accountability, and subsequently leading and supporting all participants and owners to deliver expected results.

Use data, team feedback, progress tracking, performance indicators, personal experience, and instincts to monitor program health and progress. Identify early signs of slowdown or drift, investigate root causes, and implement corrective actions that balance speed, quality, and sustainability.

Who you are:

Confident, articulate, cross-functional collaborator with the ability to prioritize and multi-task in a fast-paced environment to deliver customer-centric results.

Inventive problem-solver who can lead and influence with various partners.

Possesses strong EQ, meticulous attention to detail, excellent verbal, written and interpersonal skills to successfully interact with individuals of varying levels.

Dedicated team member that is casual in tone but serious about impact. Conversations are human. Humor is welcome. Hierarchy does not dominate the room. People can speak plainly and be themselves.

What you'll need:

8+ years of experience in program or portfolio management, preferably in complex, cross-functional environments.

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

Ability to land in a fluid environment and immediately collaborate with SMEs to establish high- to mid-level delivery targets, and build or reshape the roadmap to balance expectations and reality.

Experience with Project Management Tools (Workfront, Jira, etc) and virtual collaboration tools (SharePoint, Wiki, Miro, etc); Workfront certification a plus.
