The Opportunity
The Adobe Security Engineering Partnerships (SEP) team is seeking a Senior Product Security Engineer to scale security capabilities across our software Supply Chain, Kubernetes deployment environments, and cloud-native systems.
We're looking for a candidate that is passionate about securing the software
development lifecycle (SDLC), strengthening software supply chain integrity, and
embedding security into modern delivery pipelines using automation-first, secure-by-default approaches. You will operate as a security expert, influencing engineering organizations and key stakeholders, designing scalable security solutions, and independently managing risk across complex, cloud-native systems.

What you'll Do 

Develop and implement security controls across CI/CD platforms including GitHub workflows, Jenkins, and internal build systems.

Establish secure-by-default pipeline standards covering build isolation, artifact integrity, secrets management, and least-privilege access.

Identify systemic supply chain risks and build scalable mitigations that prevent entire classes of vulnerabilities.

Secure Kubernetes-based platforms across multi-cloud environments.

Define security baselines for clusters, workloads, container runtimes, admission controls, and network segmentation.

Perform security architecture reviews for complex CI/CD, cloud, and Kubernetes environments.

Independently manage security risk by making defensible, risk-based decisions balancing business velocity and security posture.

Recognize capability gaps and design new security solutions that increase coverage and effectiveness across multiple product areas.

Serve as a trusted security advisor and technical lead within your domain.

Establish yourself as a domain expert in CI/CD, supply chain, and cloud security.

What you need to succeed 

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field of study.

6+ years of experience in Product Security, Application Security, Cloud Security, or a related field.

Experience threat modeling for CI/CD and cloud-native systems.

Deep expertise in CI/CD systems such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or similar platforms.

Strong experience securing Kubernetes and containerized workloads in cloud-native environments.

Hands-on knowledge of software supply chain security, artifact signing, and open-source risk management.

Experience implementing GitOps workflows and securing infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation, etc.).

Strong programming or scripting ability (e.g., Python, Go, Bash) with experience building automation and security tooling.

Demonstrated ability to identify systemic risks and design scalable, automation-first mitigations.

Strong understanding of Secure SDLC practices and how security solutions reduce risk across large organizations.

Proven ability to influence engineering teams and serve as a technical leader without formal management authority.

We are seeking a highly experienced Software Architect focussed on front-end architecture to join the GenStudio Engineering team. This role is ideal for a technical leader who thrives in complex product environments, has strong opinions grounded in experience, and is passionate about building scalable, high-quality user experiences.
As a Staff Engineer, you will set the architectural direction for large portions of our front-end platform, partner closely with Product and Design, and mentor engineers across teams. You’ll operate at both the strategic and hands-on levels—shaping long-term technical decisions while staying close to the code.

What You’ll Do
Architect and evolve large-scale front-end systems using modern web technologies, with a focus on React, TypeScript, and Node.js.
Define and drive front-end architecture standards across micro-frontends, shared component libraries, design systems, and platform services.
Lead technical design for complex, high-impact features that span multiple teams and domains.
Partner with Product, Design, and Backend teams to translate product requirements into scalable, maintainable front-end solutions.

Establish best practices around performance, accessibility, reliability, security, and developer experience.

Own key technical decisions and trade-offs, including state management, data fetching patterns, rendering strategies, and build tooling.

Mentor senior and staff-level engineers, raising the technical bar through design reviews, code reviews, and architecture forums.

Identify and proactively address front-end platform gaps, tech debt, and scaling challenges.

Influence roadmap planning by connecting technical investments to product and business outcomes.

Stay current with the evolving front-end ecosystem and thoughtfully introduce new technologies where they provide clear value.

What You’ll Need to Succeed
10–12+ years of software engineering experience, with deep expertise in front-end development at scale.

Bachelors Degree or equivalent work experience
Proven experience as a front-end technical lead or architect on complex, production-grade web applications.
Expert-level knowledge of React, TypeScript, modern JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
Strong experience with Node.js and understanding of full-stack web architectures.

Hands-on experience designing systems using micro-frontends, shared UI platforms, and design systems.

Deep understanding of browser fundamentals, performance optimization, and rendering strategies.

Experience working in large codebases with multiple teams and stakeholders.

Strong architectural judgment—able to balance short-term delivery with long-term maintainability.

Ability to clearly communicate technical ideas and influence without authority.

Preferred Attributes

Experience building or scaling platform-level front-end infrastructure used by many teams.

Familiarity with server-side rendering, edge rendering, or hybrid rendering models.

Experience integrating front-end applications with complex backend and data services.

Passion for developer experience, tooling, and productivity.

Track record of mentoring senior engineers and shaping engineering culture.

Contributions to open source, internal frameworks, or technical communities.

Experience building front ends for data-heavy, workflow-driven, or AI-powered products.

About the Role

As an Digital Strategist, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the successful adoption of marketing technology platforms by increasing employee engagement, streamlining operational models, and driving sustainable change. You'll work with Adobe’s largest enterprise customers, guiding them through digital marketing transformation across technology, business processes, organizational structures, and workforce capabilities.

This role requires a combination of strategic thinking, stakeholder management, and hands-on experience with organizational change. You’ll help customers navigate the complexities of onboarding and adopting new digital solutions—ensuring they unlock the full potential of their investments.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy & Change Leadership

Lead digital transformation engagements focused on change management, operating model refinement, and organizational design.

Partner with executive stakeholders to align digital strategy with business goals.

Facilitate discovery sessions and strategic workshops to uncover needs and co-create solutions.

Deliver compelling executive-level presentations, strategic roadmaps, and value frameworks.

Change Management Execution

Apply structured change management methodologies (e.g., Prosci) to drive adoption.

Create actionable deliverables for change levers: communication plans, sponsor roadmaps, training and coaching programs, and resistance management.

Assess change readiness, conduct impact analyses, and develop stakeholder engagement plans.

Support project teams in integrating change activities into delivery plans.

Organizational Enablement

Define and implement future-state operating models, team structures, and process frameworks.

Coach senior leaders and managers to act as effective change sponsors.

Support the development and delivery of training programs to drive user adoption.

Practice Development

Contribute to the evolution of the Digital Strategy & Performance practice.

Share knowledge, mentor team members, and support methodology development.

Collaborate closely with Adobe’s delivery and partner teams to ensure seamless execution.

Required Skills & Qualifications

10+ years of experience in digital strategy, marketing technology, or business transformation.

Proven success leading large-scale change and adoption programs.

Strong executive presence and communication skills—verbal, written, and visual.

Experience with Adobe Experience Cloud or similar platforms (Salesforce, Oracle, etc.).

Deep understanding of digital marketing strategy and marketing operations.

Background in one or more key industries (e.g., retail, finance, travel, media).

Hands-on experience in creating and delivering value-driven business cases.

Exceptional problem-solving, analytical, and stakeholder management capabilities.

Preferred Certifications

Change Management:

Prosci Change Management Certification

APMG International Change Management Certification

Project & Portfolio Management:

Familiarity with project management tools, phases, and methodologies

Additional Attributes

Naturally collaborative and comfortable working in cross-functional environments.

Resilient, adaptable, and able to work through ambiguity.

Organized with a strategic mindset and tactical execution skills.

Strong influencing skills and ability to drive consensus among diverse stakeholders.

Passion for helping clients achieve measurable business value through transformation.

Strategise go-to-market with future requirements.

key Skills & Proficiencies

Uniformity and excellence in approval decisions.

The Opportunity

The Adobe Customer Solutions Engagement Manager leads substantial, innovative engagements for critical Adobe accounts. Acting as a trusted advisor and strategic guide, you help Sales and Delivery teams align projects with customers’ objectives. Recognized as a business contributor and delivery specialist, you are the primary customer contact in a billable capacity. You drive the delivery of desired results while preserving strong executive connections.

This position merges excellent delivery and client relationship supervision, concentrating on client and partner communication, cross-functional teamwork, and technical skills to advance business transformation. Success requires collaborating across people, process, and technology with an industry or customer practitioner perspective to produce measurable customer value.

What You'll Do

Customer Engagement & Delivery Leadership

The role manages the success of a defined set of strategic Services customers in the region. It ensures customer requirements are met and that engagements deliver measurable business value aligned to customer priorities. It acts as the primary contact for customer executives and coordinates with partners across the customer’s broader ecosystem. After contract booking, it ensures a smooth and efficient transition from Sales to Delivery. It works closely with Sales, Delivery, and Product teams to align on customer success plans and find opportunities to drive value across Adobe solutions. It serves as the main point of contact at senior management level, resolving customer issues quickly and keeping engagements on track.

Operational Excellence

You are responsible for driving accurate and effective revenue management, including growth and margin execution, revenue acceleration, backlog burn, contract expiration and extension management, and close alignment with Adobe Finance and Operations.

You manage the Services team by coordinating team staffing, onboarding, and transitions within the assigned account(s).

Services Expansion & Opportunity Development

You will partner closely with Adobe Sales to build new services opportunities and support contract extensions, change requests, and addendum. You contribute strategic feedback to account planning in collaboration with the wider account teams, and lead efforts to renew and expand Customer Solutions relationships with existing clients by demonstrating a deep understanding of customer objectives and the scope, activities, and resources required to achieve them.

What you'll need to succeed

8+ years of hands-on experience in professional services, consulting or customer delivery experience of large programs, preferably in SaaS or enterprise software.

Experience with enterprise level project or program management.

Proven track record of building positive relationships, managing complex customer engagements and leading transformation.

Passion for operational rigor and customer value, with a proven ability to collaborate, lead and influence in a matrixed organization.

Strong business insight and industry expertise with ability to speak to value drivers and use cases in customer's context via experience-based story telling.

Ability to effectively navigate complex client situations and act as a change agent for our clients and within Adobe Services.

Strong written and verbal communication skills, executive level presence and experience in working in a client advisory role.

Able to travel to support client engagements.

Bachelor’s degree, with an MBA or equivalent experience preferred.

Digital marketing experience is preferred.

Job Description 
Digital Video Audio (DVA) group’s portfolio consists of world class products across desktop, mobile and cloud catering to professional customers. Some of the products and services that the team develops includes Adobe Premiere Pro, Adobe After Affects etc. As part of the team you will be responsible for one or more of the following:

Developing features for Premiere Pro.

Developing core color algorithm supporting Adobe Premiere Pro.

Developing imaging or video processing algorithms that can solve some of the hard problems faced by our customers.

What you’ll do

As an Individual contributor, develop new framework/features, maintain product features with responsibility for the full product development cycle from early specs, prototypes to implementation to release and maintenance for products like Adobe Premiere Pro.

Problem-solving skills, with experience in defining and understanding complex system architectures and design patterns

The Opportunity
AI-powered Search, Recommendations and Generative AI-based guidance is a core part of Adobe’s Cloud offering. Adobe Cloud enables customers to create and generate digital content, and Digital experiences. The Search, Discovery, and Content AI Team drives customer success for Adobe Express, Creative Cloud, and Document Cloud. Creative professionals and novice users need the quick discovery of digital assets from brushes to colors, images, videos, and
beyond. They also need AI-powered assistance to discover the ingredients needed to complete their creative journey at scale.

We are building a new search, recommendations, and knowledge graph platform that powers suits of Adobe product lines. Our platform caters to millions of users and billions of entities. Become part of this growing team at Adobe and have an excellent impact by providing AI-powered search, recommendations, and gen AI-based assistance across the creative suites of products at Adobe.

How can you participate?

We focus on developing innovative AI-powered search, recommendations, and assistive experiences using generative AI technologies across all modalities, including text, image, and videos, and create industry-leading experiences to improve creative efficiency for creators, marketers, and designers.

We’re looking for a top-notch Applied Scientist with deep expertise in generative AI technologies. This is an opportunity to make a huge impact in a fast-paced, startup-like environment in a great company. Join us!

Responsibilities:

Research, develop and implement ML models using Transformers, LLMs, and classical ML algorithms for search and recommendation use cases

Be proficient in Python, PyTorch, Hugging Face Ecosystem, distributed and scalable fine-tuning of state-of-the-art LLMs.

Be proficient in optimized inference engines/frameworks like vLLM, TensorRT

Fine-tune LLMs and Diffusion models to build and augment a creative knowledge graph and use it to recommend billions of images, videos, documents, and other assets in real time.

Align text, visual and other modalities by fine-tuning Transformer-based models for the creative domain

Conduct innovative research on novel LLM architectures and training methods, focusing on creative applications

Process Multimodal (Text, Image, Video) intent and contextually assist the user by recommending ingredients and generating rich artifacts to enable a seamless creative path.

Develop robust methods to evaluate LLM performance, ensuring ethical AI practices that reflect Adobe’s standards

Masters' degree or PhD in computer science, statistics, engineering, or other relevant subject area highly preferred

5+ years of relevant experience required

As a Senior Security Engineer specializing in Identity Architecture & Solutions, you will craft, build, and operationalize scalable identity and SaaS security capabilities across the enterprise. This role is a technical leader within the Enterprise Security organization, and they should be passionate about Identity & SaaS Security functions and identity architecture strategy. As an organization, we collaborate on driving measurable reductions of identity-centric risk. This role is critical to delivering on that vision.

The Challenge

Engineer Zero‑Trust access controls across workforce and service identities: implement pipelines using RBAC+ABAC standards, device and posture checks, and risk‑adaptive policies for critical services and high-risk scenarios.

Harden privileged access: migrate administrators to right‑size entitlements and eliminate long‑lived elevated access across prioritized platforms (e.g., Entra ID, Privileged Access Management).

Stand up SaaS security posture monitoring: participate in tool POCs and deployments; define baselines for M365/Slack/GitHub/Workday/Google; build remediation runbooks and posture success measurements.

Instrument identity metrics collection and tracking: standardize log schemas for authentication (AuthN)/authorization (AuthZ) and entitlement changes; publish dashboards for privilege drift, misconfigurations, and access sprawl; coordinate risky events to security alert procedures.

Contribute and drive architecture & standards: author implementation guides and reference architecture that supports a multi‑year strategy passionate about measuring risk reduction over time. Inclusive of new technologies and risks.

What is needed to succeed

Depth of experience with enterprise identity controls and solutions, including delivering outcomes that use Entra ID/AD, Okta, and SailPoint (or equivalents)

Strong understanding of core Zero Trust principles, the least privilege and continuous verification models, and Identity governance and administration (IGA)

SaaS posture skills for securing large SaaS tenants (M365, Slack, GitHub, Workday, Google), including security Authn and Authz for all identities accessing SaaS tenants

Influence & collaboration with key partners in IT and other security teams and organizations

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including communicating complex problems and solutions to business leaders and technical specialists

Preferred

Engineering experience with secure access control solutions (e.g. Teleport, Vault), secrets management, and CI/CD solutions and their customers.

Scripting/automation knowledge (e.g., Python, PowerShell) and infrastructure‑as‑code (e.g., Terraform) for policy and pipeline automation.

Exposure to service identity frameworks (e.g., SPIFFE/SPIRE) and workload identity patterns.

Experience/Education requirements ~10+ years relevant experience; Bachelor’s required, Masters preferred or equivalent experience.

Technical lead experience in enterprise environments

The Opportunity 

We are seeking a highly skilled Information Retrieval Engineer to lead the development and optimization of retrieval systems that power context-aware large language models (LLMs). This role focuses on building robust Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines to ensure AI agents and applications have access to the most relevant, timely, and high-quality information.

You'll work at the intersection of data engineering, machine learning, and knowledge management—enabling better reasoning, accuracy, and performance for enterprise-grade AI systems.

What you'll Do 

RAG System Design

Architect and deploy scalable retrieval pipelines using vector databases (e.g., FAISS, Weaviate, Pinecone, Qdrant)

Implement semantic search infrastructure and hybrid retrieval systems (semantic + keyword)

Data Processing & Ingestion

Build ingestion pipelines for both structured and unstructured data sources

Implement document chunking strategies, embedding generation (e.g., OpenAI, Cohere, HuggingFace), and metadata tagging

Retrieval Optimization

Fine-tune relevance scoring, reranking algorithms, and query understanding mechanisms

Develop techniques to improve precision/recall for specific business domains or user tasks

Knowledge Enhancement

Create and maintain knowledge graphs to support context linking and disambiguation

Manage data freshness and version control to ensure consistency and reliability of retrieved content

Reasoning Support

Design and iterate on context window strategies that improve LLM reasoning (e.g., adaptive injection, task-based retrieval)

Collaborate with prompt engineers and model developers to align retrieval outputs with downstream model behavior

Performance Monitoring

Track key retrieval metrics such as accuracy, latency, and fallback rate

Implement caching, prefetching, and deduplication strategies to optimize system responsiveness

What you need to succeed 

4+ years in data engineering, ML infrastructure, or information retrieval

Experience building and deploying RAG pipelines or semantic search systems

Strong ML and Python skills and familiarity with retrieval libraries (e.g., Haystack, LangChain, Elasticsearch, Milvus)

Proficiency with embedding models, vector similarity search, and document indexing

Familiarity with cloud platforms and MLOps tooling (e.g., Airflow, dbt, Docker)

Preferred Qualifications

Knowledge of graph databases (e.g., Neo4j, TigerGraph) or knowledge graph design

Experience optimizing retrieval for LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral)

Background in IR/NLP, Search Engineering, or Cognitive Computing

Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field

The Opportunity

Adobe is seeking a Principal Product Marketing Manager, Mobile Apps to help define and scale our mobile product marketing strategy across a growing ecosystem of creative applications.

This role will lead outbound strategy for key mobile experiences, including Lightroom Mobile, while helping shape go-to-market and growth approaches that extend across emerging mobile products. You will play a critical role in driving usage and growth strengthening Adobe’s position in the mobile-first creator landscape.

We operate with a lean inbound/outbound structure, and this is a high-impact role that requires both strategic depth and executional excellence. You will flex across outbound leadership and partner deeply with the inbound PMM/product teams to drive positioning clarity, and market perspective to influence product strategy and growth outcomes.

This is an opportunity to help build Adobe’s scalable mobile marketing playbook, defining how we launch, grow, measure, and optimize mobile apps in an increasingly competitive environment.

What You’ll Do

Mobile Outbound Strategy

Lead outbound strategy for Adobe Lightroom Mobile, driving integrated go-to-market efforts that accelerate MAU growth and ARR.

Develop differentiated positioning and messaging that resonates with mobile-first creators and consumers.

Translate product innovation into clear, compelling value propositions across paid, owned, social, influencer, and app store channels.

Go-to-Market Leadership

Own end-to-end go-to-market planning for major mobile releases and feature moments.

Partner closely with Product, Growth, Lifecycle, Creative, Social, Influencer, and Regional teams to ensure coordinated execution and measurable impact.

Ensure strong alignment between brand storytelling and performance marketing outcomes.

Growth & Mobile Excellence

Bring deep understanding of mobile growth levers including acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, and monetization.

Partner with analytics and growth teams to design experiments, measure performance, and optimize messaging across the funnel.

Influence app store strategy, in-app messaging, and lifecycle touchpoints to improve conversion and long-term value.

Inbound Partnership & Strategic Influence

Serve as a key strategic input to Product and inbound PMM on user insights, competitive landscape, positioning frameworks, and value proposition development.

Contribute perspective to packaging and pricing discussions, with primary focus on growth impact.

Represent the voice of the mobile customer in product strategy conversations.

Building the Mobile Playbook

Define and scale repeatable frameworks for mobile launches, measurement, experimentation, and cross-functional orchestration.

Help establish standards that can extend across current and future mobile applications.

Contribute to shaping Adobe’s long-term mobile ecosystem strategy.

Executive Communication

Present strategy, launch plans, and business impact to senior leadership.

Collaborate with UX research, data science, and analytics teams to validate hypotheses and measure impact.

The opportunity 

At Frame.io, an Adobe Company, we are changing the future of creative work by helping over 1 million creative professionals collaborate seamlessly worldwide. We have built a product creatives recognize and love through constant innovation and incredible attention to detail. 

We are seeking a strategic, empathetic, and forward-thinking Quantitative UX Researcher for our team. Our ideal candidate is able to systematically measure, identify, and prioritize product quality needs across Frame.io to help our teams build and measure a highly accessible and exceptionally usable product. Reporting directly to the Head of User Insights, we'll collaborate to grow the team and change how insights impact strategy and product development at Frame.io. You'll partner with Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Design to clarify goals, highlight opportunities, and support Frame.io in delivering outstanding experiences that change how creative collaboration happens. 

What you’ll do 

Develop a comprehensive understanding of our customers by crafting and leading mixed methods research. 

Promote the voice of the customer across the organization. Partner with cross-functional leadership to roadmap and delivering meaningful, measured, and informed customer experiences that result in business impact. 

Simplify complex findings into clear, persuasive stories and actionable insights that influence immediate actions and long-term product vision. 

Develop quantitative research practices for Frame.io, setting new standards for how integrated insights drive the creation of world-class creative tools. 

Pioneers the integration of AI into core research workflows, challenging legacy approaches and measurably reducing time-to-insight and scaling the team's impact across the organization.

Establish process for releasing experiences that achieve high quality standards, establish and test measures for product quality evaluations. 

What you'll bring to the team 

Degree or equivalent experience with a minimum of 7 years of practical experience in UX Research for digital products, applying a wide variety of research methods across the product development cycle. 

Skilled presenter and persuasive communicator who quickly builds trust and rapport with collaborators at every level. 

Comfortable performing a variety of quantitative research and statistical methods. 

Ability to go beyond data and translate to practical insights about user behavior. 

Strong organizational skills & ability to manage multiple projects at various stages in the research cycle. 

Passion for AI and continuous exploration of emerging tools to stay at the forefront of industry practices.

The Cross Practices Organization: 

The Cross Practices organization serves as the strategic backbone of Americas Services Delivery. It is responsible for defining and supporting the overarching framework that empowers our delivery practices - and ultimately, Adobe’s customers - to succeed. The team drives strategy, governance, and quality assurance across all Americas Services Delivery solutions, while establishing best practices and processes for emerging service offerings. Comprised of three specialized teams - Customer Solutions & Innovation, Digital Transformation, and Project Quality & Risk Management - Cross Practices is united by a singular goal: to shape the Americas Services Delivery strategy, enabling greater agility and accelerating consistent, high-quality value realization for our customers through delivery excellence. 
 

Role Summary: 

The Professional Development Enablement Creator will play a critical role within the Customer Solutions & Innovation Team and focuses on designing, developing, and curating educational content, training materials, and resources to improve employee performance and professional growth. This role typically acts as a bridge between subject matter experts (SMEs) and the workforce, turning complex information into engaging, actionable, and scalable learning experiences, often using tools like Learning Management Systems (LMS), video, and interactive modules. The Professional Development Enablement Creator must be a proactive problem-solver with strong customer-first thinking, attention to detail, understanding program management and an eye for user experience. 

What You’ll Do: 

Content Creation & Development: Design, write, and produce training materials, including e-learning modules, videos, job aids, playbooks, and self-service resources. 

Strategy Execution: Collaborate with business leaders, SMEs and individual contributors to execute leadership vision & strategy and create role-specific learning paths. 

Content Management & Design: Owning the content management for enablement resources and design for easy navigation for end user. 

Curriculum & Asset Management: Maintain a centralized repository of training materials (LMS), ensuring content is accurate, up-to-date, and easily searchable. 

Impact Analysis: Monitor the adoption and effectiveness of training initiatives through data, analytics, and feedback to ensure continuous improvement. 

Onboarding & Development: Develop and maintain structured onboarding programs to accelerate time-to-productivity for new hires. 
 

What You’ll Need to Succeed: 

Bachelor's degree required in Change Management, Organizational Design, Communications, Marketing, Education, or similar field. 

5+ years of proven experience in video editing or content creation, particularly in a corporate or educational setting and preferably in a SaaS or technology company. 

Proficiency in e-learning software, learning management systems and video creation tools. 

A portfolio demonstrating excellence in diverse content creation, editing styles and, ideally, education content. 

Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain continuity, pacing, and visual storytelling standards. 

Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a cross-functional, agile team environment. 

Creative problem-solving skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously. 

Experience in a customer-centric or customer solutions environment is highly preferred. 

Experience with technical delivery of the Adobe Digital Experience product suite is a plus. 

 

Performance Measurement: 

This role will be measured against a predefined Business-Driven Objective (BDO) that aligns with Adobe Consulting’s strategic goals. The BDO will focus on: 

Increased Time to Value 

Consistent usage of Role-based operating rhythms, included delivery role definitions and rationalization 

Increased automations in delivery processes 

Increased asset reusability 

Defined framework for cross training strategy 

 

Progress toward the BDO will be reviewed quarterly and used to guide performance feedback, team alignment, and strategic prioritization.

As one of the world’s most innovative software companies whose products touch billions of people around the world, Adobe empowers everyone, everywhere to imagine, create, and bring any digital experience to life. The Role 
Adobe is seeking a UI Software Engineer to help build the next generation of AI-driven product experiences for Adobe Analytics, Adobe’s industry-leading analytics platform.
Adobe Analytics processes 30+ billion transactions daily and delivers insights to customers through sophisticated reporting and data visualization experiences. In this role, you will help design and build modern web-based interfaces, AI-assisted workflows, and data-rich user experiences that make complex analytics more intuitive, useful, and delightful.
You will participate in all aspects of the software development lifecycle, including architecture, design, development, testing, and maintenance of products and internal tools. This position is based in our Lehi, UT office within Adobe’s Digital Experience Business Unit.

Key Responsibilities

Build, develop, and maintain responsive, high-performance user interfaces that help customers explore and understand complex enterprise-scale datasets

Collaborate closely with product managers, UX/UI designers, data analysts, and backend engineers to translate business requirements, wireframes, and prototypes into polished, intuitive features.

Participate in code reviews, contribute to front-end architecture decisions, and help maintain high code quality through testing (unit, component, E2E).

Implement interactive data visualizations while optimizing for large datasets and real-time updates.

Optimize front-end performance, rendering efficiency, lazy loading, and smooth handling of complex state in data-intensive applications.

Leverage AI coding assistants daily to boost productivity, generating boilerplate, refactoring components, exploring implementations, and iterating on complex logic, while critically reviewing and refining AI-generated output.

Stay updated on advancements in the React/Node ecosystem, modern CSS guidelines (Tailwind, CSS modules, etc.), emerging UI/UX procedures for analytics tools, and evolving AI-assisted development workflows.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science or a related field.

Proficiency building modern web applications with JavaScript/TypeScript, React, HTML5, and CSS3

Familiarity with AI/ML-powered product features and integrating UI experiences with AI services

Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams

Solid understanding of UI/UX principles and experience turning designer-provided assets (Figma) into production-ready code.

Consistent experience applying AI-powered coding aids like GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or Claude to boost coding, debugging, refactoring, and learning during real-world projects.

What you need to succeed

Customer empathy and genuine curiosity about user problems and workflows

Ability to prototype and iterate quickly on new concepts in support of Adobe’s agile product development practices

Experience building and integrating data visualizations into user interfaces

Experience optimizing front-end performance for data-intensive applications

Familiarity with accessibility implementation and testing (e.g., WCAG, keyboard navigation, screen readers)

Familiarity with containerized development/deployment workflows (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes)

What you'll Do

Join the AIF India Foundation team as an AIML Applied Engineer. In this role, you will develop and grow the AI Assistant and agentic core for Adobe Express. These components support Assistant experiences across multiple products. The job centers on server-side tasks. You will build and deploy AI/ML models and microservices, integrate external AI/ML providers, and keep AI features for Express users dependable and scalable.

What we offer

Contribute to Adobe Express and AI Assistant that serve millions of creators.

Build agentic and cross-product AI experiences with a strong engineering and research team.

Exposure to brand new AI/ML and cloud-native systems at scale.

Encouraging and unified setting at AIF India Foundation and Adobe.

What you'll do

AI Assistant development: Build, implement, and maintain server-side components of the Adobe Express AI Assistant (APIs, orchestration, state, tool use).

Agentic core: Contribute to the agentic core that enables cross-Assistant interaction and multi-product workflows (routing, context, handoffs).

Microservices: Develop and improve microservices that deliver AI Assistant and agentic functionalities to clients and other services.

Third-party AI/ML integration: Deploy and manage AI/ML models and APIs (e.g., LLMs, embeddings, specialised models); oversee authentication, retry mechanisms, fallback strategies, and balance cost versus latency.

Cloud & platform: Manage services within cloud environments (e.g., AWS/GCP/Azure); use containers, orchestration, and platform tools for deployment and monitoring.

Reliability & observability: Integrate logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting; participate in on-call duties and incident management.

Collaboration: Work with product, build, and other engineering teams to ship features and improve AI quality and user experience.

Required

4–6 years of software engineering experience, including significant participation in applied AI/ML (model integration, deployment, or ML systems).

BS/BTech (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; or equivalent practical experience.

Strong background in server-side development with one or more of the following: JavaScript, Typescript, Python, Node.js; knowledge of REST/gRPC and asynchronous patterns.

Hands-on cloud experience (e.g., AWS, GCP, or Azure): compute, storage, networking, and managed services.

Solid data structures, algorithms, and system building; comfort with concurrency, scaling, and fault tolerance.

Experience with microservices: build, APIs, service boundaries, and deployment (e.g., containers, Kubernetes or similar).

Preferred

Experience with agentic systems: agents, tool use, planning, or multi-step reasoning in production.

Experience with LLM APIs (e.g., chat, completions, embeddings) and timely response handling at scale.

Familiarity with MLOps practices: model versioning, A/B testing, canary releases, or feature stores.

Experience with observability (e.g., Datadog, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry) and on-call for production services.

Experience in creative or build tools (e.g., Express, Creative Cloud) or conversational AI products.

Experience with AI/ML in production: incorporating or launching models (e.g., LLMs, embeddings, classifiers); understanding of latency, efficiency, and failure modes.

Experience integrating third-party AI/ML APIs or models (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source models, or internal model services).

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a high-energy, driven, and self-motivated individual to join our Japan Digital Media(DME) BDR team in Tokyo. As a BDR(Business Development Representative), you will be the first point of contact for prospects, engaging with IT and C-level decision-makers across commercial and public sectors. You’ll play a meaningful role in generating pipeline through personalized outreach and account-based development strategies. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment with a passion to succeed!

What You’ll Do

Generate qualified pipeline through inbound and outbound prospecting via phone, video, email, and social channels.

Research and identify key contacts within target accounts to initiate meaningful conversations.

Build awareness and interest in Adobe’s Digital Media solutions (Creative Cloud, Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Sign, Firefly Services, etc.).

Drive attendance to webinars and live events through targeted campaigns.

Collaborate with Account Executives, Marketing, and Product teams to align messaging and strategy.

Keep accurate records in CRM and contribute to pipeline progression and forecasting.

Handle objections confidently and guide prospects through the qualification process.

Participate in ongoing enablement sessions and contribute to team best practices.

Maintain up-to-date knowledge of Adobe's competitive positioning in the marketplace.
 

What You Need to Succeed

Full fluency in Japanese and preferred reading and writing in English.

1+ years’ experience in IT sales or business development, ideally with enterprise clients.

Proven success in inbound/outbound prospecting and building relationships across organizational levels.

Skilled in account planning, opportunity qualification, and objection handling.

Strong communicator with confident phone, writing, and presentation skills.

Quick learner able to translate complex business needs into solution plays.

Proficient in tools like Salesforce CRM, Microsoft Dynamics, Outreach, Lusha, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and MS Office or similar.

Self-starter with resilience, independence, and a collaborative attitude.

Comfortable working cross-functionally with sales, marketing, and solution teams.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Senior Demo Strategist to own CJM demo strategy across Adobe Journey Optimizer (B2C & B2B), Campaign, Target, Marketo, Dynamic Chat, and Agentic Apps. You’ll be the single point of accountability for ensuring our global field and partner teams have compelling, current demo capabilities aligned with Adobe’s go-to-market motions. If you love turning complex technology into stories that sell—this role is for you!

How You’ll Work

This role follows our Demo Strategy Framework: Identify › Assess › Fill › Publish › Evangelize. You’ll work across every stage of this cycle—from surfacing new demo needs with PM, PMM, and Engineering collaborators, to performing delta analysis against existing inventory, to building and shipping the assets that close gaps.

On the build side, you’ll develop demos across our three-tier model (video, clickable, live), own demo environment strategy and tooling (Demo System Next, Walnut, Consensus), and partner with internal engineering to translate gaps into live demonstrability. You’ll also lead Agentic Apps demo readiness—curating scripts and prompt libraries that showcase advanced agent capabilities.

On the go-to-market side, you’ll champion discoverability through Demo Hub, actively enable the global field on new offerings, and own the feedback loop that keeps the strategy sharp. You’ll manage programs across tools, solutions, and industries—driving alignment, mitigating risks, and owning critical metrics reporting on demo effectiveness. This is a high-visibility role with real influence on how Adobe shows up in front of customers!

What You'll Need Succeed

5+ years in demo strategy, solutions consulting, pre-sales, or a related GTM role

Direct experience with B2C and B2B digital marketing platforms (Adobe experience preferred)

Technical fluency with platform workflows, schemas, data flow, and integration points in a martech ecosystem

Track record managing complex, cross-functional programs across product, marketing, engineering, and field teams

Excellent communicator—comfortable presenting to senior leaders and global audiences

Strong academic credentials including a bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or Information Technology, and an MBA or equivalent experience. PMP or PgMP certification is preferred.

The Art of Sales is changing:

The concept of selling has been around for decades, but businesses are digital now. The way sales are conducted must modernize too.

In most companies, sales teams are somewhere on the journey below:

(1) Sales scratch out their own leads by prospecting their networks, sending one-off or batch emails.

(2) Marketing turns over long lists of leads, which typically contacts in your target audience

On the other hand, we at Adobe – ICX sales are a Modern Sales Team of 400+ Digital sellers, supported by analytics and data science teams. We are integrated with Adobe.com digital marketing & engagement funnel and are developing capabilities on picking cues from the customers demographic (who) & behavioral (what) data that they leave on their journey with our business to predict next ‘sales action’ that will lead to revenue conversions (Future state).

The Challenge: 

We are building a team of Account Managers who will work with a focused cohort of the reseller transacted book of business.

This role is crucial in driving revenue growth through strategic cross-sell and upsell initiatives. 

The incumbent would be responsible for helping the customers adopt the solution with ease, optimizing their product experience and guiding them to internal support teams if need be.

This role entails the entire gambit of account management like Strategic Account planning, Client Need assessment, building connect strategies with multiple stakeholders, conducting extensive account reviews, driving growth through cross selling / upselling and building long term relationships. KPIs for this role will be maximizing Net ARR by growing Gross and mitigating Cancels.

What you’ll do as an Account Manager

Plays a critical role in developing and managing relationships with large customers from ICX book of business.

Build and nurture strong relationships with managers and decision-makers in these large accounts. Expand business relationships beyond IT and Procurement into the C-Suite. You will need to map target org at departmental level to succeed in this role.

Drive revenue growth by identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities. You would be responsible for driving Net ARR from the allocated customers for the various Digital Media solutions.

Account manager’s primary goal will be to understand Customer’s business needs / pain points on document workflows & creative content creation, offer solutions, and foster long-term partnerships that drive business growth.

Identify growth opportunities and revenue potential within the accounts.

Research customer contracts and purchasing history in Adobe's various customer management systems & external sources such as LinkedIn, ZoomInfo, etc. to figure out the expansion opportunity in an account.

Devise customized connect strategy based on the account plan.

Identify the segments that have a high propensity for Adobe’s solutions and then plan customer outreach and meetings.

Sell into multiple levels of an organization, performing outbound prospecting to existing customers to identify new business relationships.

Engage customers daily via Teams / Video calls to conducting extensive account reviews.

During the account review understand clients' strategic goals, challenges, and pain points, and propose tailored solutions to address them. Develop and execute strategic account plans that align with clients' business objectives.

Lead negotiations and pricing discussions to achieve mutually beneficial outcomes.

You will serve as a trusted advisor ensuring the successful deployment of products.

Address any issues or concerns promptly to maintain positive client relationships.

Stay informed about industry trends, regulatory changes, and the competitive landscape of Document / Creative domain. Provide clients with valuable insights and thought leadership on industry best practices.

Collaborate with Solution Specialists to maximize footprint of growing Adobe Solution streams like Adobe Acrobat & Sign, Creative Cloud, Substance, Stock etc.

Managing the opportunity pipeline from week to week, providing accurate and timely updates to management on progress and outlook.

Act as the voice of the client within the organization, representing their interests and needs.

What you need to succeed

MM/SMB Segment exposure and proven ability to manage a large customer set.

4 + Years’ experience in a similar role, with experience in selling SAAS solutions preferred.

Proven track record leading a matrixed organization to sell SAAS solutions and the ability to expand influence to multiple stakeholders in the customer environment

Ability to forge and maintain strong business relationships from IT to the C-Suite.

Excellent communication and presentation skills and capable of presenting with any person, at any level within a customer.

Proven experience of using quantitative and qualitative analysis to identify new sales opportunities.

Should have skills that clearly demonstrate the ability to manage accounts and sell solutions.

Flair for technology and ability to lead a customer conversation with value-selling rather than product features pitch.

Ability to independently give basic product demos to customers.

EMEA Sales Experience preferably.

Bachelor’s Degree or Equivalent

The Opportunity
Adobe is seeking a Staff Machine Learning Engineer/Architect to lead the development of next-generation personalization models and intelligent AI agents within Adobe Experience Platform (AEP).
Our team is building intelligent agent systems that can autonomously design, generate, optimize, and evaluate personalization models at scale. These agents reason over customer data, business objectives, and experimentation signals to create adaptive models that continuously improve digital experiences.
As a senior member of the AI team, you will own the end-to-end lifecycle of personalization AI systems, from research and modeling to production deployment, monitoring, and MLOps automation. You will work at the intersection of personalization modeling, multimodal LLMs, agentic reasoning, real-time decisioning, and enterprise-scale ML infrastructure.
This role is ideal for engineers and applied scientists who want to build production-grade AI systems that autonomously power personalization, targeting, ranking, and next-best-action strategies across billions of interactions.
You’ll collaborate closely with Adobe Research, Product Management, and Platform Engineering to ensure AI-driven personalization is not an add-on—but a foundational capability embedded across Adobe’s Digital Experience products.

What You’ll Do

Design and build advanced personalization models including propensity models, recommendation models and systems, uplift models, reinforcement learning, and generative personalization systems.

Develop LLM-powered intelligent agents that can generate and tune personalization models, automate experimentation and model optimization and recommend next-best-actions and targeting strategies

Architect and implement end-to-end ML systems, including:

Feature engineering pipelines (batch and streaming)

Model training and evaluation frameworks

Low-latency inference systems

Build and scale real-time decisioning systems that operate across high-throughput enterprise environments.

Lead MLOps initiatives, including CI/CD for ML, model versioning, monitoring, drift detection, automated retraining, and performance governance.

Drive system reliability, scalability, and observability across distributed ML services.

Partner with product leaders to translate personalization strategy into measurable business impact.

Mentor engineers on modern ML practices, agentic AI design, and production grade ML architecture.

Champion responsible AI and personalization practices, focusing on interpretability, fairness, safety, and user trust.

What You Need to Succeed

Bachelor’s degree with 8+ years of experience, or PhD with 5+ years building and deploying ML systems at scale.

Deep expertise in personalization systems, recommendation models, or real-time decisioning architectures.

Some experience with LLMs, agentic systems, prompt engineering, RAG, or context engineering, especially in production environments.

Proven success building and shipping end-to-end ML systems, from research to deployment and ongoing optimization.

Hands-on experience with MLOps best practices, including model lifecycle management, monitoring, automated retraining, CI/CD for ML, and large-scale inference systems.

Proficiency in Python and ML frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, HuggingFace, LangChain, or equivalent.

Strong analytical skills with the ability to connect modeling decisions to business metrics such as lift, engagement, and customer lifetime value.

Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills and demonstrated technical leadership.

Experience bridging research and production in enterprise scale AI applications.

Creative problem-solving skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.

Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across all levels of the organization.

The Opportunity 

Adobe is seeking a bold, strategic leader to define and scale our global strategy for the Technology sector. This role spans software, hardware, semiconductor, electronics, cloud and platform companies, Professional Services, and Agency Networks, often with complex B2B, B2C and B2B2C value chains. 

As the Global Industry Strategy Lead, Technology, you will define Adobe’s industry point-of-view (POV) and translate it into a globally aligned, cross-cloud (Adobe Digital Experience + Adobe Digital Media) go-to-market (GTM) strategy. You will partner deeply across Sales, Product Management, Product Marketing, Solution Consulting, Customer Success, and Marketing to unify Adobe’s narrative, accelerate pipeline, and drive repeatable impact across regions. 

 

This role sits within the Digital Strategy Group (DSG) and plays a critical part in Adobe’s Global Industry Strategy team—responsible for shaping Adobe’s industry vision, value propositions, and high-impact strategic motions at scale. 

 

Key Responsibilities 

1. Develop Adobe’s POV for the Future of Technology 

Lead the creation of a differentiated, forward-looking POV that demonstrates how Adobe enables transformation across the entire Technology customer and partner ecosystem. 
This includes: 

· Demonstrating value across product-led growth motions, partner ecosystems, B2B commerce models, cloud & platform engagement, and customer lifecycle experiences 

· Shaping strategic use cases across data, personalization, content supply chain modernization, global marketing operations, and unified measurement 

· Developing reusable global assets: frameworks, POVs, use-case libraries, playbooks, industry demos, and Bill of Materials (BOM) content for sales, DSG, and partners 

You will collaborate closely with strategists, technologists, data scientists, partner organizations, and field teams to define what “great” looks like—and how Adobe helps Technology companies get there. 

 

2. Sharpen and Coordinate a Global GTM Strategy 

Translate the industry POV into a globally aligned, high-impact GTM motion. 
You will: 

· Align strategy across sales plays, product requirements, partner motions, and regional needs 

· Ensure GTM motions scale globally—not tied to a single region, account list, or narrow set of priorities 

· Provide input to product and engineering teams around emerging trends, customer patterns, and required capabilities 

· Collaborate with partner teams to define joint assets, accelerators, and co-sell strategies 

This role ensures Adobe shows up to the Technology industry with one coordinated voice and one unified strategy. 

 

3. Drive Influence Through High-Leverage Thought Leadership 

Focus on fewer, more strategic deliverables that scale across the business. 
This includes: 

· Authoring frameworks, POVs, and industry narratives used across Adobe’s global ecosystem 

· Identifying where Adobe has a differentiated “right to win” in Technology 

· Codifying insights from customer work into reusable global assets, such as customer success stories 

· Monitoring industry trends to ensure Adobe stays ahead of market shifts, emerging business models, and new experience expectations 

The impact of your work will be measured by clarity, adoption, and influence—not volume. 

 

4. Engage Executives Strategically (primarily 1:many, and 1:1 for top priority accounts) 

Represent Adobe as a trusted advisor in Technology executive settings. 
You will: 

· Lead Adobe’s involvement in industry events, executive forums, and roundtables 

· Present compelling, strategic thought leadership to C-suite audiences 

· Support high-value pursuits, Customer Experience Center (CEC) briefings, and strategic account engagements 

· Sponsor and cultivate key customers, enabling case studies, customer keynotes, and repeatable stories of impact 

Your goal is to maximize industry influence at scale while supporting the strategic deals that matter most. 

 

5. Amplify Global Marketing and Upskill the Ecosystem 

Partner with global marketing and field teams to amplify Adobe’s Technology leadership. 

 
You will: 

· Shape global campaigns, messaging, and event strategies 

· Guide positioning for AI-driven innovation in Technology 

· Enable DSG, field teams, SCs, BDRs, and partners with reusable training, demos, and toolkits 

· Build a consistent global drumbeat of Adobe-led thought leadership 

This role turns Adobe’s Technology capabilities into a cohesive, globally recognized story. 

 

What You Need to Succeed 

Success is defined by the clarity you create, the global alignment you drive, and the measurable impact on Adobe’s Technology business. 

Ideal candidates bring: 

· 10+ years of experience in the Technology sector (software, hardware, cloud, semiconductor, electronics, strategy consulting, or platform provider) 

· Deep understanding of digital transformation within Technology: customer data, AI/ML, personalization, content supply chain, omnichannel experiences, B2B engagement, product-led growth, and measurement 

· Proven success building and executing strategic transformation programs 

· Experience aligning GTM strategies across sales, product, and partner teams, ideally with global scope 

· Ability to distill complex topics into clear, scalable frameworks and POVs 

· Outstanding executive presence with extensive experience presenting to C-suite audiences 

· Excellent storytelling, narrative development, and written communication skills 

· Highly collaborative mindset with the ability to influence in matrixed environments 

· Comfort navigating ambiguity with an entrepreneurial, opportunity-driven mindset 

· Willingness to travel up to 40%

· Open to candidates in PST, MST and PST time zones, with a strong preference for PST

Job Description

The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Account Executive to drive opportunity within our Solution-led business. You will be responsible for exceeding sales targets through the sale of Adobe's leading edge Digital Experience solutions within our Enterprise segment. As an Account Executive, you will drive revenue from an account base of our largest customers within Solution-Led, providing strategic partnership to help them solve their biggest challenges. You will work across the Adobe ecosystem to eliminate barriers and accelerate time to sale. The ideal candidate is someone with a competitive mentality who thrives on being on the front lines, prospecting, consultative value selling, closing deals, and winning!

What you'll Do

Drive sales for Adobe’s Digital Experience solutions by delivering targeted sales strategies, overcoming objections, and creating compelling business cases to expand adoption within an existing Adobe customer base.

Manage your time and territory by prioritizing accounts, aligning activities for maximum impact, and balancing short-term wins with long-term growth opportunities.

Collaborate within a matrixed ecosystem including internal sales and cross-functional teams (Product, Marketing, Legal, Finance) to align resources, enhance value, and deliver a unified customer experience.

Build and expand executive relationships through thoughtful, ongoing engagement — gaining access to senior decision-makers (e.g., VP, SVP, CxO), leveraging champions, and crafting shareable, value-driven communications.

Stay informed on customer needs, competitive dynamics, and market trends, contributing thought leadership and sharing insights across peers and teams.

Act as a long-term strategic advisor by diagnosing business problems, tailoring and aligning Adobe Digital Experience solutions to their strategic objectives, and delivering persuasive cases that clearly demonstrate the impact of our value.

Use data and insights to manage complex sales cycles, guide strategic business reviews, ensure forecast accuracy, and consistently progress deals across your territory.

Perform outbound selling activities, conduct account-level research, and collaborate with Partner and Marketing teams to generate demand, build credibility with customers, and create a compelling vision to drive urgency and justify investment for your customers.

Build and maintain a strong pipeline of customer opportunities / revenue generation and exceed targets.

What you need to succeed

Resilience, adaptability, and strong negotiation skills.

Proactiveness, competitiveness, and ability to exceed sales targets.

Awareness of trends and customer-focused value selling.

Persuasiveness, clear communication, and effective presentation.

Trust, collaboration, and account management.

Self-awareness, open-mindedness, and curiosity.

Focus, flexibility, and drive.

Bachelor's Degree and 1 year of experience OR 3 years of equivalent practical experience.

Minimum 5 years of experience in SaaS sales.

3+ years of experience with marketing technology solutions and/or consultative platform sales preferred.

The opportunity 

From the moment you wake up in the morning, until you go to bed at night, consider the media you consume, the adverts you see, the apps you use, the websites you browse, and almost all of the shopping you do online throughout the day. Chances are that every single one of those interactions or experiences was touched by an Adobe product. We have a phenomenal opportunity for a Business Development Representative (BDR) to join our Digital Experience teams in Munich, Germany! 

What you’ll do

As a Business Development Representative (BDR), we will work together to help our prospects re-imagine their customer experiences using Adobe solutions. You’ll play a key role in building strong relationships with potential customers and creating meaningful sales opportunities for our Account Executives.

We’ll rely on you to engage with high-value prospects, understand their business goals and challenges, and take a truly consultative approach to every conversation. Together, we’ll identify, qualify, and develop opportunities that add real value to our customers and create a healthy, balanced sales pipeline.

You’ll collaborate closely with Sales, Solution Consulting, and Marketing teams as one Adobe team, running inbound and outbound activities across your territory. From researching accounts and identifying decision-makers to leading first-level qualification meetings and handing over well-qualified opportunities, you’ll be involved across the entire early sales journey.

We’ll also count on you to keep our systems up to date and share feedback that helps us continuously improve how we work and grow — because we believe great ideas can come from anywhere!

What you’ll need to succeed

We’re looking for someone who is fluent in German and English and excited about starting or growing a career in Sales or Business Development within a SaaS environment, ideally working with enterprise customers.

You enjoy engaging with people, asking the right questions, and building relationships across different levels of an organization. You’re comfortable managing inbound and outbound activities, handling objections, and qualifying opportunities, while staying curious about our customers’ businesses and challenges.

We value people who take ownership, work independently, and collaborate naturally with others. If you’re motivated, resilient, and eager to learn, you’ll feel right at home here! Familiarity with CRM systems and sales tools is helpful, but just as important is your willingness to grow and develop with us.

Why join us?

At Adobe, we truly care about our people — and that shows in the way we invest in your growth, wellbeing, and success. We offer a structured onboarding experience, continuous learning opportunities, and clear career paths across the broader Adobe ecosystem. In addition, our benefits are world-class, covering everything from competitive compensation and flexible work models to holistic health and wellbeing programs — and many more. You can find a full overview of our benefits in Germany here: https://rewards.adobe.com/germany/

Most importantly, you’ll join a collaborative, inclusive team, work on meaningful products used by millions every day, and grow alongside people who genuinely want to see you succeed!

Job Description

We are looking for a dedicated Customer Success Manager to join our ambitious Digital Media team. This outstanding opportunity allows you to work directly with customers, encouraging product adoption and value realization across Adobe’s world-class portfolio of Digital Media Cloud offerings. By developing trusted advisor-level partnerships with key customer collaborators, you will deliver product presentations and point-of-view documents that build awareness and excitement among customer power users.

 

What You'll Do

 

Maintain deep product knowledge and customer guidelines across our Cloud suite.

Build and maintain positive relationships with customers, understanding their needs, and ensuring their happiness with Adobe’s products and services.

Assist customers in effectively implementing and adopting the product, ensuring they achieve their desired outcomes and improve the value they derive from it.

Position Adobe’s complementary products alongside Creative and Document Cloud in relevant and value-focused ways. Ensure customers engage with the entire Cloud portfolio.

Build and deliver product value presentations and point-of-view documents to customer collaborators and executives.

Proficient German communication skills are required. Both written and verbal.

Data Engineer - Last Mile & Application Layer (Tron Analytics Platform)

Are you passionate about delivering flawless data solutions that drive business impact? We are seeking a dedicated Data Engineer to join our team in San Jose, CA! At Adobe, you will play a pivotal role in our ambitious projects, ensuring our data pipelines and application layers are world-class.

What you'll do day-to-day

Work closely with business collaborators and data engineering teams to understand requirements and onboarding needs. Then, translate these into reliable, scalable integrations on Tron and supporting BI tools.

Compose, build, and maintain last-mile data pipelines that ingest, transform, and deliver data from various systems into the Tron ecosystem. Ensure the pipelines provide high quality, low latency, and resilience.

Architect and implement the application metadata layer that connects underlying data models to the UI, crafting a clean, maintainable bridge that makes Tron intuitive for end users.

Partner with the core development team to debug production issues, QA/test new platform features, and validate data and application components end-to-end.

Serve as a trusted technical partner to collaborators and platform users, tackling analytics-related questions and proactively supporting evolving business needs.

What you'll bring

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a closely related technical field.

5+ years of deep SQL expertise, performance tuning, and building solutions across multiple database platforms.

Strong hands-on comfort in Unix/Shell environments, combined with experience in Spark and Python for data processing and pipeline logic.

5+ years working directly in major cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP).

Practical working experience with Git for version control, JIRA for task tracking, and modern IDEs for efficient development.

Nice-to-haves that would make you stand out

Experience building or extending internal analytics/BI platforms.

Familiarity with data observability tools or implementing custom monitoring/tracing.

Exposure to infrastructure-as-code or CI/CD for data pipelines.

Background collaborating across distributed/global teams.

This is a hands-on role with real ownership—your work will directly build how fast and reliably our teams get trusted data to make decisions. About Adobe Firefly

Adobe Firefly is the industry's premier generative AI media model, designed to be safe for commercial use. It is now expanding beyond static imagery into high-fidelity Video and deep ecosystem Extensibility, empowering enterprises to generate on-brand content at scale wherever they work.

The Opportunity

Join Adobe’s boldest investment in generative AI as the Director of Product Management for Firefly Enterprise.

This is a dual-mandate role for a seasoned product leader. You will define the product strategy for two critical growth engines:

Firefly Video: Bringing our innovative Generative Video models to enterprise workflows, enabling marketers and creatives to generate, edit, and localize video assets at scale. Extensibility: Shaping how Firefly integrates into the broader enterprise ecosystem—driving our strategy for Plugins (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, Figma) and APIs that allow businesses to build custom apps on top of our models.

This opportunity is ideal for a leader who thrives at the intersection of media technology (specifically video), platform strategy, and enterprise SaaS.

What You’ll Do

Strategic Leadership (Video & Extensibility): Define the long-term product vision and strategy for Firefly’s Enterprise Video offerings and our Extensibility platform. You will identify high-value enterprise use cases for generative video and prioritize the APIs/SDKs needed to win the ecosystem war.

Leadership & Coaching: Lead, mentor, and grow a team of Product Managers, fostering their development into world-class product leaders who can navigate complex technical domains.

Collaborator Collaboration: Partner closely with Engineering Directors, Compose leaders, and fellow Product Directors in the US and Europe to ensure seamless alignment. You will be the bridge between the "Core Model" teams and the "Enterprise Workflow" teams.

Ecosystem & Partnership Model: Define the product requirements for key third-party integrations (e.g., Microsoft, Google, Slack) and internal Adobe integrations (Express, Premiere Pro, AEM), ensuring Firefly is "everywhere work happens."

Org Impact & Scale: Champion the India product team’s capabilities, working to expand their ownership of critical business lines like Video and Developer Platforms within the global organization.

Strategic Contribution: Serve as a thought partner influencing the broader Digital Media strategy, particularly on how multimodal AI (Video + Audio) changes the enterprise content supply chain.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

18+ years of professional experience, with at least 12+ years in Product Management leadership roles.

Video / Media Domain Expertise: Proven experience building products in the video, animation, or multimedia space. You understand the complexities of video workflows (codecs, rendering, timeline editing) and the needs of enterprise video producers.

Platform & Extensibility Experience: Track record of building API-first products, Developer Platforms, or Ecosystem integrations. You understand how to build products that other developers build upon.

Enterprise SaaS Success: Proven success building and scaling Enterprise products across global markets, with a deep understanding of security, governance, and brand control requirements.

Exceptional Leadership: Ability to inspire trust and alignment across senior leaders, engineering, design, and Go-To-Market (GTM) teams. Strong executive presence is a requirement.

A passion for innovation: A drive to craft the future of work, specifically how Generative AI will transform video production and software interoperability.

The Art of Sales is changing: The concept of selling has been around for decades, but businesses are digital now. The way sales are conducted must modernize too. In most companies, sales teams are somewhere on the journey below:

(1) Sales scratches out their own leads by prospecting their networks, sending one-off or batch emails.

(2) Marketing turns over long lists of leads, which are typically contacts in your target audience On the other hand, we at Adobe – ICX sales are a Modern Sales Team of 400+ Digital sellers, supported by analytics and data science teams. We are integrated with Adobe.com digital marketing & engagement funnel and are developing capabilities on picking cues from the customers demographic (who) & behavioral (what) data that they leave on their journey with our business to predict next ‘sales action’ that will lead to revenue conversions (Future state).

The Challenge: We are expanding a team of Account Managers who will work with a focused cohort of the reseller transacted book of business to expand and grow Adobe’s footprint. This role is crucial in driving revenue growth through strategic cross-sell and upsell initiatives. The incumbent would be responsible for helping the customers adopt the solution with ease, optimizing their product experience and guiding them to internal support teams if need be. This role entails nurturing and co-selling with partners where a rep. will be responsible for the entire gambit of account management like Strategic Account planning, Client Need assessment, building connects strategies with multiple stakeholders, conducting extensive account reviews, driving growth through cross-selling / upselling, and building long-term relationships. KPIs for this role will be maximizing Net ARR by growing Gross and mitigating Cancels.

What you’ll do as an Account Manager

• Plays a critical role in developing and managing relationships with large customers from the ICX-Reseller book of business.

• Build Connects and nurture strong relationships with managers and decision-makers in these large accounts. Expand business relationships beyond IT and Procurement into the C-Suite. You will need to map target org at departmental level to succeed in this role.

• Drive revenue growth by identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities. You would be responsible for driving Net ARR from the allocated customers for the various Digital Media solutions.

• One of the key measurement metrics will be how well a rep can reach out to the large book of business, building connections and engagements.

• Account manager’s primary goal will be to understand Customer’s business needs / pain points on document workflows & creative content creation, offer solutions, and foster long-term partnerships that drive business growth.

• Managing the opportunity pipeline from week to week, providing accurate and timely updates to management on progress and outlook. As an Account manager, you will be responsible and measured on how well you are executing on the key products such as Acrobat, Acrobat AI, Express, Acrobat Sign

• Research customer contracts and purchasing history in Adobe's various customer management systems & external sources such as LinkedIn, ZoomInfo, etc. to figure out the expansion opportunity in an account.

•Devise customized connect strategy based on the account plan.

•Identify the segments that have a high propensity for Adobe’s solutions and then plan customer outreach and meetings.

•Sell into multiple levels of an organization, performing outbound prospecting to existing customers to identify new business relationships.

•Engage customers daily via Teams / Video calls to conducting extensive account reviews.

•During the account review understand clients' strategic goals, challenges, and pain points, and propose tailored solutions to address them. Develop and execute strategic account plans that align with clients' business objectives.

•Lead negotiations and pricing discussions to achieve mutually beneficial outcomes.

•You will serve as a trusted advisor ensuring the successful deployment of products.

•Address any issues or concerns promptly to maintain positive client relationships.

•Stay informed about industry trends, regulatory changes, and the competitive landscape of Document / Creative domain. Provide clients with valuable insights and thought leadership on industry best practices.

•Collaborate with Solution Specialists to maximize footprint of growing Adobe Solution streams like Adobe Acrobat & Sign, Creative Cloud, Substance, Stock etc.

•Act as the voice of the client within the organization, representing their interests and needs.

What you need to succeed

•MM/Enterprise Segment exposure and proven ability to manage a large customer set.

•3 + Years’ experience in a similar role, with experience in selling SAAS solutions preferred.

•Proven track record leading a matrixed organization to sell SAAS solutions and the ability to expand influence on multiple stakeholders in the customer environment

•Ability to forge and maintain strong business relationships from IT to the C-Suite.

•Excellent communication and presentation skills and capable of presenting with any person, at any level within a customer.

•Proven experience of using quantitative and qualitative analysis to identify new sales opportunities.

•Should have skills that clearly demonstrate the ability to manage accounts and sell solutions.

•Flair for technology and ability to lead a customer conversation with value-selling rather than product features pitch.

•Ability to independently give basic product demos to customers.

•International Sales Experience with exposure to NA markets preferably. •Working hours will coincide with the US Time Zones

•Bachelor’s Degree or Equivalent
