The Digital Strategy & Solutions Group works with Adobe customers across all levels ranging from C-level executives, with a focus on the CIO/CTO, to operational teams to advise on strategies and technology solutions to support customer-experience transformation and digital innovation, diving deep into architecture and identifying prioritized path forward for customers. Our engagements assess a customer’s current state experience ecosystem architecture, define the future-state technical vision Northstar Architecture, assess the gaps between the two, and then provide technical leadership to a sales cycle where we must overcome technical blockers and communicate the business value of a combined solution of Adobe products to customer team members.

The Director of Enterprise Architects, will be managing a team of hard workers who blend technical and business skills to architect solutions for Adobe customers. Helping brands to fully capitalize on the era of digital transformation, so they can deliver personalized and impactful experiences across all devices and channels for their customers through architecture and aligning that to Adobe's solutions. The ability to see, measure, and analyze critical factors such as resources, outcomes, and priorities keeps everyone on the same page, and team members know why their work matters.

Reporting to the head of Enterprise Architecture, this customer-facing leadership role offers a rich opportunity to lead senior and principal architects. This leader will be the primary technical partner for a Sales VP/Industry head and be accountable for technical leadership for that vertical.

What you'll Do 

Act in a sponsorship capacity for deals within assigned patch of business to ensure application of team standard methodologies and procedures while also driving revenue outcomes.

Identify, recruit, hire, onboard, empower, grow, enable, and retain top architect talent.

Prioritize technical workstreams against capacity while driving technical pipeline progression to meet and exceed bookings targets

Maintain operational cadence for reporting and updates that effectively communicates deal status to collaborators on and off the architecture team. Interact directly with individual contributors and leaders in presales, sales, product management, delivery (both Adobe and partner) and engineering.

Live on the cutting edge on Adobe products, industry trends, and competition. Align with Adobe DX processes and standards to ensure uniformity across DX product pre-sales.

What you need to succeed 

10+ Years of architecture experience working with one of the following: enterprise architecture, data architecture, or content architecture.

10+ years of people management experience. Software presales or sales experience. Strong executive presence, presentation skills, and documentation skills.

Ability to operate in a fast-paced and rapidly changing environment. Where processes and procedures often need to be adjusted along the way.

Familiarity with Adobe products, especially the Adobe Marketing Cloud and Adobe Experience platform.

Ability to partner effectively with customer IT and marketing leaders. Build rapport with salespeople, sales managers, and other presales staff.

Build relationships with Adobe & partner consultants and delivery leaders.

Solid understanding of current technical and architectural trends and concepts across key Adobe Experience functional areas of Data, Content, and Journeys.

Outstanding analytical and problem-solving skills. Including conducting research, developing hypotheses, and synthesizing recommendations.

Good interpersonal skills. Ability to work successfully with people at all levels in an organization. Ability to communicate complex ideas efficiently both verbally and in writing.

Proven track record of multi-functionally in a team environment

Passion for new knowledge, resourceful and able to absorb concepts quickly. Enjoy challenges and learning about industry and technology trends

High level of energy, personal drive, and positivity

Open to remote candidates within US who are willing to travel (as required)

About the Role

We are seeking a Principal Scientist (P60) to define and lead the data and semantic architecture that enables Adobe Firefly’s next‑generation unified foundation models—models that natively combine understanding, reasoning, and generation within a single system.
This role sits within the Applied Science and Machine Learning (ASML) organization and operates at the highest level of technical leadership. You will shape how meaning, intent, and abstraction are represented and learned at foundation‑model scale, influencing multiple generations of models and products. This is a highly strategic individual contributor role with broad organizational impact.

What You’ll Do

Foundation Model Data Vision

Define the multi‑year vision for understanding‑centric data that enables unified comprehension and generation.

Establish core principles for semantic representation, supervision, and curriculum at foundation‑model scale.

Identify limitations in existing data paradigms and drive the invention of new approaches.

Semantic Architecture & Alignment

Design canonical semantic abstractions that bridge perception‑level signals with high‑level concepts such as intent, reasoning, and compositional structure.

Lead the evolution of supervision schemas toward rich, model‑interpretable semantic signals.

Guide the use of multimodal and vision‑language models to bootstrap scalable understanding data.

Data Curriculum & Model Behavior

Define understanding‑focused data curricula across model scale and training phases.

Lead ablations to quantify how semantic data choices affect generalization, controllability, and robustness.

Balance organic, synthetic, and model‑generated data to optimize learning efficiency.

Organizational Leadership

Serve as the technical authority for foundation‑model understanding data across Adobe.

Influence research, infrastructure, and product roadmaps through principled, data‑driven guidance.

Mentor senior scientists and architects; set standards for rigor and reproducibility.

What You Need to Succeed

10+ years of experience in ML, data systems, or AI research, including leadership on large‑scale or foundation models.

Demonstrated impact shaping data, learning paradigms, or representations for LLMs or multimodal models.

Deep expertise in semantic representation, reasoning, and abstraction.

Strong intuition for interactions between data, model architecture, and training dynamics.

Ability to influence senior technical and business leaders through clear technical judgment.

Education

Ph.D. in Computer Science, Machine Learning, AI, or a related field strongly preferred.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for an experienced Director to lead our global Business Ethics and Integrity group. This is an exciting opportunity to join Adobe’s Legal and Government Relations organization and help shape a world-class ethics and compliance program. Reporting to Adobe’s Vice President and Chief Compliance Officer, you’ll be working on the front lines to ensure that Adobe acts with integrity in all areas of its business.

You’ll bring deep expertise in building and scaling ethics, compliance and risk management programs and governance. You’re a strong people leader who thrives on inspiring teams, mentoring and developing talent. You love working cross-functionally to build and maintain collaborative working relationships throughout the company. You’ll work closely with senior leadership and business partners to maintain Adobe’s culture of integrity, operate compliance programs at scale, and manage and mitigate risk to the company.

What You’ll Do

Lead and continuously evolve a global program aligned to regulatory expectations, company strategy and enterprise risk priorities.

Manage global anti-corruption and third-party compliance programs including program design, operations, advice, M&A due diligence and integrations, and risk-based monitoring.

Collaborate with legal and business colleagues to ensure compliance with public sector laws and regulations.

Develop and implement scalable training and awareness efforts aligned to Adobe's core values, business risk, and legal/regulatory requirements. Establish metrics and analytics to identify program effectiveness, gaps and emerging risk trends.

Build and mature compliance risk assessment processes, strengthen controls and monitoring systems in partnership with cross-functional teams.

Drive continuous innovation, scale and efficiency by using AI and other technologies in all aspects of program design and execution, including risk assessment, governance, training and educating, monitoring and testing, and reporting.

Lead and develop a distributed, high-impact team with a focus on scaling efficiently for present and future needs.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

Bachelor’s Degree in relevant field; advanced degree such as J.D. or MBA and/or professional certification (e.g., CCPE) is preferred.

12+ years of relevant experience, with Fortune 250 experience preferred; 5+ years of people management experience.

A strong moral compass coupled with exceptional judgment and the ability to effectively balance priorities and manage risk in a highly dynamic, global environment.

Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills, strong executive presence and experience building relationships, leading teams, and influencing across all levels of the company.

A global mentality, an unflaggingly positive attitude, and a great sense of humor.

Role Summary

Are you a dreamer with a passion for crafting outstanding user experiences? At Adobe, we are looking for a Digital Strategist who will play a pivotal role in developing and delivering user-centered experience strategies that drive measurable business outcomes. This is your opportunity to work on world-class projects, collaborate with highly skilled talent, and make a significant impact!

The Digital Strategist, Customer Experience (UX Strategy) focuses on UX strategy, systems thinking, and visual storytelling. You will turn customer insights, data, and business goals into clear experience guidance and engaging visual stories. Collaborating with senior strategists, UX and visual designers, researchers, and cross-functional partners, you will help develop the experience vision and direction—not only deciding what to build but explaining why it matters and how it brings value. You will communicate ideas using experience models, journey maps, frameworks, and diagrams that align partners and guide progress.
Success in this role means making complex experience ecosystems clear, practical, and scalable, while explicitly linking experience decisions to performance, feasibility, and business impact.

What You’ll Do

Apply human-centered thinking and UX strategy principles to frame experience challenges and opportunities across journeys, channels, and platforms.

Convert research, data, and business context into experience principles, journey frameworks, and strategic recommendations.

Evaluate experience options through a UX lens, considering usability, clarity, accessibility, emotional impact, and long-term scalability.

Build visually structured, decision-ready artifacts such as journey maps, service blueprints, conceptual models, ecosystem diagrams, and experience frameworks.

Demonstrate strong visual judgment—clear hierarchy, layout, flow, and narrative structure that guides understanding.

Partner closely with UX and visual designers, ensuring strategy intent is reflected in experience and build execution.

Translate ambiguous business and experience questions into structured UX strategy approaches, including hypotheses, options, and implications.

Make informed assumptions when information is incomplete, clearly articulating trade-offs, risks, and UX implications.

Balance experience vision with practical considerations such as delivery complexity, operational impact, and performance outcomes.

Communicate strategy through clear, visual storytelling, tailored to executives, designers, product teams, and technical partners.

Link experience decisions to business value, customer outcomes, and measurable success criteria.

Share progress, insights, and recommendations in a concise, structured way that enables confident decision-making.

Portfolio Expectations

Candidates should be prepared to share a portfolio of UX strategy work that demonstrates how they think, structure problems, and communicate visually. This role does not require high-fidelity UI or visual build execution, but it does require strong experience-build thinking and visual communication.
Your portfolio should show examples of:

Journey maps, experience frameworks, service blueprints, or ecosystem models

Strategic materials that distinctly transform insights into experience pathways and advice

Visual storytelling that simplifies complex systems, platforms, or organizational challenges

Work that connects user needs, business goals, and experience outcomes

Slides or artifacts built for executive or collaborator alignment, not just internal analysis

We’re especially interested in seeing:

How you structure ambiguity

How you visually explain experience strategy

How your work influenced decisions, alignment, or execution

Role Overview

A forward-thinking and experienced Senior Manager, Technical Support to lead a high-performing team focused on delivering world-class service for Adobe’s SMB (Small & Medium Business) customers across Adobe’s products and solutions. This role drives customer experience, operational excellence, and strategic cross-functional alignment—while building a scalable support model through AI-enabled interventions (automation, self-service, predictive support, and intelligent workflows).

This role blends relationship management, change enablement, and sales execution, creating an experience-centric culture in Tech Support that fosters growth, measurable business impact, and efficiency at scale.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Experience & Execution

Drive Tech Support performance to deliver goals/targets, including ARR, customer experience, and operational KPIs—with a primary focus on SMB customers.

Collaborate with internal GTM, PM, and PMM teams to execute joint business plans, campaigns, and targeted SMB growth/retention initiatives.

Change Leadership & Strategic Alignment

Lead change initiatives to improve overall customer experience and operational efficiency, including AI-led process improvements and automation.

Align the team with organizational goals and communicate updates effectively across stakeholders.

Performance Insights & Reporting

Establish and monitor KPIs/SLAs, leveraging analytics to identify trends and improvement opportunities—especially those impacting SMB scale and efficiency.

Provide regular business reviews and actionable insights to partners and internal leadership.

Relationship Building & Escalation Management

Collaborate cross-functionally with Product and Engineering to influence roadmap priorities—champion voice-of-the-customer insights on technical issues to improve product experience.

Own escalations and ensure timely resolution with strong stakeholder alignment.

Scale & Transformation (AI + Automation)

Drive initiatives to scale support operations, including knowledge management, self-service tools, and automation.

Define a long-term vision for intelligent, data-driven support, balancing human and AI-delivered service models.

Identify and implement AI interventions (e.g., chat/assist tools, case deflection, intelligent routing, predictive issue detection, auto-triage, and proactive prevention) to improve speed, reduce effort, and increase scalability—especially in high-volume SMB scenarios.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

Education

Graduated from a reputed UGC-recognized university or equivalent global standard; MBA preferred.

Understanding of customer journey mapping and lifecycle engagement strategy.

Preferred: ITIL, Six Sigma, or support process certifications (e.g., MCP, CCNA, etc.).

Experience / Skills

Solid technical fluency to interpret top technical issues, understand product architecture, and partner effectively with engineering teams.

12+ years of experience in technical support/customer success/sales-in-service within a SaaS environment, including 5+ years in a leadership capacity managing in-house Tech Support Operations.

Demonstrated experience supporting SMB customers at scale (high-volume, high-velocity support models), and improving outcomes through tech + process excellence.

Strong capability in driving AI-enabled workflows and intelligent automation to improve Product NPS and reduce Conversations per MAU through automation, predictive detection, and proactive prevention strategies.

Familiarity with Adobe product suites (Adobe Experience Cloud, Creative Cloud, or Document Cloud).

Familiarity with Windows, iOS, Android, and macOS environments.

Success Measures (KPIs)

Growth – Value added delivery (Revenue & ARR)

ARD (Average Resolution Days)

SLA Compliance – SL & Abd

Conversion Rate (Upsell/Cross-sell)

Position Overview

The Business Operations Lead for Sales Operations & Enablement will play a critical role in ensuring the organization operates with clarity, alignment, and disciplined execution. This role anchors the business planning and operational rhythms of the Sales Ops & Enablement team—driving budget and workforce planning, operational governance, prioritization frameworks, organizational effectiveness, and performance tracking.

You will partner closely with HR, Finance, and leaders across Sales Operations & Enablement to create structure, establish operating mechanisms, and ensure the organization remains focused on the highest‑impact priorities. You will help define goals, measure outcomes, and enable the team to execute with consistency and scale.

This position is ideal for someone who is energized by strategic operational work, cross‑functional coordination, and building systems that help an organization run effectively at scale.

Why This Role Matters

This role ensures that the Sales Operations & Enablement organization runs as a coordinated, aligned, and high‑performing system. By driving planning, operational discipline, and structured execution, the Business Operations Lead enables the team to focus on the work that accelerates impact and strengthens organizational effectiveness.

Key Responsibilities

Business & Organizational Operations

Lead the operating rhythm for the Sales Ops & Enablement organization, including planning cycles, leadership reviews, performance tracking, and operational governance.

Maintain organizational priorities and ensure alignment, transparency, and accountability across programs and workstreams.

Drive goal‑setting, OKR development, milestone planning, and KPI measurement for the organization.

Identify operational gaps and opportunities; design and implement process improvements that enhance effectiveness and scalability.

Budget, Workforce, and Talent Planning

Partner with Finance and HR to coordinate annual and ongoing budget cycles, forecasting, headcount planning, and workforce strategy.

Develop models, analyses, and frameworks to support resource planning, investment trade‑offs, and organizational decision‑making.

Provide leaders with timely insights that clarify capacity, spending, and resource needs.

Organizational Health & Engagement

Partner with HR to support employee engagement strategies, organizational health assessments, and team development initiatives.

Lead planning and execution for organizational activities such as offsites, planning workshops, and leadership sessions.

Foster a culture of alignment, focus, and operational excellence.

Planning, Insights, and Performance Enablement

Develop and maintain scorecards, dashboards, and reporting mechanisms that track organizational performance and progress against key priorities.

Conduct operational and organizational analyses to highlight risks, opportunities, and focus areas.

Enable data‑driven decision-making through structured insights and performance reporting.

Cross‑Functional Partnership

Serve as a strategic operational partner to HR, Finance, and adjacent GTM Ops functions.

Ensure alignment with corporate planning cycles, financial processes, talent programs, and enterprise operating mechanisms.

Collaborate with the Communications Lead to ensure coordination on timing and alignment for key organizational moments—without owning communications directly.

Strategic Execution & Change Enablement

Translate organizational strategy into operational plans, workstreams, and scalable processes.

Support rollout and adoption of new programs, systems, and operating practices across the organization.

Lead change enablement activities that improve readiness, efficiency, and organizational performance.

Qualifications

8–12+ years’ experience in business operations, organizational operations, program management, or strategic planning roles.

Experience partnering with HR and Finance on planning, budgeting, workforce strategy, and operational processes.

Strong capability in building operational rhythms, planning frameworks, and performance tracking systems.

Excellent analytical skills and comfort with building structured models, KPIs, and decision-support frameworks.

Strong stakeholder management skills and executive-level presence.

Proven ability to bring clarity, structure, and rigor to complex or ambiguous environments.

Nice to have

Experience within Sales Operations, Sales Enablement, or GTM Operations organizations.

Experience with OKRs, enterprise planning cycles, or business management frameworks.

Background in SaaS, Technology, or Strategy/Operations functions.

Job Description — Sr. Backend Engineer (P40) (Java, Hadoop)
 

Roles and Responsibilities 

Adobe Pass is a well-established product suite serving the TV Everywhere industry, powering authentication and access experiences for major North American media and entertainment providers. We operate our systems at massive scale, supporting major live sports, business, and lifestyle events across millions of viewers. 

We are now expanding our team with a Senior Backend Engineer who thrives in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment and is passionate about building scalable, secure, and high-performance systems. The ideal candidate has strong technical depth across frontend and backend technologies, a keen eye for system design, and a proven ability to mentor others while delivering high-quality, production-ready software in an agile setup. 
 

Responsibilities 

Design and develop end-to-end web applications using modern frontend and backend technologies. 

Architect and implement scalable RESTful APIs using Java, Spring Boot, and microservices. 

Lead design discussions and make architectural decisions that ensure scalability, reliability, and performance. 

Drive observability, monitoring, and reliability through effective instrumentation and alerting practices. 

Own the performance and resiliency of SLA-critical APIs, ensuring optimal response times and uptime. 

Implement and enforce best practices for security, including authentication, authorization, and data protection at all layers. 

Collaborate with cross-functional teams — including product managers, designers, and engineers — to deliver intuitive, high-impact solutions. 

Contribute to shared frameworks, libraries, and engineering standards that enhance code quality and reusability. 

Conduct code reviews, design reviews, and provide technical mentorship to junior engineers. 

Continuously evaluate emerging technologies, tools, and frameworks to drive innovation and efficiency within the team. 
 

What You Need to Succeed 

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, with 8+ years of experience building and operating full-stack, production-grade web applications. 

Strong fundamentals in computer science, data structures, algorithms, and large-scale system design. 

Deep expertise in Java, Spring Boot, RESTful web services, and microservices architecture.

Define and Lead the Monetization & Premium Strategy

Establish a 2–3 year vision for monetization and premium value across Express, owning strategy across direct funnels and cross-product integrations.

Drive monetization innovation—including credit systems, AI metering, bundled value, and personalized offers.

Drive Ecosystem Growth & Scalable Monetization Infrastructure

Expand revenue contribution from Acrobat, Creative Cloud, and Firefly integrations through scalable entitlement, upsell, and cross-product monetization frameworks.

Build and evolve the experimentation, platform, and measurement systems that power premium discovery, paid engagement, and AI monetization.

Ensure systems readiness for emerging AI capabilities and complex entitlement logic while maintaining operational rigor and customer trust.

Lead a High-Performing Organization & Influence Across Adobe

Grow, mentor, and develop a team of senior and principal PMs while elevating strategic thinking, execution quality, and cross-functional influence across engineering, design, and data science.

Establish operating principles that drive focus, velocity, and innovation.

Position Express as a center of excellence for PLG and freemium strategy, representing Premium Enablement in enterprise-wide planning, leadership forums, and monetization strategy development.

What You’ll Bring

10+ years of product leadership experience in SaaS, subscription, or PLG-driven environments.

Demonstrated success owning multi-million to nine-figure revenue portfolios.

Deep expertise in lifecycle optimization, experimentation frameworks, and subscription monetization.

Experience leading Principal and Senior PM teams

Strong executive presence and ability to influence VP+ stakeholders.

Experience monetizing AI-powered products or credit-based systems is highly desirable.

Ability to navigate ambiguity, strategic pivots, and ecosystem-level tradeoffs.

Why This Role Matters
Premium Enablement is central to Express’s ability to scale sustainably within Adobe’s ecosystem. This manager will:

Drive significant incremental GNARR across direct and integrated funnels.

Improve retention and lifetime value through paid engagement strategy.

Enable scalable monetization of AI innovation.

Shape how Adobe evolves its Product-Led Growth strategy across surfaces.

As a Senior Director, Marketing Strategy & Operations, you will be a strategic leader who applies world-class problem-solving skills to our most critical organizational challenges. Education: Bachelor's degree required; MBA from a top-tier program is a significant plus.

Design, build, test, and maintain AI/ML-based systems and applications that serve as the backbone of scalable, production-ready technology stacks.

Frame product features as ML tasks (e.g., classification, recommendation, context engineering).

Strong understanding of transfer learning principles and their application in production settings.

Proficiency in Python (especially for data workflows) and experience with ML/DL frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow/Keras, CUDA, Hugging Face, and JAX.

Experience designing and deploying scalable AI/ML systems optimized for GPU/TPU environments.

Strong understanding of how to transform models into reliable, production-grade services.

Preferred Attributes

Recognized as a thought leader within and beyond the organization.

Experience mentoring senior engineers and shaping engineering culture.

Contributions to industry forums, conferences, or open-source communities.

Drive partner created sales pipeline and bookings across your assigned sales segments.

Passion for getting things done in an ambiguous environment.

Lead and consolidate the topline rolling financial forecast process.

Support Outlook, Quarterly Rolling Forecast (QRF), and Annual Planning cycles.

Determine appropriate forecasting methodologies, modeling techniques, drivers, and assumptions.

Identify and refine key variables that improve forecast accuracy and business insights.

Perform variance analysis between actuals, forecasts, and plans; drive deep root-cause analysis and clear explanations for leadership.

Reporting & Executive Support

Develop and consolidate financial reporting and analysis, including quarterly results packages for executive financial reviews.

Build and track important metrics to drive business performance and monitor growth initiatives.

Deliver concise, data-driven commentary and executive-ready materials.

Systems & Data Ownership (SQL / Databricks)

Maintain and improve backend dashboard logic in SQL and Databricks.

Ensure all data jobs run efficiently and reliably; proactively monitor performance and troubleshoot issues.

Update and refine data transformation logic as business needs evolve.

Build and maintain scalable, data-driven dashboards to support financial and operational decision-making.

Build scalable, flexible processes that support business growth.

Process Improvement & Systems Partnership

Seek efficiencies in financial processes and reporting workflows; build for scale and automation.

Partner with the Finance Systems team to refine data systems and reporting tools.

Provide reporting solutions that improve operational insights and decision-making.

Contribute to ongoing improvements in data governance, documentation, and system reliability.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Data Analytics, or related field.

4–8+ years of experience in FP&A, financial systems, or a related analytical role.

Strong financial modeling and forecasting experience.

Skilled in SQL and familiar with Databricks or comparable data platforms.

Experience supporting planning cycles (Outlook, quarterly forecasts, annual planning).

Strong analytical approach with demonstrated ability to perform root-cause variance analysis.

Experience developing or supporting financial dashboards and automated reporting tools.

Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex analysis into executive-ready insights.

The Opportunity

The CSC Technical Consultant is responsible for converting business requirements into scalable and technically sound solution builds across Adobe’s Content Supply Chain technology stack. In this role you will work closely with the CSC Business Consultant but focus on solution design, configuration, integrations, and data structure. You will be the technical expert across Workfront, Fusion. AEM Assets and connected CSC tools inside and outside the Adobe tech stack – and ensure the implementation aligns with established guidelines. You will take charge of implementing stable, scalable solutions that meet business requirements, accelerate customer adoption, and ensure value realization. Success means customers are self-sufficient post-go-live, timelines and achievements are consistently reached, and documentation is detailed and supports all collaborators.

What You’ll Do
 

Translate business requirements into technical specifications, architecture, and solution documentation 

Use AI-powered technologies to optimize code quality and development lifecycles 

Configure Workfront, AEM Assets, and other CSC platform components 

Work with integrations (Fusion or APIs) to connect systems across the content lifecycle. 

Implement defined taxonomy, metadata, and folder structure 

Build and test configurations, prototypes, and workflows 

Support customers during User Acceptance Testing (UAT) cycles 

Participate and collaborate in Architecture Review Boards to ensure proper code quality and scalability 

Partner with customer IT teams on authentication, access, SSO, and data security 

Solve and resolve technical issues, ensuring high system performance 

Support Sales organization during business development cycles, scoping activities, and through thought leadership 

Collaborate with Business Consultant to ensure solutions align with business requirements and defined processes 

Guide customers on platform standard methodologies, scalability, and governance 

Provide knowledge transfer and solution documentation after launch 
 

What You’ll Need To Succeed
 

8+ years technical implementation experience in SaaS platforms 

4+ years’ experience with Workfront, AEM Assets, Frame.io, or similar enterprise platforms 

Experience implementing solutions for enterprise systems of record (e.g., ERP, HCM/HRIS, SFA/CRM, etc.) 

Experience working with 3rd party software integrations (e.g. Fusion, Shopify, Box.com, Widen, Jira, Salesforce, etc.) 

Proficient with APIs, integrations, Fusion, JSON structures, and system-to-system data flows 

Proficient with Dell Boomi or equivalent Integration Platform as a Service (IPaaS) provider is desired 

Foundational mastery of scripting and/or software code languages (e.g. Java, PHP, Python; JavaScript, HTML, and CSS) 

Intermediate experience with relational databases and SQL 

Ability to design and articulate technical architecture to both technical and non-technical audiences

Introduction

Do you spend your days immersed in Adobe’s creative products, have a passion for them, and want to support creatives worldwide in unlocking their potential? We are looking for an experienced people manager to join our team and lead the art direction, creation, and production of content, as we innovate learning experiences across desktop, mobile, and web platforms. This position will direct project efforts, leading a team to ensure deliverables achieve standards of effectiveness, visual clarity, and refinement. We are a rapidly expanding and driven group of experts. Join and help us shape the future of how creatives learn in-app!

What you’ll be working on

Lead the team across multiple projects, from concepts through production.

Shape the visual direction of in-app content experiences, keeping content fresh and innovative while developing a scalable approach and standards to support the team.

Guide the team as they translate product functionality into clear, elegant visual stories that are accessible and globally resonant.

Build a culture of creativity, experimentation, rigor, and excellence across the team.

Work hands-on with new technologies, diving in to and exploring the latest in generative AI.

Forge relationships and build trust with partners and collaborators, representing the team and its work and driving alignment and success.

Partner closely with UX, product, research, and marketing partners to develop new content experiences and produce content at scale.

Work with external agencies, providing direction and ensuring creative outputs are effective, cohesive, and align with guidelines.

Hire, develop, and retain outstanding designers; mentor and grow talent.

What you’ll bring to the team

More than 8 years of experience in visual design, including over 2 years leading a design team.

A portfolio that demonstrates advanced design craft and the ability to communicate complex ideas visually.

Experience defining an evolving visual identity systems and applying them at scale.

Skilled at managing multiple projects, timelines, and collaborators.

Proven ability to mentor and manage designers, provide critique, and elevate output.

A proactive leader with a high standard for detail, clarity, and visual storytelling, capable of driving broad exploration and developing multiple viable directions.

A learner’s approach, curious and driven to explore emerging generative AI creative tools, with frequent use of AI like Adobe Firefly in creative work and prompt literacy.

Effective when facing pressure, capable of adapting and ensuring everyone stays aligned and progresses as projects rapidly evolve.

A confident communicator who can explain design decisions to cross-functional partners and rally teams around a creative vision.

Experience recruiting, hiring, and managing talent, including onboarding and maintaining a reliable pipeline.

Motivation to design visually compelling work that helps customers understand, navigate, and confidently use creative tools.

Highly proficient in Adobe Creative tools, especially Photoshop and Illustrator, plus familiarity with Firefly; comfortable working at the edge of new design tools and workflows.

Firefly Foundry enables organizations to build proprietary, IP-protected generative AI models trained on their own brand and creative assets. As a Foundry COE Enterprise Sales Lead, you will be a key driver of early-market adoption, helping define the product and market fit through direct engagement with strategic enterprise customers.

This is a high-impact, individual contributor leadership role focused on building. You will collaborate closely with your Manager, the Director (SLM), and cross-functional partners — including Product, Engineering, and Strategy — to translate customer insights into actionable guidance for the product, GTM motion, and adoption strategy.

You will focus on highly strategic sales execution: guiding select, complex enterprise engagements that shape how Foundry is adopted, how value is realized, and how the broader organization learns from these early opportunities. Come join our team and influence how Adobe’s most strategic generative AI capability enters the enterprise market!

What You’ll Do

Lead select, high-impact enterprise engagements that validate Foundry use cases and define customer value realization.

Shape customer vision by aligning senior collaborators around next-generation creative workflows and transformation outcomes.

Serve as a trusted advisor, helping customers navigate AI adoption and experiment with early-stage capabilities.

Capture and distill insights that directly inform product-market fit and foundational adoption patterns.

Help to define the early GTM model, including value frameworks, sales motions, and strategic account approaches.

Develop repeatable plays, messaging, and ways-of-working that scale across Sales, Product, and customer-facing teams.

Partner with your Manager and Director (SLM) to evolve segmentation, coverage, and prioritization based on early signals.

Contribute to thought leadership, internal education, and customer-facing materials that establish how Adobe positions Foundry.

Work closely with Product, Engineering, and Strategy teams to communicate customer needs, friction points, and emerging patterns.

Participate in early design reviews, roadmap discussions, and beta programs with a focus on real-world applicability.

Influence product direction through thoughtful, data-supported insights.

Act as a connective tissue across teams, ensuring alignment on customer goals and opportunity direction.

Maintain insight into customer adoption patterns, opportunity progression, and market signals.

Use both qualitative and quantitative insights to influence strategy and execution.

Support the COE Manager in maturing operating rhythms, forecast clarity, and field feedback loops without shifting into high-volume motion.

Identify market and competitive dynamics that inform early GTM refinement.

What You Need to Succeed

8+ years of enterprise solutions or strategic sales experience in complex technical environments.

Proven ability to influence senior executives and drive multi-stakeholder vision alignment.

Strong consultative problem-solving skills and critical thinking.

Experience collaborating closely with Product, Engineering, or Strategy to shape early-stage solutions or market direction.

Ability to operate in ambiguity, adapt quickly, and contribute to category creation.

Understanding of creative operations, content workflows, or digital asset management and experience with generative AI, machine learning, or creative automation platforms.

Familiarity with Adobe’s Creative Cloud, Experience Cloud, and Firefly products.

Experience working in early-stage, ambiguous, or rapidly evolving product spaces.

Background launching or scaling early-stage products.

Expertise in content-heavy industries (M&E, Retail/CPG).

AES Clean Energy (AES) is seeking a Transmission Strategy Market Lead for the ERCOT region, and possibly additional markets, to join our Transmission Strategy team. This role is responsible for both transmission planning and nodal production cost modeling.

AES is at the forefront of technical and strategic innovation. This team is central to continuing our industry leadership as one of the largest U.S. Independent Clean Power Producers, across Solar, Wind, and Storage.

This ERCOT Market Lead, Transmission Strategy role, will serve as the principal Transmission Strategy lead for ERCOT, and possibly additional continental US energy markets.

The Transmission Strategy team is responsible for setting a transmission focused market-wide strategy in all Continental U.S. energy markets, and integrating that strategy across AES teams, including Development, Commercial, Execution, and other teams. This strategy will be applied to prioritizing our greenfield efforts, prioritizing our project acquisition efforts, and prioritizing our existing project pipeline. The Transmission Strategy team is also responsible for project specific assessment of network impacts, and deliverability risks and opportunities.

This function is critical through all stages of development, from greenfield prospecting through late-stage interconnection studies and agreement execution. 

The Transmission Strategy team relies on a combination of traditional transmission planning and load flow analysis, while pioneering innovative approaches to anticipate transmission network opportunities and risks. The team relies on a mix of conducting in-house and consultant-supported load flow studies. 

Desired Skills, Expertise, etc. 

Deep relevant experience including transmission planning, market design, interconnection policy, resource adequacy and/or market operations is required. Experience with multiple Regional Transmission Organizations (RTO) and other non-RTO regions is a plus, but not a requirement.

Experience personally running power flow and stability analysis (i.e. powerGEM TARA, Powerworld, GE PSLF, Siemens PSS/E) required. Ideally, demonstrated project management experience including some experience overseeing others to run power flow studies, and experience with contractors running power flow studies is preferred. 

Experience personally running nodal production cost modeling (i.e., PROMOD, UPLAN, GE MAPS, Aurora), and evaluating dispatch trends, curtailment trends and locational marginal pricing trends.. 

Experience with ISO/RTO/TO Transmission Planning, Generation Interconnection, and processes and related stakeholder processes required. Experience with Resource Adequacy processes is a plus.

Experience with reviewing and negotiating Transmission Services Agreements (TSAs) preferred. Experience with assessing strategies for wheeling across balancing authorities, is beneficial. 

Experience with renewable energy development is beneficial. 

Ability to create a positive and productive teamwork environment. 

Ability to communicate effectively in both commercial and technical venues. Ability to present complex technical content in a simplified and useful manner for a non-technical audience. 

Ability to innovate and resolve complex challenges.

Willingness to travel as needed, which is not expected to exceed 10% of the time. 

AI and/or Automation experience is a plus.

Vision for what is needed to achieve success and ability to implement an effective plan of action.

POSITION: Sr. Interconnection Project Engineer (full time, exempt) 

DEPARTMENT: Interconnection, Grid Integration Group 

REPORTS TO: Manager, Interconnection 

LOCATION: Remote, San Francisco CA, Long Beach CA, Salt Lake City UT, Louisville CO, New York, NY, or Richmond, VA 

 

The Grid Integration group is responsible for siting and interconnecting the AES Clean Energy portfolio to transmission systems across the United States. The group consists of a Transmission Strategy team, Interconnection team, High Voltage Engineering team, and a Generation Modelling and Technical Compliance team. 

 

The primary responsibilities of this role are: strategic analysis of the interconnection procedures, queue and transmission system in a given RTO/ISO to formulate and steer greenfield project siting, and to then prepare and manage interconnection requests through to an Interconnection Agreement with the most favorable terms possible. The Interconnection Project Engineer supports the Interconnection (IC) Regional Lead on progressing projects through the interconnection process and working cross functionally with the broader Development Team to optimize the position throughout the development lifecycle. 

 

The preferred candidate has experience in: the preparation and review of interconnection requests; review and management of PSS/E and/or PSLF models; and participating in the management of solar and wind projects through the generator interconnection processes including negotiation and execution of Generator Interconnection Agreements. Additional responsibilities include monitoring the progress of required system upgrades and identifying creative mitigation solutions when needed within the applicable open access transmission tariff. 

 

Principal Duties and Responsibilities: 

The Interconnection Project Engineer will support and lead when necessary, all interconnection activities through the full life cycle of development and construction of projects. The position will support the IC Regional Lead and other internal stakeholders leading to the successful execution of both new and acquired projects across the United States. Some travel required (~15-20%). 

Support of greenfield development: review transmission system analysis, lead the identification of interconnection agencies and procedures, help lead preparation and filing interconnection requests including leading internal and external parties on preparation of technical materials, provide viability feedback to the IC Regional Lead and other internal stakeholders to support any financial and project approvals needed. 

Interconnection study process: lead and support the review and analysis of utility study reports; help lead tracking and reporting of results throughout process; help lead negotiation and execution of interconnection agreements and engineering and procurement agreements. 

Implementation of portfolio projects: lead assistance of internal groups to complete deliverables required by transmission owners to construct interconnection facilities including integrating schedules of Transmission Owner into project construction schedule. 

Support and lead project due diligence efforts, identify existing and potential red flags for project acquisitions. 

 

Desired Skills and Expertise: 

In depth knowledge reviewing interconnection studies and familiarity with power flow models. Experience running study models a plus. 

Strong ability to analyze power flow and system impact studies for interconnection of utility scale solar, wind, and storage generating facilities. 

In depth knowledge of System Impact Studies (SIS) and other interconnection studies of renewable energy generating facilities in the respective region. 

Experienced understanding of electrical diagrams, preliminary site plans, and preparation of interconnection request packages for submittal. 

Awareness of transmission systems and transmission expansion plans in US. 

Strong knowledge of Open Access Transmission Tariffs and Generator Interconnection Procedures. 

 

Minimum Qualifications: 

BS in Electrical Engineering or related field. 

4+ years work history in renewable or traditional energy development, utility generation development, or transmission planning. Previous employment or experience working at an Electric Utility, or consultants providing services within those footprints is strongly preferred.

AES Clean Energy is recruiting for the position of Manager within the Transmission Strategy department. The Transmission Strategy department is responsible for performing transmission system analysis to steer AES Clean Energy greenfield prospecting efforts and support the interconnection for our large utility-scale project portfolio. This is an outstanding opportunity for individual who is passionate about renewable energy and seeking high-growth work environment. The Transmission Strategy department actively tracks and analyzes transmission systems not just as they exist today, but how they will exist in the future. The department is instrumental in the strategic siting efforts of the entire development platform. The position will be responsible to set up and run a variety of innovative, automated power flow studies using power flow and coding software. As an internal power flow study expert, this position will work with internal Strategic Development team, and external entities including Transmission Owners, ISO/RTO to review, analyze and replicate generator interconnection study results.

The person could be based in one of our EAST region offices or work remotely. Some travel will be required (~10%).

Principal Duties and Responsibilities:

In partnership with internal stakeholders, lead to the successful execution of both new and acquired projects across the United States.

Analyze transmission grid to identify new opportunities for interconnecting renewable energy projects (i.e. solar, storage, wind).

Spearhead power flow analysis such as First Contingency Incremental Transfer Capability (FCITC), injection analysis, replicating key market and region deliverability studies.

Ability to set up and conduct automated power flow analysis using Python, or other scripting languages to expedite the analysis process.

Perform injection studies to identify the optimal interconnection locations for the placement of generator resources across the targeted study/focus region.

Actively track and participate in regions Transmission Planning Process, and advocate for AES clean energy portfolio to be included in Long Term Planning process.

Experience personally running nodal production modeling (i.e., PROMOD, UPLAN, GE MAPS, Aurora), and evaluating dispatch trends, curtailment trends and locational marginal pricing trends.

Obtain, update, and maintain regional power flow base cases with changes in resource mix and transmission topology based on ISO/RTO regional plans.

Remain up to date on all relevant new and upcoming technologies and knowledge to model them as per regions generator interconnection study criteria.

Perform network upgrade cost estimate allocation for the proposed projects, based upon applicable tariff.

Verify and challenge study results. Perform multiple scenario sensitivity analysis based on future queue projections and retirements.

Perform study review and provide technical insight and decision on acquisition generator projects. 

Strong knowledge of market efficiency analysis and identifying least congestion transmission points in the grid for delivery of power for PPA.

Understand and gain proficiency in Transmission Providers’ tariff, business practices, interconnection standards, interconnection study practices, cost allocation methodologies, transmission planning standards, and transmission system performance evaluation criteria. Possess an understanding of regional transmission plans and operational practices.

Minimum Qualifications:

BS in Electrical Engineering or related field.

5 years of working experience in renewable or traditional energy development, or transmission planning with an emphasis on generator interconnection studies.

Proficiency in power flow software (TARA, PSS/E).

Ability to automate generator interconnection studies on an interconnection wide basis.

Extensive knowledge of PJM Regional Transmission Expansion Plan (RTEP), Long Term Transmission Planning Process and modeling methodology.

Extensive knowledge of PJM Generator Interconnection study methodology.

Desired Skills and Expertise:

MS in Electrical Engineering or related field.

Familiarity with transmission systems and expansion plans, and generator interconnection study methodologies in MISO, NYISO and other affected systems.

Strong organizational skills and ability to prioritize and manage several projects simultaneously to meet project schedules.

Simulate and perform power system stability analyses using software such as PSCAD and/or PSSE for systems integrating new technologies and applications (EMT modeling experience preferred)

Develop project-specific system architecture concepts and technical documentation to support the development of new system functionalities, including clean generation and energy storage integration with data centers and the broader grid network

Identify high-level project objectives and coordinate with project teams and equipment subject matter experts (SMEs) to select equipment that defines potential solutions

Collaborate with the AES Technology Solutions group to establish de-risking objectives, review test plans, and analyze results from AES or vendor testbeds

Review results from offline and real-time simulations of new technology applications in AES power plants with the AES Generator Modeling team, and incorporate insights into the development of future products and projects

Transfer project-specific materials (share experience and guidance) to product engineers to assist in creating engineering product documents, such as templates, design guidelines, tools, and training materials

EMT power system modeling or similar experience strongly preferred; Experience with large load modeling (data centers, industrial facilities) and microgrids is a plus

The Senior Project Engineer on the Mega and M&A Engineering team will be responsible for design and engineering of utility scale solar PV and energy storage projects in development and construction phases. Responsibilities include lead and support engineering activities across the full project lifecycle, including design development and peer reviews, energy and performance modeling, equipment selection and specifications, and preparation of engineering calculations. Provide technical inputs to support Engineer Procure Construct (EPC) pricing estimates, RFP responses, permitting applications, design drafting, and technical due diligence for M&A project evaluations. Responsibilities also include engineering management, development and review of contract documents, participation in technical negotiations, preparation of procurement specifications, punch list development, and delivery of ongoing technical support throughout project execution.

Designs will be developed, optimized, analyzed, and reviewed using industry-standard tools, including PVsyst, AutoCAD, Civil 3D, GIS, MS Office, and SharePoint. This role will provide technical leadership across multiple projects by defining design-phase roadmaps, establishing development engineering standards and processes, and training and mentoring junior engineers. The successful candidate will manage complex, multi-project priorities, communicate progress to the Senior Manager of Mega and M&A Engineering, and operate effectively with distributed and remote teams. A strong background in the development, execution, analysis, and design of utility-scale, transmission-interconnected PV and battery energy storage systems is required, along with a demonstrated ability and commitment to coaching and developing engineering talent. Experience with additional renewable technologies such as wind, green hydrogen, or hydroelectric systems is a plus. Excellent communication, planning, and task-management skills, combined with broad technical expertise, are essential for success in this role.

The position is in Louisville, CO / Houston, TX / Salt Lake City, UT / or New York, NY and may include up to 25% travel to project locations and partner offices, including international travel.

Key Responsibilities

Project Development

M&A

Perform full technical due diligence and risk assessment for the M&A projects

Full project design evaluation to identify red flags and fatal flows

Redesign and update layouts, energy production estimates, EPC cost estimates, and equipment selections

Coordinate with M&A developer to complete necessary RFP response documentation

Design for select projects up to 30% electrical, civil, structural, and mechanical

Project Execution 

Mega

Develop scopes of work and technical contract exhibits.

Seek and evaluate proposals for engineering services.

Manage engineering consultants and EPC contractors to develop project construction drawings and support materials.

Perform technical project due diligence and project engineering design reviews.

Coordinate feedback from internal stakeholders and subject matter experts (SMEs) on design reviews.

Value engineer PV and BESS system designs to maximize reliability and reduce overall project cost.

Establish/review technical specifications of owner furnished equipment in coordination with Procurement and Sourcing.

Technical support during construction including: 

Respond to contractor requests for information (RFIs).

Perform quality assurance (QA)/ quality control (QC) checks in the field.

Develop punchlists.

Support commissioning activities with internal Technology/Commissioning teams and external stakeholders.

Review commissioning reports and analyze system performance.

Support internal Owner’s Engineering team through financing activities.

Support Operations/Asset Management teams to resolve technical issues at operating sites.

Assist Development and Project Management teams with budget development and key financial inputs.

Develop and implement technical solutions to region/market specific requirements in coordination with Director of Engineering, Mega Projects.

Growth and Leadership

Contribute to process improvement initiatives for the development and execution of safe, quality, and high-performance projects.

Develop inter-engineering processes for sharing information and best practices among the team

Manage relationships with 3rd party engineering consultants and firms utilized by the team

Mentor and train the team on changing trends in technology, best practices, and safety

Participate in AES Clean Energy’s growth planning process by contributing to process improvement task forces and other strategic planning activities

Primary Qualifications

Undergraduate degree in Engineering or equivalent technical field

5+ years of professional experience in solar PV system design, development, construction, and analysis preferred

Proficiency in PV system design, including 1-line and 3-line diagram conventions, NEC design requirements, overcurrent protection sizing, utility disconnecting means requirements, equipment selection, grounding methodologies, and short circuit current analysis

Experience with medium voltage collector system design

Effective leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills

Ability to work in a team environment

Proficient with MS Office Suite

“Plus” Qualifications

Graduate degree in Engineering

PE license

PMP Certification

NABCEP PV Installation Professional certification

2-5 years of experience with Battery Energy Storage Systems design and modeling

Experience with MATLAB, ETAP, SKM, and other advanced modeling tools

Substation/HV design experience

Reporting to the AES CE Manager of Technical Services, the goal of this position is to support, improve, and optimize the AES Clean Energy operational performance of a fleet of renewables across the US by providing technical expertise, troubleshooting and critical process support to substation relays, meters and communications equipment. The Senior Protection Relay and Metering engineer will provide support and troubleshooting to solar, wind and BESS facilities with substation telemetry, relay connectivity and OT projects requiring operations support. The Senior Protection Relay and Metering engineer will interface routinely with field services personnel and serve as the operations department liaison between networking personnel and the operational technology department.

Location: Remote/Hybrid. Preferred Locations Salt Lake City, UT; Louisville, CO; Dayton, OH; Indianapolis, IN; Churubusco, NY, Southern California or Phoenix metro area (Covering turbine assets across the US)

Main Responsibilities:

Primary subject matter expert for AES Clean Energy substation automation controller installations and troubleshooting

Substation meter subject matter expert

Establish and maintain connectivity, access and passwords to all substation and meter sites. Facilitate establishing these connections for new team members.

Provide real-time troubleshooting for emergent events involving substations, transmission lines or collection systems. Assist in educating team members in troubleshooting methods.

Mentor and train team members, BOP and field resources on connecting to relays and meters for the purposes of retrieving and interpreting relay data.

Ensure new sites have meters, relays and event collection configured properly for remote access and event collection

Provide real-time support to sites by collecting events and distributing event data and information to personnel to reduce the return to service time of substations impacted by disturbance events.

Manage the replacement of aging Remote Automation Controllers to minimize disruption to operations.

Participate in deployments of new OT initiatives and provide operations perspective/representation in their rollout.

Evaluate replacement solutions for obsolescent equipment such as PLC controllers or multifunction relays.

Participate in teams for the rollout of new NERC standards requiring telemetry solutions for event collection or electrical data collection.

Provide guidance and feedback to project execution teams on the setup of software protocols for communication of events/data.

Coordinate with reliability and performance engineers any OT/communications improvement technologies for the AESCE renewables fleet.

Share and capitalize on lessons learned and benchmarking from not only AES but other industry leaders.

Monitor new technology innovations in operational technology and substation communications systems and provide recommendations to project design teams to implement where appropriate.

Skills & Qualifications:

Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or equivalent technical field from an accredited college/university and 3-5 years of professional experience in one or more of the following areas: (PLCs,SCADA integration, networking, renewable energy systems, relays, power plant controllers and substation equipment)

Knowledge of condition monitoring systems and their connectivity

Excellent troubleshooting and problem solving skills related to network communications and SCADA systems

Knowledge of RTAC programming/Structured Text

Fluency with data acquisition systems and SCADA systems

Candidate must be innovative, with strong troubleshooting skills and must be flexible, with the ability to organize, prioritize, execute and follow up on many concurrent duties, as well as adapt quickly to changes in business priorities.

Ability to establish trust through building relationships and demonstration of capabilities.

Strong coaching skills and safety awareness.

Ability to work flexible schedules (late evenings/early mornings) as required

Proficient in the following focus areas; Communication Systems, operational technology systems related to renewables, and condition monitoring systems.

Outstanding interpersonal skills, including an ability to maintain calm and effective exchanges by all parties.

Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.

Willingness and ability to travel up to 25% (35% first year).

Proficient in Microsoft Office bundle including Project and Visio

Planning and project management skills for multiple change efforts.

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior SCADA Engineer to join our Remote Operational Control Center (ROCC) team. The successful candidate will play a critical role in the design, implementation, maintenance, and optimization of SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition) systems that monitor and control utility generation processes for our North American AES Clean Energy operations. This is position offers flexibility and the opportunity to work with SCADA technologies in a dynamic and collaborative environment. This is a solid opportunity for an individual to build a future in renewables for themselves and make a positive impact both at AES and globally. 

Principle Duties and Responsibilities

Design, configure, and maintain SCADA systems for operational control centers, ensuring reliable and secure data acquisition and process control.

Directly manage the SCADA Process and SCADA Vendor/integrator to meet project requirements and timelines

Monitor system performance, troubleshooting issues, and resolve faults to ensure continuous and efficient operation.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate SCADA systems with other industrial automation platforms and enterprise IT systems.

Work with SCADA Integrators to develop, test, and implement SCADA logic, graphical interfaces, and alarm systems to support operational requirements.

Review internal exhibits, create Scopes of Work (SOW) for SCADA bids and pass directly to vendors as needed. Delineate responsibilities and identify scope gaps. 

Participate in cybersecurity assessments and support best practices to protect SCADA infrastructure from threats.

Provide remote technical support and training to operations staff and end-users.

Document system configurations, procedures, and maintenance activities.

Participate in system upgrades, migrations, and expansion projects as needed.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, or equivalent field experience.

5+ years of experience in SCADA engineering, preferably in an operational control center environment.

Strong organizational skills and ability to prioritize projects and tasks.

Experience with SCADA platforms such as Bluence, Ignition, Emerson Ovation Green, Rockwell Factory Talk Optix, Wonderware, Siemens WinCC, or similar.

Strong understanding of industrial communication protocols (Modbus, DNP3, OPC, etc.).

Experience with remote monitoring, troubleshooting, and support tools.

Knowledge of cybersecurity principles and best practices for industrial control systems.

Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.

Ability to work independently in a remote setting and manage multiple priorities.

Preferred Skills

Knowledge of networking and IT infrastructure related to SCADA systems.

Experience with cloud-based SCADA solutions and virtualization technologies.

SCADA project management experience.

AES Clean Energy is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior Structural Engineer to support design development, plans review, and construction of wind, photovoltaic (PV) and grid-scale battery storage systems in coordination with the AES CE Business Development, Engineering and Construction teams.

The Senior Structural Engineer will be responsible for providing professional and technical support to multiple wind, solar PV and battery storage projects. Design review of structural plans for AES CE Engineering, construction alternatives and structural solutions, and quality control and assurance reviews will also be a part of their daily routine.

The Senior Structural Engineer supports a larger development and engineering project team and serves as the subject matter expert for technical and engineering matters related to structural engineering design. This position requires the candidate to have an extensive knowledge of pile load testing, Lpile reporting and analysis, shallow and deep foundations, concrete and structural steel design, corrosion of steel and concrete, and wind turbine generator (WTG) foundation design including spread footings and P&H tensionless pier. Excellent communication, task management and planning skills are needed, in addition to technical breadth.

The successful candidate will have a depth of experience in design, engineering, and analysis of civil plans, structural piles, and structural foundations for large scale renewable energy development projects. Experience with wind, PV systems and battery energy storage systems (BESS) ranging from 500 kW to 200 MW is preferable.

While Senior Structural Civil engineering is the primary qualification, the role will require the review of information related to general structural elements of photovoltaic system, wind, and battery storage design. The successful applicant, while not an expert, will be comfortable with high-level review of all elements of practical wind, BESS and PV system design.

The position is in our primary offices of Louisville, CO, Salt Lake City, UT, or San Francisco, CA, and may include up to 25% travel to project locations and partner offices.

Key Responsibilities

Project Execution

Adjust contract specifications to suit project requirements

Perform review of foundation and pile systems for projects in the design phase

Coordinate with team members and engineering consultants to develop detailed structural civil drawings and support material from conceptual and final drawings

Review, respond and comment on engineering reports and studies for structural design elements on all projects

Review and comment on design deliverables provided by consultants and contractors

Respond to contractor RFIs during course of construction

Conduct site visits for structural issues during construction or operations as required

Offer root cause analyses when structural issues occur

Perform Job Safety Assessments and Safety Walks to identify job-site hazards

Work closely with interconnection and project engineers to manage project timelines

Project Development

Review and occasionally provide preliminary structural designs for projects in early development

Complete review of geotechnical reports for structural impacts on projects in development

Prepare QA/QC review and comments on construction documents for permitting and construction

Coordinate with vendors and engineers to identify specifications and scopes of work for projects

Engineering Support

Draft and revise structural specifications for contractual standardization.

Provide technical input, design solutions and review of all structural documents

Confirm Structural engineering reports and studies are complete, and recommendations incorporated in the project construction documents

Collaborate with Project Management and Engineering team to troubleshoot projects or develop alternative repair and remediation plans

Design solutions for repairs and modifications to systems, and “close the gap” between various AES subcontractors and vendors where needed

Support the Innovation team with product reviews relating to structural design principles

Growth and Leadership

Improve and develop processes for the execution of safe, quality, and high-performance projects

Mentor and educate team on changing trends in technology, best practices, and safety

Participate in AES CE’s growth planning process by contributing to process improvement task forces and other strategic planning activities

Develop and refine tools for designing and estimating structural concepts

Skills and Qualifications

Primary Qualifications

Undergraduate degree in Structural Engineering or equivalent technical field.

5+ years professional experience in structural engineering design.

Proficiency in real-world structural, civil, geotechnical, and/or design build construction.

Field experience on large Structural projects, including in the field troubleshooting, quality evaluation, and construction support.

Experience with Structural Civil Engineering standards and codes in the US.

Proficiency with Microsoft Office.

“Plus” Qualifications

PE or SE qualifications, or on track to become qualified

Master’s degree in Civil Engineering

+2 years of experience with PV and Battery Energy Storage System design and WTG foundation design and/or 2+ years of experience with HV Substation and Overhead Line design

Experience with AutoCAD, Civil 3D, Lpile, finite element analysis (SAP2000, STAAD, or similar) or other advanced modeling tools

Spanish language skills

OSHA 10-hr or comparable job-site safety certification

The person holding this position is responsible for safe operation and maintenance of wind turbine power generation equipment.

Conduct all work activities in a professional, environmentally conscious, and safe manner.

Assure operational efficiency, unit reliability and compliance with safety and environmental standards. Maintain and complete tactical processes in a team oriented, multi-discipline environment.

Carry out troubleshooting and repair activities to ensure that wind turbine generation equipment work at the optimum levels.

Perform general and preventative maintenance on generators, pitch systems, yaw systems, cooling systems, and other wind turbine support systems. 

Perform predictive, preventive and corrective maintenance.

Experience in troubleshooting and correcting mechanical issues with gearboxes, pumps and other rotating equipment.

Experience in rotating machinery alignment.

Complete other tasks as requested by the Lead Technician or Facilities Manager.

Varying day shift schedule allow up to 6 days a week of coverage. Will also be required to respond to call outs and work overtime as needed.

Ability to enforce to and follow all safety policies.

Ability to perform inspections of safety equipment, vehicles, personal protective equipment, and plant equipment.

Must be timely and track time accurately. 

Qualifications:

Demonstrates effective oral and written communication skills.

Good decision-making skills.

Proven planning and interpersonal skills.

Capability to multi-task and prioritize work.

Ability to handle constantly evolving and emerging work priorities schedules and prioritizes work.

Ability to understand and read electrical drawings and to read, write and comprehend technical information.

Good digital literacy including Microsoft Office and other computer-based efficiency tools.

Demonstrates decision making abilities, long term developmental capabilities and networking skills.

Must have an unrestricted driver’s license and speak English.

Education:

High School Diploma or GED required.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

Ability to work in mechanically and electrically oriented situations.

Previous equivalent related experience and/or as the Company may determine to be an appropriate skill level.

Successful completion of all training, education courses and/or skill level testing required by the Company for entry into this position.

Knowledge of basic electrical testing equipment, commonly used bolts and torque values.

Additional Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

Attention to detail and strong interpersonal skills.

Work under pressure, remaining focused and calm in the face of distractions.

Possess high safety and environmental awareness.

Ability to optimally communicate and interact with diverse groups.

Ability to continuously learn and adapt to change.

Troubleshoot complicated mechanical and electrical problems on variable pitch, variable speed turbines.

Working Conditions:

Requires climbing ladders, standing, sitting, walking, kneeling, twisting, and climbing stairs to inspect, or collect data on plant equipment.

Outdoor conditions may run from very cold to hot and humid. Will work in confined spaces, dust, grease & oil and be exposed to loud noise.

Requires occasional travel outside service area.

Requires wearing personal protective safety equipment (respirators, safety glasses, hard hat, appropriate footwear, ear plugs, etc.)

Must have the ability to work at elevated spaces and be able to climb a 300-foot tower ladder daily.

Must be able to lift a minimum of 40 pounds.

Ability to work in all weather conditions.

Must be able to operate power tools such as grease guns, impact guns and rotating saws.

Must have the ability to operate hand tools such as wrenches, pliers and screwdrivers.
